A top fixing seat is fixedly connected to the top end of the lamp holder, a locking mechanism and a solar light panel are arranged on the upper surface of the top fixing seat, the supporting device comprises a connecting base, a plurality of supporting legs are hinged to the lower surface of the top of the connecting base, and first springs are fixedly connected to the sides, close to the connecting base, of the supporting legs; ground placement illumination is achieved through the supporting device, suspension illumination is achieved through the suspension device, the illumination range can be enlarged through the telescopic rod device, and various illumination requirements of a fire-fighting site can be met.

title: Linkage type double-shaft solar tracking support
abstract: The invention discloses a linkage type double-shaft solar tracking bracket, and belongs to a tracking bracket for receiving solar energy. An existing double-shaft solar tracking support is high in cost, and part of products are low in reliability. According to the tracking support, linkage of elevation angle tracking motion and azimuth angle tracking motion is achieved through the rocker mechanism, a set of tracking driving device is omitted, cost is reduced, and reliability is improved; according to the multi-machine linkage of the tracking bracket, a motor and an electric control box of each linked tracking bracket are omitted, and the cost of using a plurality of tracking brackets on the same ground is further reduced; an energy flow channel is arranged to reduce the abrasion of a wire or a conduit so as to improve the reliability; an adjuster, a correction rod, a correction rod elevation angle indicator and a correction rod azimuth angle indicator are arranged, so that the tracking support is easy to install, adjust and maintain. The tracking bracket is combined with a photovoltaic panel or a flat plate collector, can provide electric energy or hot water, and is suitable for idle regions in cities and villages, photovoltaic power stations, grassland pasturing areas, mobile photovoltaic vehicles, frontier sentries and the like.

title: Dibenzofuranyl carbazole derivative as well as preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of perovskite solar cells, and provides a dibenzofuranyl carbazole derivative and a preparation method and application thereof.The dibenzofuranyl carbazole derivative takes dibenzofuranyl carbazole as a functional group, molecular ordered accumulation is optimized, and hole mobility is remarkably improved; an alkyl carbon chain is used as a linking group, a phosphate group at the tail end is an anchoring group, perovskite interface defects can be effectively passivated, the energy loss at the interface can be reduced, single molecule self-assembly can be realized, the cell performance can be improved, and as a self-assembly monomolecular layer hole transport material, a perovskite solar cell has relatively high photoelectric conversion efficiency, and the photoelectric conversion efficiency can be improved. The service life is long; and the stability is high.

title: Charging station
abstract: The utility model discloses a charging station, which comprises a building main body, a first photovoltaic unit, a second photovoltaic unit and a power supply device, a first mounting area and a second mounting area are formed on the outer surface of the building main body, and the first mounting area is higher than the second mounting area; the first photovoltaic unit is arranged in the first mounting area, and the first photovoltaic unit can rotate relative to the building main body so as to adjust the orientation of the first photovoltaic unit; the second photovoltaic unit is arranged in the second mounting area; the power supply device is electrically connected with the first photovoltaic unit and the second photovoltaic unit and/or connected with an energy storage device powered by the first photovoltaic unit and the second photovoltaic unit. According to the charging station, through combination of the multiple photovoltaic units, the outer surface area of the building body can be effectively utilized, the illumination area of the charging station is increased, and the generating capacity is improved; the orientation of the photovoltaic unit can be adjusted, more solar radiation can be absorbed, the generating capacity is further improved, and the requirement for long-time and long-distance power supplementation of the vehicle is met.

title: Photovoltaic hot water system and control method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of comprehensive utilization of solar energy, in particular to a photovoltaic hot water system and a control method thereof.The photovoltaic hot water system comprises a photovoltaic array, a control system, a household power distribution cabinet set and a household electric water heater set, and the photovoltaic array comprises n photovoltaic set strings connected in parallel; the control system comprises an MPPT control module group, an anti-countercurrent unit and a main protection switch, the MPPT control module group comprises n MPPT control modules, and the anti-countercurrent unit comprises n anti-countercurrent diodes; each photovoltaic string is electrically connected with the corresponding MPPT control module to form a first loop, and each anti-countercurrent diode is connected with the corresponding MPPT control module in series and then electrically connected with the main protection switch to form a second loop; the MPPT control module can monitor the output voltage and current of the photovoltaic string in real time and automatically adjust the working state of the photovoltaic string, so that the system is always in the maximum power output state. The main protection switch is electrically connected with the household electric water heater set through the household power distribution cabinet set, and the household electric water heater set is electrically connected with the mains supply.

title: Agricultural light complementary type composite production system based on photovoltaic energy and planting method of agricultural light complementary type composite production system
abstract: The invention discloses an agricultural light complementary type composite production system based on photovoltaic energy and a planting method thereof, and relates to the technical field of solar power generation, the agricultural light complementary type composite production system comprises a frame, a photovoltaic panel is embedded in the middle of the top end of the frame, the outer side of the photovoltaic panel is sleeved with an air cushion, and bases are symmetrically installed at the bottom of the frame; according to the invention, external disturbing force can be converted into disturbing pressure, dynamic conversion and superposition of gravity, internal air pressure and external wind power can be realized, triple elastic locking of a photovoltaic panel can be realized, and the stability of the photovoltaic panel can be improved. According to the technical scheme, the connecting stress among the frame, the photovoltaic panel and the base is enhanced, sufficient elastic buffer space is synchronously given to the photovoltaic panel, the compatibility of the photovoltaic panel to the complex external environment is greatly improved, the sustainability and stability of agricultural and photovoltaic complementary work are improved, photovoltaic array dynamic optimization can be more effectively carried out, and the working effect of the photovoltaic panel is improved.

title: Efficiency adaptation method applied to stratosphere solar communication unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract: According to the efficiency adaptation method applied to the solar communication unmanned aerial vehicle in the stratosphere, collaborative optimization of energy management and communication service of the solar unmanned aerial vehicle in the stratosphere environment is achieved by constructing a dynamic solar radiation database, predicting communication load and setting a dynamic threshold value and a multi-objective optimization mechanism. The method has the capability of responding to solar radiation fluctuation and communication load change in real time, effectively avoids the problems of misalignment of electric quantity management and interruption of a communication link, and remarkably improves the cruising ability and task reliability of the unmanned aerial vehicle. Meanwhile, according to the method, through a data-driven closed-loop optimization mechanism, the energy utilization efficiency and the communication quality are both considered, and the method has good practicability and popularization value.

title: Floating type inflatable solar concentrating power generation device
abstract: The invention relates to a floating type inflatable solar concentrating power generation device, and belongs to the technical field of solar lighting and power supply devices. The invention relates to a floating type inflatable solar concentrating power generation device, which can be used for concentrating light at a high proportion, simultaneously concentrating light beams and scattered light, realizing electricity and heat cogeneration, continuously providing alternating current in the daytime and providing illumination at night, and comprises a large concentrating fixed condenser consisting of an inflatable dome-shaped divergent Fresnel lens filled with helium or hydrogen and a non-imaging solar condenser, and a small concentrating fixed condenser consisting of an inflatable dome-shaped divergent Fresnel lens filled with helium or hydrogen and a non-imaging solar condenser, the wall surface of the transparent cylinder is covered with a display screen; at least one LED lamp or bulb; a solar thermoelectric and photovoltaic hybrid receiver; at least one thermoelectric module; a thermal energy storage device; the battery pack is provided with a charger and a charging controller; and a micro inverter. Wherein the transparent cylinder surrounds the inflatable condenser, and the LED lamp or the bulb is located between the condenser and the transparent cylinder. The whole system floats in the air and does not occupy land.

title: Inverted perovskite solar cell based on composite carbon electrode and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of solar cells, and particularly relates to an inverted perovskite solar cell based on a composite carbon electrode and a preparation method of the inverted perovskite solar cell. The structure of the inverted perovskite solar cell sequentially comprises a glass substrate, a conductive graphene-ITO composite carbon electrode, a hole transport layer, a perovskite light absorption layer and an electron transport layer, the composite carbon electrode is obtained by directly preparing conductive graphene on a glass substrate through a coating method and then depositing an ITO film on the surface of the graphene through a magnetron sputtering method. According to the composite carbon electrode, interface contact and energy level matching can be improved, and the photoelectric conversion efficiency and stability of the battery are improved.

title: Solar energy storage and air energy complementary control system and control method
abstract: The invention provides a solar energy storage and air energy complementation control system and method, and the method comprises the steps: collecting original data, and constructing a system state vector; based on the system state vector, calculating an effective energy supply ratio of an introduced battery temperature correction coefficient; defining cooling feasibility criteria based on the battery temperature and the water tank temperature; generating a strategy vector based on the effective energy supply ratio and the cooling feasibility criterion; calculating the current capability of each energy channel based on the strategy vector and the system state vector; obtaining the target power of each energy channel based on the starting state of each energy channel, a preset priority weight and the current capability; the duty ratio of the liquid cooling water pump is calculated; operating at a fixed scheduling cycle, and determining to hold or refresh an instruction by judging whether the change of each control target exceeds a minimum change threshold; and finally, issuing each target power and duty ratio to corresponding equipment.

title: Wake-up of access execution points
abstract: According to a first aspect of the present disclosure, a computer-implemented wake-up method performed by an access execution point is provided. The access execution point may be configured to cause operation of the access point, preferably to cause unlocking and/or locking of the access point. The access execution point may include an energy harvesting device, which may include a solar cell and an energy storage device. The method may include collecting ambient light by a solar cell and generating a solar cell signal. The method may include determining that the solar cell signal satisfies a mode switching condition. The method may include switching an access execution point from a sleep mode to an active mode in response to determining that the solar cell signal satisfies a mode switching condition. The mode switching condition may include a drop in the solar cell signal, which may correspond to a reduction in ambient light incident on the solar cell that may occur when the solar cell is manually shaded.

title: Storage and charging integrated charging device for vehicle
abstract: A storage and charging integrated charging device for a vehicle belongs to the technical field of charging equipment, and comprises an electric vehicle charging pile body, a storage battery pack, a solar cell panel, a time switch, a support frame, a charging control circuit, a detection circuit and an output circuit, the solar cell panel is installed on the supporting frame, and the storage battery pack, the time control switch, the charging control circuit, the detection circuit and the output circuit are installed in the electric vehicle charging pile body and electrically connected. According to the utility model, the energy storage battery can be charged through the solar cell panel, and when the solar cell panel is not fully charged, the time control switch cooperates with the detection circuit, and the AC power supply-to-DC power supply module can supply power to the energy storage battery in a low-ebb power consumption time period. When the vehicle is charged, the charging control circuit cooperates with the output circuit, the vehicle storage battery can be firstly charged through the energy storage battery, and the commercial power can be switched to charge the vehicle storage battery when the electric quantity of the energy storage battery is not enough, so that energy and expenses are effectively saved on the basis of ensuring effective charging of the vehicle.

title: Marine solar power station
abstract: The utility model provides a marine solar power station which comprises a ship body, elevated overhanging decks which are symmetrically arranged left and right are fixedly installed on the top of a main deck of the ship body through an elevated structure, and a plurality of sets of light hatch covers are movably installed on the tops of the elevated overhanging decks in a rolling overlapping mode. The top of each light hatch cover is fully provided with solar power generation panels in a full-area mode. All the light hatch covers cover the upper space of the whole cargo hold in a lap joint mode after being completely unfolded, and power is generated through the solar power generation panel to provide electric energy for the ship. When the ship needs to be loaded or unloaded, all the light hatch covers are pulled into the length range of the single light hatch cover at the front end or the rear end of the ship, so that the cargo hatch of the ship is fully opened, and ship cargo loading and unloading are facilitated.

title: Benzoindolo [2, 3-a] carbazole compound as well as synthesis method and application thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a benzoindolo [2, 3-a] carbazole compound and a synthesis method and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of photoelectric materials, the benzoindolo [2, 3-a] carbazole compound is a compound shown as a formula I and a formula II, the compound takes two isomeride benzoindolo [2, 3-a] carbazole with different benzene ring orientations as a main body, and the main body is a compound shown as a formula II; the main bodies with different orientations have obvious different influences on molecular accumulation and self-assembly growth, the solubility and wettability of molecules in an organic solvent are adjusted, and the hole transport layer material is applied to a perovskite solar cell, so that the photovoltaic performance and stability of the perovskite solar cell are effectively enhanced; the energy level and the dipole moment can be adjusted through different functional groups, so that hole extraction and charge transfer are enhanced, and the application range of the hole transport layer material in different perovskite solar cells is widened.

title: Trimethoxy-substituted PTAA copolymer as well as preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a trimethoxy-substituted PTAA copolymer as well as a preparation method and application thereof. The structural formula of the trimethoxy-substituted PTAA copolymer is shown as a formula (I), the perovskite solar cell prepared from the trimethoxy-substituted PTAA copolymer disclosed by the invention has relatively high open-circuit voltage, and the energy conversion efficiency of the perovskite solar cell is effectively improved.

title: Coating capable of being sprayed to prepare structural color radiation refrigeration functional layer and preparation method of coating
abstract: The invention relates to a coating capable of being sprayed to prepare a structural color radiation refrigeration functional layer and a preparation method of the coating, and aims to provide the coating capable of being sprayed to an outer wall of a building to prepare the structural color radiation refrigeration functional layer so as to realize the requirements of reducing the refrigeration energy consumption of the building, endowing the building with high-saturation color and promoting the energy-saving and environment-friendly development of the building. The preparation method comprises the steps of preparing the coating, spraying the coating on the surface of a building to prepare the radiation refrigeration functional layer and the like. The coating is prepared from the following components in percentage by mass: 20 to 45 weight percent of monodisperse spherical inorganic filler with solar spectrum reflection or infrared spectrum emission, 10 to 30 weight percent of polymer with transparent spectrum or high infrared spectrum emissivity, 0 to 10 weight percent of functional additive and 30 to 50 weight percent of solvent. The emissivity of the radiation refrigeration functional layer in the 8-12 [mu] m wave band of an atmospheric window is not lower than 0.8, and the radiation refrigeration functional layer shows multiple colors including red, green, blue and the like according to selection of the particle size of the spherical inorganic filler. The preparation method provided by the invention is simple in process, is not limited by the size and the shape of a spraying substrate, can effectively reduce the refrigeration energy consumption of a building, endows the building with good aesthetic characteristics, and can improve the energy efficiency and the living suitability of the building.

title: Photovoltaic hydrogen production system and method considering waste heat recovery and solar tracking
abstract: The invention provides a photovoltaic hydrogen production system and method considering waste heat recovery and solar tracking, and relates to the technical field of electricity-hydrogen-heat capacity configuration optimizing.According to the system, a distributed photovoltaic system of a solar tracking device is designed and used for independently controlling rotation of a cadmium telluride CdTe photovoltaic panel in a distributed mode; the cadmium telluride CdTe photovoltaic panel rotates along with the sun, the solar radiation utilization rate is increased, the hydrogen production amount and the system economical efficiency are improved, meanwhile, waste heat of the electrolytic bath is divided into low-grade heat and medium-high-grade heat according to different temperature levels through the waste heat recovery unit to be sold to heat supply networks in different areas, and the energy utilization rate is increased. According to the method provided by the invention, the parameters of the CNN-LSTM model are calculated through the COA algorithm so as to predict the photovoltaic power at the future moment, the trained CNN-LSTM model can improve the prediction precision and reduce the influence caused by uncertainty, and meanwhile, a capacity configuration plan for multi-target optimization is formulated so as to reduce the cost.

title: Photovoltaic power generation and greenhouse agriculture integrated system
abstract: The technical scheme of the invention discloses a photovoltaic power generation and greenhouse agriculture integrated system. According to the photovoltaic agricultural integrated technology disclosed by the invention, photovoltaic power generation and greenhouse planting are innovatively combined, and a solar panel with adjustable light transmittance of 30%-90% is mounted at the top of an agricultural facility, so that sunlight is utilized for power generation, and illumination required by crop growth is reserved. The system disclosed by the invention is provided with an intelligent sensor and an AI algorithm, environment data is monitored in real time, the angle, light supplementing intensity, temperature and humidity of the photovoltaic panel are dynamically adjusted, and different crop requirements (such as low illumination of leaf vegetables and medium and strong illumination of fruits and vegetables) are accurately matched. Residual electricity is stored or connected to a grid, photovoltaic waste heat is recycled in winter for heat preservation, sun shading and cooling are conducted in summer, and efficient circulation of energy is achieved.

title: Novel push-pull type membrane distillation assembly for real-time visual monitoring of membrane pollution
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of membrane distillation, and discloses a novel push-pull type membrane distillation assembly for real-time visual monitoring of membrane pollution. The assembly comprises a shell, two photovoltaic units, two membrane distillation units, two refrigeration units and two visual units. The photovoltaic unit can convert solar energy into heat energy and electric energy and provide a heat source for membrane distillation; the refrigeration unit adopts a semiconductor refrigeration layer to cool the cold side; the visual unit comprises symmetrically arranged miniature waterproof cameras and is used for monitoring the membrane surface pollution state in real time; and the membrane distillation unit adopts a pull-out structure, so that the membrane distillation unit is convenient to quickly replace and maintain after being polluted. The device integrates photoelectric heat cogeneration, semiconductor refrigeration, waste heat recovery and visual monitoring, has the advantages of compact structure, low energy consumption, pollution visualization and convenience in maintenance, and is suitable for efficient and energy-saving membrane distillation operation.

title: Laser light supplementing device for field crop growth regulation and control
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of field plant cultivation devices, in particular to a laser light supplementing device for field crop growth regulation and control. Comprising a power supply module, a control circuit module, a laser lighting module and a supporting column. The solar power generation panel, the energy storage unit and the laser transmitter are electrically connected with the control circuit module; the laser lighting module is fixed to the top of the supporting column. The solar power generation panel charges the energy storage unit through photoelectric conversion; the laser lighting module comprises a laser transmitter, a free-form surface lens array, a light-transmitting panel and a cover body, the free-form surface lens array covers the outer side of the transmitting end of the laser transmitter, and the light-transmitting panel is connected to the outer side of the free-form surface lens array in a sleeving mode. The upper part of the light-transmitting panel is hermetically connected with the cover body; a laser beam emitted by the laser emitter is transmitted and shaped through the free-form surface lens array, and a rectangular laser beam is emitted from the light-transmitting panel. The light supplementing device has the advantages that the energy uniformity of light beams is improved, the energy consumption is reduced, and the irradiation distance is long.

title: Air conditioner energy consumption management system and method based on self-adaptive load
abstract: The invention discloses an air conditioner energy consumption management system and method based on a self-adaptive load, and relates to the technical field of energy consumption management. Data such as outdoor temperature, solar radiation intensity, total power consumption of an air conditioner system and real-time number of people in each partition are collected by arranging an external environment sensor and an internal environment sensor of a building; and integrating the data into a unified vector. And based on vector calculation, a comprehensive thermal load index and a system real-time energy efficiency ratio are calculated, and a situation portrait reflecting a system operation state is formed. And further calculating an energy efficiency deviation rate and a load-power consumption consistency index according to the situation portrait, and diagnosing system states in real time through a preset threshold value, including normality, slight energy efficiency abnormality, serious energy efficiency abnormality, load-power consumption mismatch and composite abnormality. And finally, executing a corresponding regulation and control strategy according to a diagnosis result. The method can dynamically adapt to building heat load changes, real-time energy efficiency monitoring and intelligent optimization of the air conditioning system are achieved, and the energy utilization efficiency is improved.

title: Stackable lightweight intelligent mobile bank and service system
abstract: The invention discloses a stackable lightweight smart mobile bank and service system, and modular box units of the stackable lightweight smart mobile bank and service system are made of carbon fiber composite materials, so that the stackable lightweight smart mobile bank and service system is light in weight and high in compressive strength. The system integrates various energy collection and storage devices such as glass patch photovoltaic, solar photovoltaic and piezoelectric energy assemblies, the utilization rate of renewable energy reaches 75%, and self-sufficiency of energy is achieved. The system is provided with a 5G network system, multiple functional areas and advanced equipment, supports multi-scene application, and can provide functions of financial business handling, intelligent customer service, community life service integration and the like. According to the system, the deployment cost is reduced by 60%, the deployment time of a single website is shortened to 48 hours, the convenience and high efficiency of bank services are remarkably improved, meanwhile, the performance in the aspect of environmental protection is excellent, and compared with a traditional website, the carbon emission in the whole life cycle is reduced by 80%.

title: Detachable folding combined solar charging backpack
abstract: The utility model provides a detachable folding combined type solar energy charging packsack which comprises a packsack body, the packsack body is composed of a packsack body, a right packsack body, a left packsack body and a front packsack body, the left packsack body and the right packsack body are integrally formed and arranged on the left side and the right side of the packsack body, the front packsack body is respectively connected with the packsack body, the right packsack body and the left packsack body through a packsack body main zipper, and the right packsack body is connected with the left packsack body through a packsack body main zipper. A solar panel storage bag is arranged on the front side of the front bag body, a folding solar charging panel storage bag is arranged in the solar panel storage bag, a folding solar charging panel is placed in the folding solar charging panel storage bag, a charging head is arranged on the folding solar charging panel, and the first storage bag and the second storage bag are fixed to the back bag body. According to the detachable folding combined type solar charging packsack, the detachable independent storage bag is arranged and can be used in combination with the packsack body or independently, and the special solar panel storage bag is arranged, so that the solar panel is convenient to use and store.

title: Aluminate dark red fluorescent powder as well as preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention provides aluminate dark red fluorescent powder as well as a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of solid luminescent materials. According to the aluminate dark red fluorescent powder, manganese is adopted to activate aluminate, the excitation spectrum coverage area is wide, the excitation range covers most of ultraviolet and blue light areas, and the emission spectrum is concentrated near 659nm. The fluorescent powder can absorb light from ultraviolet light to a blue light region in a solar spectrum, has very strong emission intensity in a dark red light region, can emit red light under the irradiation of sunlight, can improve the utilization rate of light energy, and is more favorable for promoting the photoelectric conversion efficiency of a silicon solar cell. The fluorescent powder can be prepared into a film to be compounded on the surface of a solar cell, the solar spectrum is optimized, and the energy conversion efficiency of the solar cell is improved.

title: Carnot battery energy storage system coupling data center waste heat and solar energy and control method
abstract: The invention provides a Carnot battery energy storage system coupling data center waste heat and solar energy and a control method. The Carnot battery energy storage system comprises a heat pump subsystem, a heat storage subsystem and an organic Rankine subsystem. The heat pump subsystem comprises heat pump circulation and further comprises a cold storage tank. Besides a heat storage tank, the heat storage subsystem further comprises a solar power generation module and a data center waste heat utilization module. In the energy storage mode, a large amount of waste heat generated by the data center can be used for meeting the thermal load requirement of the user side, and the rest of waste heat can be stored in the Carnot battery, so that the heat storage capacity of the Carnot battery is improved; in the power supply mode, waste heat generated by the data center can be used for preheating a circulating working medium and increasing the inlet temperature of the solar power generation module, so that the solar photo-thermal utilization rate is increased, the heat storage temperature of the Carnot battery is increased finally, and the energy utilization rate of the Carnot battery is increased; according to the invention, high-efficiency recycling of medium and low-grade heat energy in different time and space can be realized.

title: Optical weeding system and method
abstract: The invention relates to the field of agricultural equipment, and provides an optical weeding system and method. The optical weeding system comprises a base and a solar weeding device, the solar weeding device is arranged on the base and comprises a lighting assembly, a collimating lens, a light guide assembly and a cylindrical lens, the lighting assembly comprises a supporting frame and a Fresnel lens, and the Fresnel lens is arranged on the upper portion of the supporting frame. Sunlight is focused to a focus through the Fresnel lens to form a high-energy light spot, light output by the Fresnel lens is collimated through the collimating lens, and the focused light is output through the cylindrical lens to form a linear high-temperature light spot on the ground; solar energy of renewable clean energy is directly utilized to form a light knife for physical thermal cutting weeding, consumption of non-renewable energy sources is reduced, and the use cost is reduced; due to the fact that optical weeding is adopted, chemical reagents are not needed, and pollution to soil and water sources is avoided.

title: Multi-element metal-based catalyst as well as preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a multi-element metal-based catalyst as well as a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of metal-based catalysts. The multi-metal-based catalyst takes an iron-based spinel oxygen carrier AB2O4 as a matrix, the A site is multi-metal compounding, and the B site uses a transition element to replace part of Fe; the general formula is MFe2-xNxO4, M is a multi-metal compound, N is a transition element, and x is more than or equal to 0.05 and less than or equal to 0.5. The multi-element metal-based catalyst MFe2-xNxO4 provided by the invention can be applied to a two-step thermochemical CO2 or H2O decomposition system and a two-step thermochemical methane dry/wet reforming system. According to the invention, the concentrated solar energy can be used for providing reaction heat for the reaction, CO2, H2O and other substances with wide sources are used as raw materials to prepare CO, H2, synthesis gas and other high value-added chemicals, the whole process can realize no coal consumption and zero carbon emission, and the method is a very clean and promising green fuel preparation technology.

title: Building radiation refrigeration ceramic tile taking industrial silicon slag as raw material and preparation method of building radiation refrigeration ceramic tile
abstract: The invention relates to a building radiation refrigeration ceramic tile taking industrial silicon slag as a raw material and a preparation method thereof. The ceramic is prepared by molding industrial silicon slag powder with the particle size of more than or equal to 100 meshes at room temperature and sintering at high temperature. The sintered ceramic is of a porous structure and mainly comprises silicon oxide and silicate. The porous structure has a strong Mie scattering effect on a solar spectrum and does not absorb solar spectrum energy, silicon oxide and silicate components have strong infrared radiation characteristics in an atmospheric window, and the ceramic tile has a radiation refrigeration function by combining the two mechanisms. When the ceramic tile is used for building exterior wall decoration, building refrigeration energy consumption can be effectively reduced. According to the radiation refrigeration ceramic tile, the sunlight spectrum wave band reflectivity is larger than or equal to 0.85, the 8-12 micron wave band emissivity in an atmospheric window is larger than or equal to 0.82, the refrigeration efficiency under the direct solar radiation condition is larger than or equal to 83 W/m < 2 >, and the refrigeration temperature difference of 6.2 DEG C is achieved. Theoretical calculation shows that in the typical environment of the Nanchang city, by using the ceramic tile, the refrigeration energy consumption can be saved by more than or equal to 16 MJ/m < 2 > all year round. According to the invention, high-value utilization of the industrial silicon slag can be realized, and the prepared building radiation refrigeration ceramic tile has good application potential in the field of reduction of building energy consumption, so that the purpose of sustainable and green social development is achieved.

title: Control method and device of photovoltaic system
abstract: The invention is suitable for the technical field of solar power generation, and provides a control method and device for a photovoltaic system, and the method comprises the following steps: obtaining the state information of a photovoltaic panel and the environment data of a place where the photovoltaic panel is located in real time; based on an illumination intensity prediction model, obtaining a maximum illumination intensity prediction value according to all-sky imaging time sequence data, sun position information and meteorological data; according to the maximum illumination intensity prediction value, the sun position information and the state information of the photovoltaic panel, an objective function about the photovoltaic power generation amount prediction value and mechanical energy consumption required by angle adjustment of the photovoltaic panel is established; according to the objective function, predicting to obtain a theoretical optimal angle adjustment value of the photovoltaic panel; and controlling the photovoltaic panel to perform angle adjustment according to the theoretical optimal angle adjustment value of the photovoltaic panel. According to the invention, through fusion of multi-source information, an illumination intensity change trend and a cloud layer movement track can be anticipated prospectively, so that the photovoltaic panel can be adjusted to an optimal position in advance, and the method has weather adaptability and dynamic prediction capability.

title: Paint baking equipment and process for high-temperature paint of nickel-based tube panel of solar heat absorber
abstract: The invention discloses paint baking equipment and technology for high-temperature paint of a nickel-based tube panel of a solar heat absorber, and aims at solving the problems that in the paint baking process of high-temperature paint of a tube panel of an existing solar heat absorber, the equipment universality is poor, and a paint film is prone to being damaged due to unreasonable technological parameters. The equipment is high in flexibility, the sectional design can adapt to tube panels of different sizes, and the equipment investment cost is reduced; the process stability is high: through the pre-baking step and the baking temperature adjustment, the paint film explosion is avoided, and the adhesive force is improved by more than 30%; the solar energy absorption rate stably reaches 95%, and the thermal shock resistance of the tube panel can meet more than 1000 times of cycle tests.

title: Environmental parameter acquisition method and device, equipment and storage medium
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides an environmental parameter acquisition method and device, equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring hot end heat and cold end heat corresponding to a power supply component and a target channel corresponding to a communication component; controlling the power supply assembly to output power based on the hot-end heat and the cold-end heat; controlling the acquisition equipment to acquire environmental parameters based on the power supply; and transmitting the environmental parameters to the terminal device based on the target channel. According to the embodiment of the invention, power generation is carried out by means of the temperature difference which generally exists in a family environment and is continuously far higher than illumination, power supply fluctuation caused by solar energy depending on illumination and limited battery capacity is avoided, power supply stability is realized, and the problem that acquisition equipment stops working due to power supply is fundamentally solved; the environment parameters are transmitted to the terminal equipment through the target channel, and the target channel is the communication channel with the optimal communication performance in the communication component after being screened and adapted, so that the high efficiency of environment parameter transmission is realized, and the terminal equipment is ensured to acquire the environment parameters in time.

title: Stably-butted unmanned aerial vehicle charging pile
abstract: The invention discloses a stably-butted unmanned aerial vehicle charging pile, and relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle charging piles, the stably-butted unmanned aerial vehicle charging pile comprises a dual-function integrated assembly, the dual-function integrated assembly comprises an insulating frame, and the top end of the insulating frame is fixedly connected with a hollow toothed bar. According to the stably-butted unmanned aerial vehicle charging pile, the two functional areas including the photovoltaic power generation area and the power grid charging area are integrated on the front side and the back side of the insulating frame, when the charging pile is not used, the photovoltaic power generation area on the front face upwards absorbs solar energy and converts the solar energy into electric energy, and a cable converts the electric energy through a controller through a threading hole in the middle of a hollow toothed rod and then stores the electric energy in a storage battery; wind energy and solar energy are directly converted into electric energy through the photovoltaic power generation area on the front face of the insulation frame and the wind power generation module at the top end of the cabin, the charging requirement of the unmanned aerial vehicle is preferentially met, redundant electric energy is stored in the storage battery, a light-storage-charging closed loop is achieved, an external power grid is not needed, the system is particularly suitable for remote outdoor scenes, dependence on traditional electric power is reduced, and the system is convenient to use. And carbon emission is reduced.

title: Bird repeller for electric power engineering
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of bird repelling devices, in particular to an electric power engineering bird repelling device which comprises a bottom plate, a magnetic attraction clamping seat structure is fixedly connected to the middle of the lower end of the bottom plate, a supporting frame is fixedly connected to the left portion of the upper end of the bottom plate, and a solar panel is fixedly connected to the upper end of the supporting frame. The right end of the supporting frame is fixedly connected with an energy storage battery, the lower end of the energy storage battery is fixedly connected with the bottom plate, the right portion of the upper end of the bottom plate is fixedly connected with a mounting frame, and the middle of the inner lower wall of the mounting frame is fixedly connected with a bird repelling device. According to the bird repelling device for the electric power engineering, accessories such as the solar panel, the energy storage battery, the bird repelling device and the magnetic attraction clamping base structure are arranged, under the mutual cooperation effect of the accessories, stable energy supply, an effective bird repelling mode and a convenient and stable installation structure are adopted, and the bird repelling device is convenient to use and high in practicability. Therefore, the bird repeller for electric power engineering can repel birds in a wider range for a longer time in the aspect of electric power.

title: Solar window suction lamp
abstract: The utility model provides a solar window suction lamp, and belongs to the technical field of decorative lamps. The solar window suction lamp comprises a lampshade and a base, the lampshade is connected to the base in an inserted mode, a solar panel is fixed to the back face of the base, a containing groove for a rechargeable battery to be inserted is formed in the base, the base is further provided with a lamp strip and a control chip which are powered on to emit light, and the solar panel, the lamp strip and the rechargeable battery are connected to the control chip through wires respectively. A connecting assembly capable of being fixed to glass is arranged outside the base. The solar lamp is fixed on a glass window through a sucker or a sticky hook, can absorb solar energy in daytime to charge the rechargeable battery, and can be used for illumination at night.

title: MOF-derived Cu/t-ZrO2 bimetallic heterojunction catalyst as well as preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention discloses an MOF-derived Cu/t-ZrO2 bimetallic heterojunction catalyst as well as a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of photocatalyst materials. The preparation method of the catalyst comprises the following steps: adding an organic ligand suspension into a mixed solution of a copper source and 1, 2-bis (diphenylphosphine) ethane, and mixing and reacting under anhydrous and anaerobic conditions to obtain a copper-doped organic ligand material; the copper-doped organic ligand material and a zirconium source are mixed by using an organic solvent and then are subjected to a heating reaction to obtain a copper-doped zirconium-based metal organic framework material; and calcining the copper-doped zirconium-based metal organic framework material in an air atmosphere, and carrying out heat treatment in an inert atmosphere to obtain the MOF-derived Cu/t-ZrO2 bimetallic heterojunction catalyst. According to the MOF-derived Cu/t-ZrO2 bimetallic heterojunction catalyst disclosed by the invention, efficient, stable and low-cost solar energy-hydrogen energy conversion can be realized.

title: Building energy consumption management and control method
abstract: The invention discloses a building energy consumption management and control method, belongs to the technical field of building energy-saving control, and solves the problems of response lag and energy waste caused by independent operation of a lighting system and an HVAC system. According to the technical scheme, a building parameter database is pre-stored; environment data and equipment power consumption are collected in real time; calculating a solar radiation thermal gain coefficient and a thermal load influence quantity of illumination on the HVAC; when the dynamic coupling factor exceeds a first threshold value or the variation of the illumination intensity exceeds a second threshold value within a preset time, triggering collaborative optimization; a lighting target power consumption value (the compensated lighting power consumption is not lower than a preset proportion of the basic lighting demand value) is synchronously generated after response, and the HVAC set temperature is corrected based on the thermal gain coefficient; and finally a control instruction is issued. The method is mainly used for real-time energy consumption collaborative optimization of large-scale public buildings.

title: Photovoltaic power generation support with angle adaptive adjustment function
abstract: The invention discloses a photovoltaic power generation support with an angle adaptive adjustment function, and belongs to the technical field of solar photovoltaic power generation. Comprising a support, a mounting frame and a photovoltaic panel, a rotating frame and a fixing rod are arranged at the top end of the support, and double-shaft adjustment is achieved through an electric scissor jack on the support frame and a turnover adjusting mechanism between a T-shaped adjusting frame and the mounting frame. Four groups of silicon photocells are arranged at the top end of the photovoltaic panel up, down, left and right to serve as photosensitive sensor assemblies, and after signals are transmitted to a controller, first and second servo motors (integrated speed reducers) are driven to control overturning and pitching actions respectively. During working, the silicon photocell collects light intensity difference in real time, the controller calculates solar azimuth deviation, the adjusting mechanism adjusts the pitch angle and the azimuth angle of the photovoltaic panel in a linkage mode, and a'detection-adjustment-feedback 'closed loop is formed. Through double-shaft self-adaptive adjustment, the light energy receiving efficiency is improved, and the silicon photocell array is high in anti-interference capacity, high in driving precision, compact in mechanical structure, low in cost and suitable for photovoltaic systems of different scales.

title: Perovskite solar cell and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a perovskite solar cell and a preparation method thereof, the perovskite solar cell comprises a hole transport layer, the material of the hole transport layer is selected from PTAA derivatives, and the structural formula of the PTAA derivatives is as shown in the formula (I); the perovskite solar cell provided by the invention has relatively high energy conversion efficiency and high thermocycling stability.

title: Green energy-saving building structure and construction method
abstract: The invention discloses a green energy-saving building structure and a construction method, and belongs to the technical field of energy-saving constructions.The green energy-saving building structure comprises two sets of frames, a distance increasing mechanism is hinged between the upper surfaces of the two sets of frames, and solar power generation panels are laid at the two ends of the upper surface of a roof and used when a brushing and sweeping mechanism needs electricity; the brushing and sweeping mechanism is rotationally installed in the rainwater collecting barrels and controlled by the controller, and the rainwater collecting barrels are fixedly installed at the two ends of the outer surface of the roof. Through the design of the brushing and sweeping mechanism and the distance increasing mechanism, the modular adjustable frame system, the intelligent rainwater collecting and processing system and the solar comprehensive utilization technology are organically combined, the limitation of a traditional building on space adaptability and resource utilization efficiency is broken through, dynamic expansion and contraction of the building space are achieved, and the space utilization efficiency of the building is improved. An efficient rainwater collection and treatment closed loop is constructed through cooperation of the four-stage conical filter disc and the intelligent brushing and sweeping mechanism, and the cyclic utilization rate of water resources is increased.

title: POM/PVDF (Polyoxymethylene/Polyvinylidene Fluoride) radiation refrigeration composite film based on electrostatic spinning method as well as preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of a POM/PVDF (Polyoxymethylene/Polyvinylidene Fluoride) radiation refrigeration composite film based on an electrostatic spinning method, and belongs to the field of radiation refrigeration materials. Polyvinylidene fluoride is used as a matrix, polyformaldehyde is used as a modification component, and PVDF/POM composite membranes with different proportions are prepared by an electrostatic spinning method, so that a composite membrane material with high solar reflectivity and infrared emissivity is constructed, and the microstructure stability and thermal properties of the composite membrane material are considered; the practical application value is expected to be achieved in the fields of passive cooling and heat management. A characterization technology is comprehensively tested, and the aspects of structure, thermal stability, photo-thermal performance and the like of composite films made of materials with different proportions are researched, so that the passive radiation cooling material with the most excellent performance is obtained. In the future, a fiber structure and a process can be optimized, and an evaporative cooling or phase change technology is combined, so that the practical application is realized, and help is provided for energy conservation and environment regulation and control.

title: Intelligent bus station
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of traffic facilities, and discloses an intelligent bus station which comprises a left side plate, a right side plate, a back plate arranged between the left side plate and the right side plate, and a ceiling arranged above the left side plate, the right side plate and the back plate. An electronic stop board is arranged on the left side plate; an LED display screen is arranged on the back plate; a solar panel is laid on the upper surface of the ceiling; a fan is mounted on the lower surface of the ceiling; a heater and a refrigerator are arranged in the fan; a storage battery is arranged in the back plate; the electric energy output end of the solar panel is connected with the storage battery; the storage battery is used for providing a power supply; ventilation openings are formed in the left side plate and the right side plate; a plurality of blades are vertically mounted in the ventilation openings; blade control mechanisms are installed on the upper side wall and the lower side wall of the ventilation opening. The station area environment structure can be automatically adjusted according to the air temperature environment, the waiting environment with the higher comfort level can be provided for passengers, and the experience feeling of citizens can be improved.

title: Passivation layer and preparation method thereof, solar cell and photovoltaic module
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a passivation layer and a preparation method thereof, a solar cell and a photovoltaic module, and belongs to the technical field of solar cells. The material of the passivation layer comprises a rubidium-containing inorganic compound, and the rubidium-containing inorganic compound comprises at least one of rubidium-containing halogen borate or rubidium-containing oxysalt. The passivation layer provided by the invention not only can passivate the interface defects on the perovskite absorption layer, but also can adjust the energy level barrier between the perovskite absorption layer and the electron transport layer, improve charge transport, improve the open-circuit voltage and fill factor of the solar cell device, and further improve the photoelectric conversion performance of the solar cell device.

title: SYSTEM AND PROCEDURE FOR OPTIMIZED CONSUMPTION OF ELECTRICAL ENERGY FROM AN INTERNET OF THINGS-BASED SOLAR POWER PLANT.
Vehicle-mounted unfoldable photovoltaic ceiling multifunctional system
abstract: The invention discloses a vehicle-mounted deployable photovoltaic ceiling multifunctional system, which comprises a vehicle-mounted photovoltaic system, a vehicle-mounted photovoltaic ceiling, a vehicle-mounted photovoltaic ceiling, a vehicle-mounted photovoltaic ceiling, a vehicle-mounted photovoltaic ceiling, a vehicle-mounted photovoltaic ceiling, a vehicle-mounted photovoltaic ceiling, a vehicle-mounted photovoltaic ceiling and a vehicle-mounted photovoltaic ceiling, the tent is mounted on the top of the automobile to provide a rest space; according to the vehicle-mounted sunshade system, an awning is installed on a vehicle-mounted photovoltaic system on the top of an automobile, and if the photovoltaic system is not needed, an independent sunshade function can be provided when a photovoltaic panel is taken down; and the lifting mechanism is mounted at the bottom of the vehicle-mounted photovoltaic system and drives the vehicle-mounted photovoltaic system and the tent to be quickly folded. According to the invention, efficient solar energy collection, sun shading, an intelligent expandable mechanism and multiple functions are integrated, so that the defects of a traditional fixed photovoltaic ceiling and an early expandable photovoltaic ceiling are overcome, efficient and practical application of solar energy in a vehicle-mounted scene is truly realized, and the energy self-sufficient capability and comprehensiveness of an automobile are improved.

title: Island multi-energy integrated light heat and power cogeneration system
abstract: The invention discloses an island multi-energy integrated light heat and power cogeneration system, relates to the technical field of new energy utilization, and solves the problem of electricity, heat and fresh water supply under the conditions that an island is relatively closed and resources are deficient by utilizing rich renewable energy sources of the island, so that energy waste is reduced to the maximum extent, and the utilization rate of clean energy is improved. The system comprises a multi-energy integrated power generation module, a water electrolysis hydrogen production module, a combined heat and power supply module based on hydrogen energy and a multi-stage flash evaporation seawater desalination module based on solar photo-thermal, and offshore wind energy, solar energy, wave energy and a fuel cell technology are fused to cope with energy challenges in island regions. By introducing a fuel cell, a heat pump technology and a multi-stage flash evaporation seawater desalination technology, not only can electric power be provided, but also heat energy for heating and fresh water can be produced, and meanwhile, the system has good performance in the aspect of quick response starting through utilization and redistribution of waste heat of the system.

title: Power grid monitoring system capable of monitoring solar power generation state in real time
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of power grid monitoring, in particular to a power grid monitoring system capable of monitoring the solar power generation state in real time. According to the system, a solar data acquisition unit is connected to the output ends of a solar photovoltaic module and an inverter and acquires solar power generation data in real time; the local edge calculation and preprocessing unit performs electric energy quality analysis on the acquired solar power generation data based on a method of converting a cross-correlation zero-lag point amplitude into a frequency difference amplification factor, identifies the power generation efficiency change, and performs logic judgment by using an embedded DTU (Data Transfer Unit); the energy management unit integrates the processed solar power generation data into a unified platform by using a semantic adaptive modeling gateway based on the existing PME system; and the state grid communication interface unit communicates with a state grid system by using an MQTT protocol. By collecting and analyzing solar power generation data in real time, the system can accurately calculate parameters such as active power and reactive power and perform electric energy quality analysis.

title: New energy self-power-generation window
abstract: The invention discloses a new energy self-power-generation window, relates to the technical field of new energy windows, and solves the technical problems of low light energy utilization rate and low function integration rate in an existing technical scheme. The new energy self-power-generation window comprises a window frame, an outer window body is rotatably mounted on the outer side of the upper end in the window frame, and louver boards are rotatably mounted in the outer window body; a louver board is arranged on the outer side of the window frame, a solar photovoltaic power generation film is arranged on the outer side of the louver board, a louver adjusting structure is arranged in the outer window body, an electric gauze curtain structure is arranged in the window frame, and an inner window body is rotationally installed on the inner side wall face of the window frame. The core contradiction between the power generation efficiency and the light transmission of a traditional photovoltaic window is solved. Through a shutter adjusting structure, light can be intelligently tracked according to the position of the sun, so that the photovoltaic film is always at the optimal light receiving angle, and the power generation efficiency is greatly improved.

title: Parking space management system in the form of speed bumps
abstract: The present invention relates to a parking space detection and management system, based on an intelligent device in the shape of a speed bump. This innovative system is designed to facilitate parking space management, by providing real-time information on space occupancy. The heart of the system is a self-contained, solar-powered detector, which is simply installed using bolts in the ground. This detector is equipped with sensors that identify the presence or absence of a vehicle in the parking space. The data collected is transmitted via a Wi-Fi connection to a microcontroller, which centralizes information on space occupancy. This intelligent, self-powered detection system enables 24/7 surveillance at low operating cost. Users can access real-time information on available spaces via a digital interface, facilitating the management and use of parking spaces. The system's simple installation and energy autonomy make it suitable for a wide range of applications, from public to private parking lots. This innovation contributes to optimizing the use of parking spaces, while offering an enhanced user experience.

title: Solar disc-type condensation system with low wind load and damping vibration attenuation
abstract: The invention discloses a low-wind-load and damping vibration attenuation solar disc-type condensation system which comprises a condenser, a double-shaft tracking device, a main beam, a liquid amount adjusting system, a plurality of steel cables and the like. The condenser is composed of a steel framework, a plurality of mirror surface units, a covering body, a plurality of liquid storage bags and the like, wherein the steel framework is composed of a plurality of radiation beams and cross rods which are arrayed circumferentially; the mirror surface units are fixed on the steel framework; the covering body wraps the steel framework on the back of the condenser to form a streamline aerodynamic shape so as to reduce wind load, and only the reflecting surface of the mirror surface unit bears wind pressure, so that the wind load is effectively reduced; the mirror surface unit adopts a light high-rigidity structure with a light supporting back frame and an embedded bearing framework, so that the deformation of a reflecting element under wind pressure is reduced; the double-shaft tracking device is installed on the back of the condenser and is close to a pneumatic center to reduce the wind moment load. The liquid level of the liquid storage bag and the liquid storage box which is installed on the main beam and can move is adjusted, self-adaptive liquid damping energy dissipation and vibration reduction of the light condensation system under the wind disturbance effect are achieved, and the service optical precision is improved.

title: Solar cell stability test system and method
abstract: The invention provides a solar cell stability test system and method, and belongs to the technical field of solar power generation. The system comprises a test box body; the cooling heat dissipation system and the semiconductor light source system are arranged in the test box body and are connected with the test box body; the tool platform is fixedly connected to the first outer surface of the test box body; the solar cell is placed in a top groove of the tool platform, and the light source system irradiates the solar cell through a through hole formed in the tool platform and the test box body; the temperature control system is located above the solar cell and embedded in a groove in the top of the tool platform; and the microcontroller is electrically connected with the cooling heat dissipation system, the light source system and the temperature control system respectively. According to the scheme, the solar cell stability test with wider light source coverage and high-precision temperature control can be realized, the energy utilization efficiency in the test is improved by using the semiconductor material to emit light, and the energy loss is reduced.

title: Silicate GO intercalation corrosion inhibitor for quaternary nitric acid molten salt as well as preparation and application of silicate GO intercalation corrosion inhibitor
abstract: The invention discloses a silicate GO intercalation corrosion inhibitor for quaternary molten nitrate and preparation and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of heat storage materials. In the silicate-GO intercalation corrosion inhibitor, GO layers are main body frames and are in a two-dimensional layer shape, layered silicate is inserted between the GO layers, and the orientation of the layered silicate is parallel to the orientation of the GO layers. The silicate-GO intercalation corrosion inhibitor is added into quaternary nitric acid molten salt, and the addition amount of the silicate-GO intercalation corrosion inhibitor is 0.4 wt%-5.0 wt%. The corrosion inhibitor with a two-dimensional intercalation composite structure is prepared by organizing silicate and alkylating GO, so that the stability and dispersity of the high-temperature quaternary nitric acid molten salt are promoted, the corrosion of the high-temperature quaternary nitric acid molten salt to a metal matrix in high-temperature energy systems such as concentrated solar power generation is slowed down, and the long-term stable operation of the high-temperature molten salt energy system is supported.

title: Electron transport layer and preparation method thereof, solar cell and preparation method thereof, and photovoltaic module
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides an electron transport layer and a preparation method thereof, a solar cell and a preparation method thereof, and a photovoltaic module, and belongs to the technical field of solar cells. A preparation method of an electron transport layer comprises the following steps: placing liquid gallium between an upper substrate and a lower substrate, keeping the temperature of the substrates at 100-200 DEG C, applying a uniaxial vertical pressure of 5kPa-400kPa to the two substrates to carry out extrusion so that the liquid gallium is spread between the upper substrate and the lower substrate, the gallium forms a gallium oxide film on the surface of the substrate through an in-situ oxidation reaction under the air condition, and the electron transport layer is obtained. High-temperature sintering or complex deposition equipment is not needed in the preparation process, the preparation process is simple, the energy consumption is low, the expandability is good, and the method is suitable for efficient preparation and large-scale production of large-area flexible electronic devices; the obtained electron transport layer can improve the electron transport capability, thereby improving the photoelectric conversion efficiency of the solar cell device.

title: Current multiplication type polycrystalline silicon light-emitting device
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of photoelectric sensing and optical communication, relates to a silicon-based light-emitting device, and particularly provides a current multiplication type polycrystalline silicon light-emitting device which is used for solving the problem that an existing silicon-based light-emitting device is low in light-emitting efficiency. The solar cell comprises a substrate layer, a polycrystalline silicon layer, a packaging layer, a metal positive electrode and a metal negative electrode, the polycrystalline silicon layer grows on the substrate layer, and a P1 region, an N1 region, an Nx region, a Px region, a P2 region and an N2 region which are sequentially arranged from left to right are formed through doping; on one hand, through structural optimization of the light-emitting device, on the basis of light emitting of a reverse biased diode, additional multiplication current is introduced, and the avalanche breakdown process of the light-emitting device is accelerated; on the other hand, the doping concentration gradient of the PN junction space charge region is optimized, so that the electric field forms an electric field peak in the space charge region, and the formation of high-energy carriers in the space charge region is facilitated; the two mechanisms finally enable the luminous efficiency of the device to be obviously improved.

title: Undervoltage protection method, undervoltage protection device and energy storage system
abstract: The invention discloses an under-voltage protection method, an under-voltage protection device and an energy storage system, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining the input voltage of a solar charging module and the SOC of a battery module in response to the access of the solar charging module to a solar panel, and determining a current working mode according to the SOC; under the condition that the current working mode is the learning mode, comparing the input voltage with an under-voltage protection threshold value corresponding to the learning mode in the current period; when the input voltage is greater than the under-voltage protection threshold, activating the energy storage system to enable the solar panel to charge the battery module through the solar charging module; acquiring all system output power, input power of a solar charging module and net consumption power of a battery management module in the current period; and setting an under-voltage protection threshold of the next period according to the input power, the system output power, the net consumption power and the input voltage. Therefore, the energy storage system can carry out self-learning and self-adaptive adjustment on the under-voltage protection threshold value, and it is guaranteed that the battery is not deeply discharged.

title: Outdoor multifunctional power transformation box
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of electrical equipment, and provides an outdoor multifunctional power transformation box which comprises a box body, and an electrical storage device and a solar energy conversion device are arranged in the box body. The solar conversion device comprises a rectangular lining frame, a side door mechanism which is arranged at the top of the lining frame and can be opened along two sides, and a middle door mechanism which is arranged in the middle of the lining frame and can extend upwards. By arranging the solar conversion device, the space at the top of the power transformation box can be effectively utilized, when photovoltaic power generation is used, the side top plates are unfolded towards the two sides, the middle top plate extends upwards, the effective area of the photovoltaic panel can be increased through the design, the photovoltaic panel can retract when not used, space is not occupied, and the photovoltaic power generation box is convenient to use. The electrical storage device can store the electric energy converted by the solar energy conversion device for people to use.

title: Solar panel vehicle-mounted charging device capable of being automatically folded
abstract: The invention discloses an automatic folding solar panel vehicle-mounted charging device, and relates to the field of electric vehicle energy supplement. In order to solve the problems that an existing charging pile depends on a fixed place, and a vehicle-mounted solar device is low in unfolding efficiency, poor in light following capacity, insufficient in energy storage inversion adaptability and poor in low-temperature practicability, the device comprises a vehicle roof supporting frame fixed to a vehicle roof, the vehicle roof supporting frame is connected with a rotatable lower supporting column and a rotatable upper supporting column, and the upper supporting column is connected with a charging supporting frame. A folding solar panel assembly is arranged on the solar panel assembly; the adjusting electric push rod is used for adjusting a pitch angle, the rotating assembly is used for adjusting a horizontal angle, the energy storage device comprises an energy storage battery and a 220V inverter with a direct-current boosting module, and the unified controller is provided with an illumination detection function. The controller carries out unfolding/light following according to the illumination control panel, realizes 220V slow charging and 400V fast charging, assists battery heat preservation at low temperature, and improves the energy supplement convenience and the long-endurance supporting capability.

title: Photovoltaic module
abstract: The utility model discloses a photovoltaic assembly. The photovoltaic module comprises a panel, a back plate, a battery piece layer and a first packaging adhesive film layer, the back plate and the panel are arranged in a stacked mode, the battery piece layer is located between the panel and the back plate, the first packaging adhesive film layer is located between the battery piece layer and the panel, a color layer is arranged between the panel and the first packaging adhesive film layer, the color layer is a light-transmitting layer, and the light-transmitting layer is located between the panel and the first packaging adhesive film layer. A concave-convex structure is arranged on the side, away from the first packaging adhesive film layer, of the panel. Therefore, the concave-convex structure can reduce the reflection of solar rays on the panel, thereby improving the incident quantity of the solar rays, increasing the generating capacity of solar energy and reducing the light pollution phenomenon of a building, and in addition, the color layer can increase the color brightness of the panel, thereby improving the aesthetic property of the photovoltaic module.

title: Integrated photovoltaic-thermal (PVT) hybrid solar module with solar collectors, heat exchangers and energy storage tank.
abstract: The present invention concerns an integrated photovoltaic-thermal (PVT) hybrid solar energy conversion system with solar collectors, heat exchangers and energy storage tank, capable of simultaneously producing electricity and heated water for storage or immediate use. More specifically, the invention proposes the use of alternative materials for the system components, such as the absorber, the heat exchanger within which a heat transfer fluid circulates, the hot water storage tank (drum), as well as for the heat transfer fluid used within the heat exchanger and the metal frame, with the aim of reducing manufacturing costs compared with solutions currently available on the market. This approach also aims to reduce the weight of the system, thus contributing to better overall economy.

title: Water electrolysis hydrogen production system based on solar energy
abstract: The invention relates to a water electrolysis hydrogen production system based on solar energy. Comprising a chimney, a heat collector, a generator set, a seawater pool, an electrolytic bath and a gas collection device, the heat collector is positioned between the bottom end of the chimney and the seawater pool, is communicated with the bottom end of the chimney and is used for absorbing solar radiation to heat air below the heat collector; the generator set is located at the bottom end in the chimney and used for converting air movement energy into electric energy. The seawater pool is located in the center position below the heat collector, and the electrolytic cell is located below the heat collector and surrounds the seawater pool. A plurality of electrolysis units are arranged in the electrolytic bath; the generator set is used for supplying power to the electrolysis unit; a water collecting structure is arranged on the inner wall of the heat collector and conveys collected fresh water to a water inlet of the electrolytic cell through a pipeline. The gas collecting device is used for collecting hydrogen and oxygen generated by electrolysis in the electrolytic cell, hydrogen production can be achieved through clean energy such as solar energy and seawater, extra power supply is not needed, and dependence on fresh water resources is not needed either.

title: Self-adaptive fractional order MPPT control method and device for perovskite solar cell
abstract: The invention discloses a self-adaptive fractional order MPPT control method and device for a perovskite solar cell. The method comprises the steps that the output current and the output voltage of PSCs are acquired; determining a target operation condition to which the PSCs belong and a corresponding fractional order parameter based on the output current and the output voltage; based on the target operation condition, determining a target disturbance step length function and a target disturbance switching frequency function corresponding to the PSCs; and determining an adaptive adjustment strategy corresponding to the PSCs based on the target disturbance step length function, the target disturbance switching frequency function and the fractional order parameter, and adjusting the PSCs based on the adaptive adjustment strategy. According to the invention, self-adaptive adjustment of the PSC is realized, the energy conversion efficiency of a photovoltaic system is improved, power oscillation and tracking errors caused by a hysteresis effect are reduced, additional material cost does not need to be increased, and an effective technical scheme is provided for low-cost, high-performance and large-scale industrial application of the perovskite solar cell.

title: Blade state monitoring device for wind driven generator and wind driven generator
abstract: The invention discloses a blade state monitoring device for a wind driven generator and the wind driven generator, and relates to the field of data monitoring, and the blade state monitoring device comprises a device integration multi-mode sensor module, a self-cleaning deicing module, a lightning stroke monitoring module, an edge calculation module, an anti-typhoon monitoring module, an energy supply module and a communication gateway module. Strain, vibration and temperature sensors are arranged at the root, the tip and the surface of the blade, and an icing detector is arranged at the front edge. And deicing is realized through hot air injection and the nano coating. And a lightning sensor and ultraviolet imaging are used for positioning lightning stroke. And an AI chip is arranged in the edge computing node to diagnose damage. The fiber grating sensor monitors typhoon strain. The solar film and the miniature wind driven generator supply power.
