And the communication module supports LoRaWAN and Beidou short messages. And the far-end intelligent diagnosis module predicts the service life through machine learning and provides maintenance suggestions. The system has the advantages that the blade state is accurately monitored in real time through the integrated multi-mode sensor and module technology, operation safety is guaranteed, the service life of equipment is prolonged, and efficient utilization of clean energy is facilitated.

title: Expressway energy storage and power supply separation zone device based on solar energy and wind energy
abstract: The utility model provides an expressway energy storage and power supply separation zone device based on solar energy and wind energy, which belongs to the technical field of expressway facilities and comprises a solar panel, a solar panel fixing and adjusting structure, a wind energy power generation structure, an arc-shaped supporting structure, a base and a battery charging device. The multiple arc-shaped supporting structures are vertically arranged on the base, the wind power generation structure is fixed to the base and arranged in arc-shaped openings of the arc-shaped supporting structures, the solar panel fixing and adjusting structure is arranged at the tops of the arc-shaped supporting structures, and the solar panel is arranged on the solar panel fixing and adjusting structure. The solar panel and the wind power generation structure are both connected with the battery charging device. When being used on the roadside of a medial strip or a tunnel entrance and exit, the electric energy can be provided, the planting of green plants can be reduced, the green plant pruning operation on an expressway can be avoided, the safety of operators can be protected to a certain extent, and the cost can be saved.

title: Small domestic sewage treatment and recycling device and method based on wind-solar coordination
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of sewage treatment, and discloses a small-sized domestic sewage treatment and recycling device and method based on wind-light collaboration, and the device comprises a sewage pool which sequentially comprises a primary sedimentation tank, a high-efficiency anaerobic reaction tank, a clarification tank and a biological filter in the water flow direction; a wind energy water elevator and a solar power generation assembly are installed above the biological filter, and a fan with the same height as the wind energy fan is installed on the side, close to the wind energy fan, of the solar power generation assembly. Solar energy is converted into electric energy, then the electric energy is converted into wind energy, the wind energy is converted into mechanical energy, and natural energy is adopted for continuously supplying oxygen and lifting water for the system; the wind-solar collaborative energy system ensures the dissolved oxygen concentration of the sewage treatment system, solves the drainage problem of the sewage treatment system, adopts the direct-current motor fan, has high efficiency and low noise compared with a traditional air blower for converting wind energy into electric energy, and can stably work under different weather conditions (such as starting the fan for compensation at low wind speed).

title: Hydrogen photoelectric multi-energy coupling lighting device and control method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a hydrogen photoelectric multi-energy coupling lighting device and a control method thereof, and solves the problems of insufficient endurance and low-temperature failure of a street lamp in cloudy and rainy days, the device comprises a control unit, the control unit is connected with an energy system and a lighting unit, the energy system comprises a fuel cell, a solar panel and an energy storage battery, the fuel cell is connected with a solid hydrogen storage tank, the fuel cell is connected with the energy storage cell through the control unit, the solar panel is respectively connected with the energy storage cell and the lighting unit through the control unit, the energy storage cell is connected with the lighting unit, the control unit is connected with an inductor, and the control unit controls the energy storage cell and the lighting unit according to the temperature. The illumination intensity and the electric quantity of the energy storage battery control the charging mode of the lighting unit. Through a three-level energy management optimization strategy and a solid hydrogen storage-built-in structure collaborative design, the hydrogen consumption is reduced, the service life of a fuel cell is prolonged, and the street lamp has the advantages of being not affected by weather, zero in emission and long in endurance.

title: PV - System For Solar Energy Generation With Rapid Shutdown Disconnecting Function Of PV String-Level
abstract: PV 스트링-레벨의 신속 차단 기능을 가진 태양광발전시스템에 관한 것이다. 태양전지로 DC전력을 발생하여 스트링 단위로 공급하는 태양전지모듈(10); 상기 태양전지모듈(10)의 DC전력을 상기 스트링 단위로 차단하는 RSD(200, Rapid Shutdown Disconnector); 상기 태양전지(10)의 DC전력을 상기 RSD(200)를 통해 수집 취합하는 접속반(300); 상기 접속반(300)의 DC전력을 AC전력으로 변환하는 인버터(400); 및 상기 인버터(400)의 AC전력을 수용가에 공급 관리하는 FPS(Fire Protection System) 에이전트(500);를 포함하고, 상기 RSD(200), 상기 접속반(300), 상기 인버터(400) 중 어느 하나는, 상기 태양전지(10)의 DC전력에 대한 PV 전압값, PV 전류값, PV 온도값 중 어느 하나를 획득하는 제 1단계; 상기 제 1단계의 PV 전압값, PV 전류값, PV 온도값을 각 1차 화재 감지용 제 1설정값과 비교하는 제 2단계; 상기 제 2단계에서, 상기 제 1단계의 PV 전압값, PV 전류값, PV 온도값이 상기 각 제 1설정값 이상인 경우, 1차 화재 감지로 판별하는 제 3단계; 및 상기 제 3단계의 1차 화재 감지에 해당하는 스트링을 상기 RSD(200)로 스트링 단위로 개별 차단하는 제 4단계;를 포함한다.

title: High-entropy multi-principal-element rare earth borate radiation refrigeration pigment and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to a high-entropy multi-principal-element rare earth borate radiation refrigeration pigment, the pigment is powder, the chemical general formula of the pigment is (A1xA2yA3zA4uA5v) BO3, A1, A2, A3, A4 and A5 are any five of La, Ce, Pr, Nd, Sm, Gd, Tb, Dy, Er, Yb and Lu, and x, y, z, u and v satisfy x + y + z + u + v = 1. Meanwhile, the invention also discloses a preparation method of the pigment. According to the invention, through a synergistic effect, the material has high reflection performance in a solar spectral region (0.3-2.5 [mu] m), shows efficient infrared emission performance in an atmospheric window wave band (8-13 [mu] m), can be widely applied to many fields, and especially has considerable application prospects in cooling and energy saving of outdoor buildings and equipment.

title: Protective structure of air conditioner outdoor unit
abstract: The utility model belongs to the technical field of air conditioner outdoor units, particularly relates to a protective structure of an air conditioner outdoor unit, and aims to solve the problems that the air conditioner outdoor unit is exposed outdoors for a long time, is easy to be eroded by rain and snow and damaged by falling objects, and is not favorable for prolonging the service life of the air conditioner outdoor unit. A grille door is rotationally installed at the front end of the grille frame through a plurality of hinges, the grille door and the grille frame are fixed through two first bolts, and a baffle is obliquely arranged at the top of the grille frame. When the air conditioner outdoor unit is used, rain and snow erosion and falling object collision damage are effectively prevented through the design of the grating frame and the baffle, the service life of the air conditioner outdoor unit is prolonged, the height of the baffle can be adjusted according to air conditioner outdoor units of different heights through the design of the adjusting assembly, and the practicability is high. And the solar power generation panel is introduced, so that the protection structure can generate power by utilizing solar energy, and sustainable utilization, energy conservation and emission reduction of energy sources are realized.

title: Surveillance camera with solar energy storage system
abstract: The utility model relates to a monitoring camera with a solar energy storage system, which comprises a solar energy storage system and a camera body, and the solar energy storage system comprises a solar panel, a solar energy controller, a standby power supply and a plurality of battery modules. The solar controller is provided with a solar panel interface, a camera body interface, a standby power supply interface and a battery module interface, and the solar panel, the camera body, the standby power supply and the battery module are electrically connected with the solar panel interface, the camera body interface, the standby power supply interface and the battery module interface respectively. The solar panel inputs electric energy to the solar storage system, and the solar controller is used for managing the electric energy. The battery modules are systematically managed through the solar controller, even if a single battery module breaks down, other battery modules can still work normally, and the reliability is improved. And a standby power supply is arranged, so that the influence of weather is avoided.

title: Flexible ammonia synthesis system capacity configuration optimization method based on wind-solar combined power generation
abstract: The invention discloses a flexible ammonia synthesis system capacity configuration optimization method based on wind-solar combined power generation. Comprising the following steps: constructing a wind-solar hydrogen production coupling ammonia synthesis system; determining flexible boundary parameters of modules for producing hydrogen by electrolyzing water, synthesizing ammonia and the like; building an energy mass flow model of the flexible system under variable working conditions by utilizing dynamic analogue simulation of coupling of water electrolysis hydrogen production and ammonia synthesis; and by taking the minimum leveling production cost as a target parameter, constructing a wind-solar hydrogen production coupling ammonia synthesis system capacity configuration optimization model, and solving a target function to obtain wind-solar installed capacity, energy storage, the scale of hydrogen storage equipment, rated power of an electrolytic bath and ammonia synthesis equipment, and the optimal leveling production cost of ammonia. The universal capacity configuration optimization method of the green ammonia synthesis system for the flexible process is realized, the leveling production cost of the green ammonia is reduced, and the method is suitable for guiding the construction, popularization and application of an actual industrial green ammonia synthesis system.

title: Dual-configuration grid-connectable renewable energy power plant delivering high capacity factors to controllable loads
abstract: A renewable energy power system with a dual configurable architecture is described. The system includes a renewable energy source (RES), an energy storage system (ESS), and at least one controllable load (CL) (e.g., an AI training/data center). The system can be used as a base-load or half-base-load power plant for CL (s) and/or as a peak-shaving or half-peak-shaving power plant for an electrical grid, or vice versa, and optionally in parallel, and can also provide auxiliary services for the electrical grid and/or for CL (s). In certain embodiments, e.g., solar photovoltaic (PV) RES (s), the system can have a capacity factor of at least about 60% and up to 100% compared to known CL-free systems, higher asset utilization, better economic benefits of RES-ESS, improved system performance, and lower energy costs. By varying the load and making it part of the system, complex resource allocation policies, including the AI algorithm, can be developed, which are previously impossible in known CL-free systems.

title: Desert intelligent water taking ecological restoration and comprehensive security system
abstract: The invention discloses a desert intelligent water taking ecological restoration and comprehensive security system, and belongs to the technical field of desert ecological restoration and comprehensive protection, the system comprises an energy supply subsystem, an air water taking subsystem, an intelligent irrigation subsystem, a comprehensive protection subsystem and a central control subsystem, the subsystems are interconnected through pipelines, circuits and communication lines, and core components are all installed on a support. The energy supply subsystem adopts wind-solar complementary power supply and is provided with a comprehensive controller and a storage battery to realize stable energy storage; the air water taking subsystem is used for efficiently taking water through three-stage precooling and compression condensation; the intelligent irrigation subsystem realizes vegetation irrigation and emergency drinking water quality-divided supply; the comprehensive protection subsystem comprises a camera and an emergency operation unit, and monitoring and personnel safety are guaranteed; the central control subsystem (Internet of Things) realizes intelligent linkage of the subsystems. The system can autonomously supply energy and water, is high in function integration level and strong in extreme environment resistance, can meet the requirements of desert ecological restoration and comprehensive security and protection, and reduces the operation and maintenance cost.

title: Multivariable feedback adjusting method and device based on clothes hanger and clothes hanger
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of smart home, in particular to a multivariable feedback adjustment method and device based on a clothes hanger and the clothes hanger, and the method comprises the steps: dynamically adjusting the distance between the clothes hangers and the inclination angle of the clothes by obtaining the real-time solar illumination intensity, azimuth angle, elevation angle and clothes moisture content change rate. Firstly, front and rear row positions of a clothes hanger array are determined according to a solar azimuth angle; and based on the solar altitude, the height of the front-row clothes hanger and a preset shadow shielding rate threshold, calculating a target distance between the front-row clothes hanger and the rear-row clothes hanger. Meanwhile, combining the illumination intensity and a preset illumination energy threshold value to determine a target inclination angle between the solar rays and the surface of the clothes; in the adjusting process, the change rate of the moisture content of the clothes is monitored in real time, if the change rate is lower than a preset threshold value, the target distance and the inclination angle are dynamically corrected, and it is ensured that the clothes are evenly illuminated and the airing efficiency is maximized.

title: Dual-source heat pump system based on PV/T
abstract: The invention provides a dual-source heat pump system based on PV/T, and relates to the technical field of solar energy comprehensive utilization and building energy saving. The system comprises a PV/T module, a heat pump module, a heat exchange module, a pipeline switching device, a control module and a user unit, the PV/T module comprises a solar PV/T heat collector and a heat storage device which are connected, and the heat storage device is connected with the user unit through the pipeline switching device; the heat pump module is connected into the pipeline switching device and connected with the user unit and comprises an air source heat pump unit and a ground source heat pump unit which are connected in parallel. The plate heat exchanger is arranged on an air side inlet path of the air source heat pump unit; and the control module controls the pipeline switching device to act based on the environment signal, so that the system realizes switching between a heating working mode and a refrigerating working mode. According to the system, cascade efficient utilization of solar energy is achieved, the operation efficiency and stability of the heat pump are improved through switching of multiple refrigeration and heating modes, and the energy utilization efficiency is improved.

title: Dual-emission carbon dot nano-enzyme, preparation method thereof and application of dual-emission carbon dot nano-enzyme in enhancing photosynthesis and salt stress resistance of crops
abstract: The invention discloses a dual-emission carbon dot nano-enzyme, a preparation method thereof and application of the dual-emission carbon dot nano-enzyme in enhancing photosynthesis and salt stress resistance of crops, and relates to the field of nano-material technologies and agricultural engineering.The dual-emission carbon dot nano-enzyme is prepared by taking glutathione and formamide as precursors through ultrasonic treatment, microwave heating, purification and drying; the double-emission carbon dots have emission in blue light and red light ranges, are well overlapped with chloroplast absorption, and can be used as a light converter to promote photosynthesis of crops, improve the utilization rate of solar energy and enhance photosynthesis of crops; in addition, the compound has excellent SOD-like activity, and can improve germination of crop seeds and growth of seedlings under salt stress.

title: Ground source heat pump and solar energy coupled heating system
abstract: The invention discloses a ground source heat pump and solar energy coupled heating system, and relates to the technical field of heating. Comprising a solar heat collection module, a ground source heat pump module, a heat storage module, a building terminal module and an intelligent control module. The solar heat collection module is connected with the heat storage module, the source heat pump module and the building terminal module and used for achieving solar heat storage, solar auxiliary ground source heat pump heat taking and direct building heat supply. The ground source heat pump module is connected with the building terminal module, so that a ground source heat pump supplies cold and heat to a building; the heat storage module is connected with the building terminal module, so that the heat storage device supplies heat to the building; the intelligent control module is connected with the solar heat collection module, the ground source heat pump module, the heat storage module and the building terminal module, so that start-stop control over solar heat collection circulation, regulation and control over a ground source heat pump unit and ground source side circulation, regulation and control over heat storage and release of the heat storage module and regulation of building terminal heat supply loads are achieved.

title: Solar engineering water tank based on Wi-Fi Internet of Things technology
abstract: The utility model relates to the field of solar energy engineering, and discloses a solar energy engineering water tank based on Wi-Fi Internet of Things technology, comprising a tank body, the top of the tank body is fixedly connected with a motor, the output end of the motor is fixedly provided with a third threaded rod, the outer surface of the third threaded rod is rotatably connected with a first connecting pipe, and the first connecting pipe is connected with a second connecting pipe. And the outer surface of the third threaded rod is in threaded connection with a second connecting pipe, the top of the inner wall of the second connecting pipe is rotationally connected with a second threaded rod, and the outer surface of the second threaded rod is in threaded connection with a third connecting pipe. The motor is arranged at the top of the water tank, the brush heads are arranged at the bottom of the motor, the brush heads are connected through the connecting blocks and the telescopic rods, under the action of the motor, the connecting blocks rotate so as to drive the four brush heads to rotate, and the four brush heads and the telescopic rods can expand outwards due to centrifugal force. The inner wall of the tank body is cleaned while rotating, and the problem that the interior of the water tank is difficult to clean in time is solved.

title: Ecological interaction type park landscape system based on nannococcus miniature water ecosystem
abstract: The utility model discloses an ecological interaction type park landscape system based on a nannococcus miniature water ecosystem, relates to park landscapes, and aims at solving the technical problem that an existing intelligent park is poor in interaction function. The park landscape system comprises a pool, a dot matrix light source, an energy storage battery, a motion power generation facility, a solar panel, a photosynthesis monitor and a controller. Chlorella is put into the water pool; the lattice light source is laid at the bottom of the pool. The solar panel and the motion power generation facility are connected with the energy storage battery. The energy storage battery is connected with the dot matrix light source; the photosynthesis monitor is arranged above the water tank; monitoring the growth state of chlorella in the water tank and transmitting the growth state to the controller; and the controller is also connected with the dot matrix light source to control the illumination mode and illumination intensity of each light source point in the dot matrix light source. A participant claims chlorella in the interactive pool by scanning an interactive applet on the controller through a mobile phone and sends out a control instruction to participate in landscape formation in the pool, and the system can be used in the field of urban parks.

title: Solar display screen
abstract: The utility model relates to the field of display, in particular to a solar display screen, which comprises a display layer, an active element array layer, a thin film transistor (TFT) glass substrate, an energy storage battery and a solar battery, the display layer, the active element array layer, the TFT glass substrate, the energy storage battery and the solar battery are arranged in sequence; the solar cell comprises a thermoelectric conversion film and a solar cell module. The solar battery module is connected with the thermoelectric conversion film and the energy storage battery; through the arrangement of the thermoelectric conversion film, a new energy conversion mode can be provided on the basis of an existing solar display screen, the problem that the light utilization rate of solar energy at present can only reach 30%-50% is effectively solved, and the problem that the temperature of the display screen is high possibly when the environment is too hot or energy consumption is too high is solved. Therefore, the service life of the outdoor display screen is prolonged.

title: Bay-position naphthalene ring-containing cathode interface layer material and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a bay-site naphthalene ring-containing cathode interface layer material and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the field of organic solar cell preparation, the molecular formula of the bay-site naphthalene ring-containing cathode interface layer material is shown in the specification, the obtained cathode interface layer is simple and convenient in synthesis path and low in cost, and the prepared cell has good stability; compared with other cathode interface layers, the cathode interface layer material obtained by the invention has good film-forming property, can effectively reduce the energy barrier between the active layer and the interface layer, is better in contact with the active interface, and has the performance advantages of high battery efficiency, high filling and high current; meanwhile, a large-plane naphthalene ring has large steric hindrance and excellent conductivity, so that over-close packing of a core framework can be inhibited, and the molecular packing state can be regulated and controlled.

title: Hole transport layer and preparation method thereof, solar cell and photovoltaic module
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a hole transport layer and a preparation method thereof, a solar cell and a photovoltaic module, and belongs to the technical field of solar cells. The preparation method of the hole transport layer comprises the steps that in an oxygen-containing environment, tellurium in a molten state is placed on the surface of a substrate to do relative motion and is attached to the surface of the substrate, the tellurium forms a tellurium oxide film on the surface of the substrate through an in-situ oxidation reaction, and the hole transport layer is obtained. According to the preparation method of the hole transport layer, high-temperature sintering or complex deposition equipment is not needed, energy consumption is low, repeatability is good, complex equipment is not needed, expandability is good, the preparation method is suitable for large-area thin film continuous production, the obtained tellurium oxide film has high hole mobility, photo-generated holes can be extracted and transmitted more efficiently, and the hole transport layer is suitable for large-area thin film continuous production. The interface recombination loss is reduced, the hole transmission capability of the hole transmission layer can be obviously improved, and the photoelectric conversion efficiency of the solar cell is improved.

title: Lunar brick making base based on lunar soil and lunar soil brick in-situ detection method
abstract: The invention relates to a lunar soil-based lunar brick making base and a lunar soil brick in-situ detection method. The lunar soil-based lunar brick making base is characterized in that an electric heating crucible and at least two sets of molds are conveyed to the moon by using a space shuttle; collecting lunar soil and conveying the lunar soil into a crucible by a lunar vehicle which already executes a task on the moon; the electric energy of the crucible is converted from solar energy, and the lunar soil in the crucible is melted by heating through the electric energy to form lunar soil slurry; pouring the molten lunar soil slurry into at least two sets of molds by the lunar rover, and cooling the lunar soil slurry in the molds to form lunar soil bricks; one part of lunar soil bricks are transported back to the earth for testing, and the other part of lunar soil bricks are left in the moon for environment testing; the brick making base comprises a lunar vehicle used for collecting and transporting lunar soil, a melting part and a maintaining and pouring part. The method has the advantages that an in-situ detection method of the lunar soil brick is provided, the lunar soil brick is manufactured in a real lunar environment and is subjected to environmental test, and real performance data of the lunar soil brick is obtained; meanwhile, a feasible scheme is provided for building a brick making base on the moon.

title: Solar charging device for swimming pool robot and charging control method
abstract: The invention discloses a solar charging device and charging control method for a swimming pool robot, and the method comprises the steps: judging whether the swimming pool robot meets a solar charging condition or not according to the current working state and working environment of the swimming pool robot, and obtaining a first judgment result; and when the first judgment result is yes, the angle of the photovoltaic panel is adjusted according to the current illumination angle, so that the photovoltaic panel directly faces the sun. The embodiment of the invention provides a solar charging control method for a swimming pool robot. Solar charging conditions are set based on the current working state and working environment of the swimming pool robot. When the solar charging condition is met, the solar charging function of the swimming pool robot is started, the angle of a photovoltaic panel above the swimming pool robot is adjusted to be right opposite to the sun, and therefore maximum-efficiency solar charging energy supplement is achieved.

title: Self Contained Energy and Facilities Centre
abstract: Abstract The invention proposes a self-contained energy and facility, which includes a modified shipping container equipped with renewable energy generation such as wind turbines and solar panels and uninterrupted power supply, and the modified container also equipped with wireless communication system for remote monitoring and communications, and outfitted with a functional electric kitchen, facilitating cooking and food preparation, contains toilet(s) that may utilise macerators and eco-friendly sewerage treatment systems and is attached with a water generator, tapping into atmospheric humidity and a water desalination and/or filtration system to produce clean drinking water.to produce clean drinking water. title: SOLAR MODULE MANUFACTURING DEVICE AND SOLAR MODULE MANUFACTURING METHOD
abstract: Disclosed in one embodiment of the present invention is a solar module manufacturing device comprising: a base plate having at least one preliminary solar module arranged thereon; a temperature control unit which is arranged to face one surface of the base plate, and which controls the temperature of the solar module; and an energy application control unit which is arranged to face the solar module, and which controls energy applied to the preliminary solar module.

title: MODULAR SOLAR POWER AND ENERGY STORAGE SYSTEMS AND METHODS
abstract: A power generation device is provided. The power generating device includes a photovoltaic panel configured to generate a first type of electrical power, a power converter electrically coupled to the photovoltaic panel and configured to convert the first type of electrical power to a second type of electrical power for transmission to a grid and/or load, and at least one energy storage device electrically coupled to the power converter, the at least one energy storage device configured to store electrical energy provided by the power converter. The power generating device further includes at least one heat management component and at least one back housing physically attached to the photovoltaic panel and defining a space between the photovoltaic panel and the at least one back housing. The power converter, the at least one energy storage device, and the at least one heat management component are positioned in the space.

title: DRONE DEPLOYABLE MODULAR SYSTEM FOR REMOTE SOLAR ENERGY GENERATION
abstract: A drone deployable modular system for remote solar energy generation utilizes remote-controlled multi-rotor drones configured to deliver and maintain modular heliostat units for assembly into heliostat fields in remote locations. The drone deployable modular heliostat unit may include a frame that supports at least one deployable, mirrored surface controlled by a heliostat driver. In one embodiment, the deployable, mirrored surface is a Mylar film tensioned over a mirror frame portion supported and controlled by the heliostat driver to orient a working face of the mirrored surface in various positions. The drone deployable modular heliostat unit may include a deployable stand arrangement and/or an anchor system. The modular heliostat units May be configured to be deployed in heliostat fields in a generally peripheral arrangement to provide reflected solar energy to a centrally located concentrating solar collector/energy utilization system.

title: MODULAR AGRICULTURAL FENCE WITH SOLAR ZONES AND ENVIRONMENTAL CONTROL FEATURES
abstract: The invention relates to a fence (1) for protecting a planted area, comprising a plurality of glass elements (2) supported by vertical posts (3) mounted in or on an underlayer (4). Each glass element (2) includes one or more zones (5) that reduce sunlight permeability, each zone (5) comprising one or more bifacial solar cells. The total sunlight permeability through each glass element is within the range of 5-45%, enabling light transmission suitable for plant growth while generating solar energy. The fence may serve as a wind barrier and is optionally configured to attenuate noise using laminated glass, gas-filled cavities, or varying pane thicknesses. It may also supply power to agricultural systems such as irrigation or environmental sensors. The fence can include features such as non-vertical mounting, orientation-based zone distribution, and modular, replaceable panels tailored to crop type or seasonal conditions.

title: NEGATIVE PRESSURE SUCTION-BASED FIXING DEVICE
abstract: A negative pressure suction-based fixing device. The negative pressure suction-based fixing device comprises a housing (10), a holding member (20), a negative pressure forming assembly (30), a solar panel (40), and a battery. An accommodating cavity (11) is provided inside the housing (10); the holding member (20) is configured to be suctioned on a suction surface; the end of the holding member (20) away from the housing (10) is provided with a suction cavity (21), and the suction cavity (21) is in communication with the accommodating cavity (11); the suction cavity (21) is used to cooperate with the suction surface to form a closed space; the negative pressure forming assembly (30) is used for generating a negative pressure in the accommodating cavity (11), so that a negative pressure is formed in a closed space; the solar panel (40) is mounted on the housing (10), the solar panel (40) is provided with a light absorbing surface (41), at least part of the light absorbing surface (41) is exposed out of the housing (10), and the solar panel (40) is used for converting solar energy into electric energy; and the battery is used for supplying power to the negative pressure forming assembly (30), and the battery can store electric energy obtained by conversion by the solar panel (40). In the negative pressure suction-based fixing device, power can be continuously supplied to the battery by means of the solar panel (40), thereby alleviating the problem of insufficient battery life of the negative pressure suction-based fixing device.

title: A SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR SOLAR IRRADIANCE MONITORING IN WEATHER MONITORING SYSTEMS
abstract: The present invention relates to a system and method for solar irradiance monitoring in weather monitoring systems (WMS) comprises a data collection module (21), a data filtration module (22), and an alert generation module (23); thereby ensures optimal solar energy generation by improving the precision of solar irradiance measurements, incorporate advanced machine learning techniques and a sophisticated clear sunny period to address the challenges associated with weather data accuracy and anomaly detection in solar energy, enhances the accuracy and reliability of solar irradiance monitoring, results in a significant impact on the solar energy industry by minimizing energy inefficiencies, reducing financial losses, and contributing to a more sustainable and efficient energy generation process.

title: THIN-FILM BACK CONTACTS FOR PHOTOVOLTAIC DEVICES AND METHODS FOR FORMING THE SAME
abstract: Photovoltaic devices having metal telluride back contact layers and methods for forming group-V doped metal telluride back contact layers for use in photovoltaic devices are described, wherein the doped metal telluride (170) is sputter-deposited directly on the absorber (160) of the solar cell, and consists in a doped seed layer deposited with a lower sputtering energy and a bulk layer deposited with a higher sputtering energy, and/or using sputtering targets presenting a metal-rich stoichiometry in order to improve the group V dopant incorporation and activation.

title: STRUCTURAL ARRANGEMENT APPLIED TO A MULTIFUNCTIONAL STRUCTURE FOR CONVERTING WIND, SOLAR AND TIDAL ENERGY INTO ELECTRICITY
abstract: The present application for a utility model relates to a product pertaining to the renewable energy sector, and more particularly to a product which is useful in installations in marine and coastal environments, where conditions are conducive to the simultaneous exploitation of wind, solar and tidal energy. The application provides a multifunctional structure (1) intended for generating electricity, comprising an integrated set of aerodynamic blades (2) provided with photovoltaic solar panels (5) and an inverted and submerged tidal turbine (6), the configuration of which allows the simultaneous and optimized capture of wind, solar and tidal energy, thereby increasing energy efficiency and continuous energy production capacity. Integration of the three energy sources into a single structure reduces the need for multiple installations, maximizes the use of available space and minimizes the environmental impacts associated with the construction and operation of separate energy infrastructures.

title: OUTDOOR OPTICAL STORAGE AND CHARGING DEVICE
abstract: The present invention discloses an outdoor light storage and charging device, which comprises a bottom plate, a charging pile, an adjusting frame, a mounting frame and a photovoltaic panel, wherein the charging pile is fixedly mounted on the front side of the top of the bottom plate. By providing the flushing pipe and the flushing hole, the water supply mechanism conveys water to the flushing pipe, and the water is sprayed out from the flushing holes distributed at equal intervals from the surface of the flushing pipe to flush the top of the photovoltaic panel, thereby greatly improving the cleaning efficiency. In the large charging station, the cleaning time can be greatly shortened, the reduction of the power generation efficiency of the photovoltaic panel caused by cleaning is reduced, the energy supply of the charging station is guaranteed, the automatic cleaning structure is not arranged, in the large charging station, the number of solar panels is large, the consumed time of cleaning one solar panel is long, and the overall cleaning work consumes a large amount of time.

title: SOLAR ENERGY DISPOSITION
CONDUCTIVE LINE, TRANSFER DEVICE, AND SPACE SOLAR BEAM ENERGY TRANSPORTATION METHOD
abstract: The problem is to prevent laser leakage to the ground during power and energy transmission from space to the ground for applications such as space solar power generation SSPS. In addition, when carbon and organic materials, which are lighter than copper, are used as conductors for driving spacecraft, plants, structures, and aircraft, such as SSPS, and for power transmission, there is a problem that charge carriers and charge carriers are scarce. SOLUTION: This application proposes a system consisting of a photon emitter (1) and receiver (2) that uses short-wavelength photons such as UV-C, which are absorbed by molecular atoms in the atmosphere, including oxygen, between space and air during power and energy transmission. For said conductors, we propose a conductor, electrode, and battery that applies the carrier injection and introduction method of the electric double layer transistor. We also propose ideas for induction, discharge, short circuit, and breakdown of positive and negative charges stored in the atmosphere using said light emitting part 1 and said conductors.

title: A renewable energy generation module
abstract: A renewable energy generation module 1 for use in a body of water comprises a plurality of floatation devices 3 supported by and located outside of a structural frame 2 to maintain an upper portion of the module above the surface of the body of water, a wave energy generation device 5 located centrally within the structural frame, and a renewable energy generation device receiving platform 6 located on an upper end 7 of the structural frame. The wave energy generation device may comprise an oscillating water column 51 having a wind turbine (54, fig 4). A plurality of solar panels 8 or wind turbines may be mounted on the platform. A renewable energy generation system comprises a plurality of renewable energy generation modules, each connected to adjacent modules, and a tidal wave energy generation device (101, fig 7) suspended between the plurality of modules.

title: SOLAR ENERGY DISPOSITION
SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR A SELF-SUSTAINING GRAPHITE FUEL MECHANISM
abstract: The present invention discloses a self-sustainable graphite fuel system (100) for continuous electricity generation using hydrogen and oxygen gases produced via solar-powered electrolysis. The system comprises a fuel cell (102) with aluminum-doped graphite anodes (104, 106) and a cathode (108), an electrolyzer (200) powered by a solar panel (210), and storage tanks for hydrogen (300) and oxygen (400). During operation, solar energy splits water in the electrolyzer, generating hydrogen and oxygen gases, which fuel the electrochemical reaction in the fuel cell, producing electricity and water. Excess gases are stored for energy generation in the absence of sunlight. The aluminum doping enhances catalytic efficiency, increasing charge storage and reaction speed. The system offers high energy efficiency (87%), eco-friendliness, and cost-effectiveness, making it suitable for applications like solar energy storage, fuel cells for electric vehicles, and industrial heating. The invention ensures continuous, renewable, and sustainable power generation.

title: Benzodithiophene-containing polymer and application thereof in solar cell
abstract: The invention discloses a benzodithiophene-containing polymer and an application thereof in a solar cell, the polymer has a structure as shown in a general formula (I), a benzodithiophene unit is selected as an electron donating unit, and two electron withdrawing units with different structures are matched, so that the benzodithiophene-containing polymer is obtained. On one hand, the energy level of the polymer can be adjusted by adjusting the proportion of the two electron withdrawing units; and on the other hand, the polymer is a ternary random polymer, and more excellent molecular crystallinity and pi-pi stacking are realized by adjusting the proportion of repetitive units, so that dissociation and transmission of machines are promoted, and more excellent photoelectric properties are realized.

title: Solar cell, preparation method thereof and photovoltaic module
abstract: The invention discloses a solar cell and a preparation method thereof, and a photovoltaic module, and the solar cell comprises a silicon substrate which is provided with a graphical region and a non-graphical region; the passivation contact structure comprises a dielectric layer and a doped layer which are sequentially laminated on the surface of the silicon substrate, and the doped layer comprises a first doped polycrystalline silicon layer, a silicon oxynitride layer and a second doped polycrystalline silicon layer which are sequentially laminated on the surface of the dielectric layer; wherein the second doped polycrystalline silicon layer is a graphical film layer, the second doped polycrystalline silicon layer is located in a graphical area, and the surface doping concentration of doping elements in the second doped polycrystalline silicon layer is larger than that of doping elements in the first doped polycrystalline silicon layer; the electrode is arranged on the second doped polycrystalline silicon layer; the graphical area corresponds to a setting area of the electrode, and the non-graphical area is an area outside the graphical area. According to the invention, the contact resistance between the second doped polycrystalline silicon layer and the electrode is effectively reduced, and the energy conversion efficiency of the solar cell is improved.

title: Garden tree whitewashing equipment
abstract: The utility model discloses a garden tree whitewashing device, which relates to the field of garden maintenance equipment and comprises a base, a paint storage box, a spraying component, a photovoltaic component and a control unit, equipment wheels are arranged at the bottom of the base, the paint storage box is mounted at the top of the base, and the spraying component, the photovoltaic component and the control unit are mounted on a front panel at the front end of the base. One side of the control unit is connected with the power supply device, the photovoltaic assembly is electrically connected with the power supply device, and the spraying assembly comprises a mechanical arm and a spraying head and can be adjusted in multiple directions to adapt to different trees; the photovoltaic module can convert solar energy and store the solar energy in the power supply device to realize autonomous power supply. The equipment can automatically convey a whitewashing agent and uniformly spray the whitewashing agent, solves the problems of inconvenient power supply and non-uniform whitewashing of traditional equipment, improves the operation efficiency and environmental adaptability, and is suitable for whitewashing operation of various garden trees.

title: Perovskite film for automobile glass piece
abstract: The utility model belongs to the technical field of automobile parts, and relates to an automobile glass piece perovskite film, which comprises a film body, the film body comprises a surface layer, a functional layer and an attaching layer which are sequentially arranged, the surface layer is positioned on the outermost layer of the film body, and the attaching layer is adhered on the surface of an automobile glass piece; the functional layer comprises a semitransparent solar soft film layer used for converting light energy into electric energy, the semitransparent solar soft film layer comprises a plurality of flexible perovskite solar cell films, and the perovskite solar cell films are electrically connected in series and/or in parallel and are electrically connected with an automobile circuit and an electric power storage system through electrodes. The film can enrich the energy complementing ways of equipment, and does not depend on traditional battery power supply any more; meanwhile, heat energy and light energy can be effectively utilized, and even if the automobile is in a driving state, the film of the automobile glass piece can still be used for blocking and preventing strong light irradiation, weakening strong light, reducing light and heat entering a cab, reducing driving potential safety hazards and protecting the personal safety of a driver.

title: Photovoltaic pantile and power generation roof structure
abstract: The utility model provides a photovoltaic pantile and a power generation roof structure, and particularly relates to the technical field of buildings. The photovoltaic pantile comprises a tile body, a water retaining piece and a photovoltaic assembly. Wherein the tile body is a curved surface arranged in a wave shape. The water retaining piece is arranged on the upper surface of the curved surface in a protruding mode along the wavy curved surface of the tile body, the water retaining piece is located on one side of the tile body in the width direction, and the length size of the water retaining piece is the same as that of the tile body. And the photovoltaic module is positioned on the photovoltaic pantile. The photovoltaic pantile is arranged to be of a wavy curved surface structure, so that adjacent photovoltaic pantiles can stop water through the water stop piece after being in lap joint, and a building is protected from being damaged by rainwater. According to the photovoltaic pantile, the photovoltaic assemblies and the photovoltaic pantile are combined, the solar energy collecting area of the photovoltaic pantile is increased, the appearance adaptability is improved, the arrangement mode of the photovoltaic assemblies is matched with the photovoltaic pantile, and the power generation efficiency of the single photovoltaic pantile and the solar energy conversion efficiency can be improved.

title: Multi-source matrix-based building group sunny and sunny side cooperative power generation control method and system
abstract: The invention discloses a multi-source matrix-based building group sunny and sunny surface cooperative power generation control method and system, and the method comprises the steps: firstly collecting the illumination intensity, wind speed and other environmental data of a building group, building a database, and initializing photovoltaic, wind power and energy storage modules and optimization algorithm parameters; a bionic honeycomb photovoltaic thermoelectric composite structure is adopted on the sunny side, and a photoelectric and thermoelectric conversion model is established; a wind energy capture model is constructed on the dark side by using a shape memory alloy diversion trench and a piezoelectric vibrator structure; the energy storage unit establishes a charge-discharge and heat storage and release model based on the microcapsule phase change material three-dimensional network; all the module models are integrated through a multi-source capture matrix center, photovoltaic output prediction and wind power fluctuation data are combined, an LM algorithm is adopted for collaborative optimization, wind-solar-storage collaboration and building load requirements are used as targets to iteratively update parameters, and an optimal energy distribution strategy is output; according to the invention, through real-time monitoring and closed-loop optimization, the dynamic response capability and the operation stability in extreme weather are significantly improved.

title: Solar electric valve control system and method
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of electric valves, in particular to a solar electric valve control system and method.The solar electric valve control system comprises an outer shell, a solar panel is connected to one side of the front face of the outer shell, a controller and a battery pack are installed in the outer shell, and an output wire harness extending out from inside to outside is arranged on the outer shell; the output wire harness is electrically connected to the electric valve, the lower side of the outer shell is connected with a supporting column supported on the ground, the supporting column is a hollow column, the output wire harness enters the supporting column, the side wall, close to the bottom, of the supporting column is provided with a bottom output port for the output wire harness to stretch out, and the solar panel is used for charging the battery pack. The controller is used for controlling the charging process of the battery pack and opening and closing of the electric valve, the solar energy conversion rate is higher, and use is reliable.

title: System and methods for thermoelectric air cooling and heating
abstract: A system and methods for photovoltaic phase change material assisted thermoelectric air cooling and heating of a building includes a photovoltaic phase change material wall unit which is cooled by absorption of heat by a phase change material attached to the photovoltaic wall unit; a photovoltaic phase change material roof unit which converts solar radiation into electric energy; Peltier based thermoelectric units configured to heat and cool air streams passing through an air duct; and Seebeck effect based thermoelectric units which convert a temperature gradient into thermoelectric power. A hot air stream in the air duct is directed to an air duct on a roof of the building and a cold air stream from the first air duct is circulated into the building interior to achieve thermal comfort.

title: Multi-energy complementary economic dispatching method for wind-solar-thermal storage micro-grid based on deep learning
abstract: The invention discloses a multi-energy complementary economic dispatching method for a wind-solar-thermal storage micro-grid based on deep learning, and the method comprises the following steps: 1, constructing a multi-time-scale wind-solar-thermal storage micro-grid operation data set, comprising photovoltaic output time sequence data, wind power output time sequence data, thermal power output time sequence data, energy storage charging and discharging time sequence data and meteorological data; 2, setting a generative adversarial network model comprising a time sequence feature extraction unit, and embedding a generator into an LSTM network to serve as the time sequence feature extraction unit; the input of the generator is a Gaussian noise vector and meteorological data, and the output of the generator is wind and light output uncertainty scene data; 3, taking the minimum operation cost as an objective function and combining a power abandoning punishment mechanism to construct a multi-energy complementary economic dispatching optimization model; and 4, introducing a dynamic threshold evaluation mechanism, evaluating the quality of the wind and light output uncertainty scene set through kernel density estimation and an autocorrelation coefficient, and dynamically adjusting an evaluation threshold according to a historical fluctuation standard deviation and error feedback.

title: New energy desertification control power generation device
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of desertification control power generation, in particular to a new energy desertification control power generation device which comprises a plurality of solar panels, first sand-proof cloth, second sand-proof cloth and a splicing device, the second sand-proof cloth is placed on one side of the first sand-proof cloth, and the surfaces of the first sand-proof cloth and the second sand-proof cloth are fixedly connected with the multiple solar panels. Splicing devices are arranged on the surfaces of the two sides of the second sand-proof cloth and comprise first clamping pieces, the first clamping pieces are fixedly connected with the surface of the second sand-proof cloth, the first clamping pieces are placed on the surface of the first sand-proof cloth, and second clamping pieces are fixedly connected to the lower surface of the second sand-proof cloth; and the second clamping piece is placed on the surface of the first sand-proof cloth. According to the desertification control power generation device, through the arrangement of the splicing device, the first sand prevention cloth and the second sand prevention cloth can be effectively spliced together, the situation that the first sand prevention cloth and the second sand prevention cloth are blown open by strong wind is avoided, and then the desertification control effect of the desertification control power generation device is improved.

title: Environment-friendly and energy-saving display lamp box
abstract: The utility model relates to an environment-friendly energy-saving display lamp box which is characterized in that a display box electrically connected with a storage battery is embedded in the middle area of a cabinet body, two arc-shaped sliding rails which are concentric and oppositely distributed are fixed above a supporting plate, and a sliding block is arranged on each arc-shaped sliding rail in a sliding mode; a solar panel which is obliquely distributed and electrically connected with the storage battery is arranged above the two arc-shaped sliding rails, two stand columns below the solar panel are fixedly connected with the two sliding blocks correspondingly, and a power mechanism used for driving the solar panel to rotate is fixed to the position, at the circle centers of the arc-shaped sliding rails, of the supporting plate. A sun sensor electrically connected with the controller is fixed to the light facing side of the solar panel, and the power mechanism is electrically connected with the controller. The beneficial effects are that the solar sensor can detect the direction of sunlight and send a detection signal to the controller, the controller then sends an action instruction to the power mechanism, and the power mechanism controls the solar panel to rotate along with the sunlight so as to efficiently utilize the sunlight to enter and exit for charging and energy storage.

title: Passivated NiOx thin film, perovskite solar cell and preparation method
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of thin film material preparation, and particularly relates to a passivated NiOx thin film, a perovskite solar cell and a preparation method. The SAM formed by mixing the DPA-carbazole derivative and the 4-chlorophenyl potassium trifluoroborate is used as the passivation layer of the NiOx thin film, and the 4-chlorophenyl potassium trifluoroborate is used for filling vacancies in the SAM structure to ensure that the SAM completely covers the NiOx thin film. The perovskite solar cell sequentially comprises a conductive substrate, a passivation NiOx thin film, a perovskite light absorption layer, an electron transmission layer, an electron blocking layer and a metal electrode. According to the invention, interface modification is carried out on the NiOx-based perovskite solar cell through the SAM layer, so that surface defects of a thin film are passivated, and non-radiative recombination is reduced; the interface energy level is better matched, and the conductivity is improved; therefore, the open-circuit voltage, fill factor and stability of the device are improved.

title: Solar-driven interface evaporation extraction device of coupling electrode
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of seawater mineral extraction, and particularly relates to a solar-driven interface evaporation extraction device of a coupling electrode, the solar-driven interface evaporation extraction device comprises an interface evaporation assembly and an electric field strengthening assembly, the interface evaporation assembly comprises a main evaporation layer, a mineral crystallization evaporation layer, a buoyancy body, a water delivery layer and an ion separation membrane; the mineral crystallization evaporation layer is arranged at the lower part of the main evaporation layer; the top surface of the buoyancy body is in contact with the bottom surface of the main evaporation layer; the upper end of the water conveying layer sequentially penetrates through the buoyancy body and the main evaporation layer upwards; the ion separation membrane covers the lower end of the water conveying layer; the electric field strengthening assembly comprises a main evaporation layer electrode, a mineral substance crystallization evaporation layer electrode, a zero potential electrode and a high-voltage power supply. The seawater mineral extraction device is used for seawater mineral extraction, can solve the technical problems of insufficient evaporation efficiency, high energy consumption, high cost and poor benefits in seawater mineral recovery in the prior art, and can realize efficient recovery of seawater minerals, reduce the cost and improve the benefits.

title: Passivated contact solar cell, preparation method thereof and photovoltaic module
abstract: The invention discloses a passivation contact solar cell and a preparation method thereof, and a photovoltaic module. The passivation contact solar cell comprises a silicon substrate; the dielectric layer is arranged on the surface of the silicon substrate; the doping layer is laminated on one side, away from the silicon substrate, of the dielectric layer; the oxide layer is laminated on one side, away from the silicon substrate, of the doping layer; the functional layer is laminated on one side, away from the silicon substrate, of the oxide layer; the first electrode penetrates through the functional layer and the oxide layer and is in ohmic connection with the doping layer; wherein the functional layer comprises S < i > atoms and N atoms, and the ratio of the Si atoms to the N atoms is in a decreasing trend in the direction away from the oxide layer. According to the passivation contact solar cell, the interface defect state density between the doping layer and the functional layer is effectively reduced, and the energy conversion efficiency of the passivation contact solar cell is improved.

title: Mounting structure of solar panel
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of solar panels, in particular to a mounting structure of a solar panel, which comprises the solar panel and is used for directly converting sunlight into electric energy, and the solar panel comprises a main body assembly and a plurality of photovoltaic panels arranged in a frame; the mounting assembly comprises a plurality of mounting frames arranged in the frame, a shell frame used for limiting the photovoltaic panel and fixing the two ends of the mounting frames, a gear rotationally mounted in the center of the interior of each mounting frame through an inner hexagonal shaft, balance rods fixed to the upper and lower ends of the interior of each mounting frame, racks slidably mounted on the balance rods, and pin heads fixed to the outer walls of the ends of the balance rods; the balance rod is sleeved with a spring; the auxiliary assembly comprises a fixing plate mounted at the top of the shell frame and plugs fixed to the two sides of the bottom of the fixing plate; the main body assembly comprises shaft brackets fixed at the two ends of the bottom of the mounting frame; the photovoltaic panels are convenient and fast to disassemble and assemble, and a plurality of photovoltaic panels can be controlled to turn over synchronously by only one motor.

title: Tobacco beetle trapping lamp
abstract: The tobacco beetle trapping lamp comprises a base, a supporting body is fixedly connected to the base, a trapping device is fixedly connected to the top of the supporting body, a motor box is connected to the top of the trapping device, and a solar panel is arranged at the top of the motor box; the trapping device comprises a light-transmitting shell, a lamp tube is arranged in the shell, and the lamp tube is electrically connected with the motor box; a sticky plate is arranged in the shell and at the bottom of the shell, and a plurality of beetle holes which are uniformly distributed are further formed in the shell. Light energy is converted into electric energy through the solar panel to supply power to the lamp tube, the tobacco beetles are lured into the trapping device through the phototaxis of the tobacco beetles, the tobacco beetles enter the trapping device through the beetle holes, and the tobacco beetles are captured through the sticky plate in the trapping device. The technical problem that in the prior art, tobacco beetle prevention and control need manpower is solved, and the tobacco beetle prevention and control efficiency is improved. The device is powered by solar energy, and has the advantages of energy conservation, environmental protection, safety, reliability and the like.

title: Lithium bromide solution concentration solar preheating system
abstract: The utility model discloses a lithium bromide solution concentration solar preheating system which comprises a solar heat collection plate, a heat exchange cylinder and a liquid storage barrel, a condensing coil is arranged in the heat exchange cylinder, the solar heat collection plate and the condensing coil are connected to form a solar heat collection circulation loop, the heat exchange cylinder and the liquid storage barrel are connected to form a lithium bromide solution circulation loop, and the lithium bromide solution circulation loop is connected with the liquid storage barrel. A liquid adding pipe is arranged between the solar heat collecting plate and the condensing coil, and R123 refrigerants are added into the liquid adding pipe. According to the preheating system, the R123 refrigerant is used as a heat absorption medium, phase change can be generated in the heat absorption process, liquid phase is converted into gas phase, a large amount of heat can be absorbed, the gas-phase R123 refrigerant absorbing the large amount of heat also generates phase change in the heat release process after entering the condensing coil and encountering the lithium bromide solution, and the heat release effect is improved. The gas phase is converted into the liquid phase, a large amount of heat can be released, the lithium bromide solution can be rapidly heated and preheated, electric energy used for heating in the concentration process is reduced, and the purposes of reducing cost and improving efficiency are achieved.

title: Electric vehicle charging system capable of generating electricity by solar energy
abstract: Provided is an electric vehicle charging system capable of generating electricity by solar energy comprising a roof capable of generating electricity under illumination, a movable solar panel, a solar panel state control device, and an intelligent voltage conversion and control module. The solar panel state control device is connected to the intelligent voltage conversion and control module, and controls stretched and contracted states of the movable solar panel, output voltages of the roof capable of generating electricity and the movable solar panel are connected in parallel, and then are connected to the intelligent voltage conversion and control module, an output voltage of the intelligent voltage conversion and control module is used for charging a power battery of the electric vehicle, and the solar panel is controlled to generate a maximum conversion rate and a maximum power in real time to charge the power battery.

title: Perovskite composite layer and preparation method thereof, solar cell and photovoltaic module
abstract: The invention discloses a perovskite composite layer and a preparation method thereof, a solar cell and a photovoltaic module, the perovskite composite layer comprises a perovskite layer and a reduced graphene oxide layer laminated on the surface of the perovskite layer, and the reduction degree of reduced graphene oxide in the reduced graphene oxide layer is 10%-35%. The reduced graphene oxide with a specific reduction degree is arranged on the surface of the perovskite layer, so that surface defects of the perovskite layer are remarkably reduced, carrier recombination on the surface of the perovskite layer is reduced, and the energy conversion efficiency of the solar cell is further improved.

title: Photovoltaic direct-drive type efficient heat pump unit and using method
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of heat pump units, and provides a photovoltaic direct-drive type efficient heat pump unit and a using method.The photovoltaic direct-drive type efficient heat pump unit comprises a supporting base and a solar panel, and the solar panel is used for a photovoltaic structure in the heat pump unit and converts light energy into electric energy; the heat dissipation mechanism is arranged in the solar panel and used for heat dissipation and cooling of the solar panel; the regulation and control mechanism is arranged on the supporting seat and is used for regulating the use direction of the solar panel; the adjusting mechanism is fixedly arranged on the solar panel and is used for adjusting the use angle of the solar panel; the light sensing mechanism is arranged on the side edge of the solar panel and used for monitoring the sun illumination direction; the first servo motor controls the solar panel to rotate in the illumination direction, meanwhile, the second servo motor can control the solar panel to rotate by the rotation angle, and therefore the solar panel can synchronously adjust and control the light receiving angle in real time according to the sunlight irradiation angle, and the efficiency of converting light energy of the solar panel into electric energy is effectively improved.

title: Insecticidal agricultural machine special for farmland
abstract: The utility model discloses a special insecticidal agricultural machine for farmland. The special insecticidal agricultural machine comprises an equipment body, the equipment body is used for supporting agricultural machinery mechanism elements, and a winged insect attracting assembly and a winged insect collecting assembly are arranged in the equipment body; the utility model relates to the technical field of farmland insect killing, and has the following beneficial effects that winged insects can be directly sucked into the agricultural machine through the winged insect attraction assembly, and can be killed through the insect killing lamp in the agricultural machine, no pesticide is used, and the component growth environment of soil cannot be harmed; and the consumption of a large amount of manpower and electric energy resources is reduced through the mobile disinfecting and killing mechanism using the solar panel to supplement electric power.

title: Intelligent medicament filling system
abstract: The invention provides an intelligent medicament filling system. The intelligent medicament filling system comprises a medicament dissolving mechanism used for storing and mixing medicaments; the filling mechanism is used for conveying the dissolved medicament to the medicament adding opening; the solar power supply mechanism converts solar energy into electric energy and outputs voltage; the controller is used for controlling the medicine dissolving mechanism to mix the medicine and controlling the filling mechanism to convey the mixed medicine to the medicine adding opening; the controller is further used for converting voltage output by the solar power supply mechanism into action voltage of the medicine dissolving mechanism and the filling mechanism. The controller adjusts dissolving and filling parameters in real time, and the solar power supply mechanism provides independent clean energy, so that automation and intellectualization of the chemical adding process are realized, the problem of power supply in remote areas is solved, and the operation cost is reduced; and the production efficiency, the environmental protection benefit and the economical efficiency are obviously improved.

title: Solar cell, preparation method thereof and photovoltaic module
abstract: The invention discloses a solar cell and a preparation method thereof, and a photovoltaic module. The solar cell comprises a semiconductor substrate; the P-type conductive film layer and the N-type conductive film layer are arranged on the surface of the semiconductor substrate; a first electrode and a second electrode; in the surface of the semiconductor substrate, a first texture structure is arranged in a region in contact with the P-type conductive film layer, a second texture structure is arranged in a region in contact with the N-type conductive film layer, and the first texture structure and the second texture structure are a plurality of grooves of which the areas are gradually reduced from groove openings to groove bottoms; any side length of a notch of the first texture structure is smaller than any side length of a notch of the second texture structure, the depth of the first texture structure is larger than that of the second texture structure, and the included angle between the side edge and the bottom edge of the first texture structure is larger than that between the side edge and the bottom edge of the second texture structure. According to the invention, the quality of the conductive film layer is improved, and the energy conversion efficiency of the solar cell is further improved.

title: Solar weighing scale
abstract: The utility model discloses a solar weighing scale, comprising a pedal, the upper end of which is respectively provided with a photovoltaic assembly and a display screen; the lower shell is arranged at the position of the lower end of the pedal, and pressure sensors are arranged at the positions of four end corners of the lower shell; and a central control processing unit and a storage battery are respectively arranged in the lower shell. According to the solar weighing scale provided by the utility model, a platform for treading or supporting can be provided for a user through the pedal, the pressure sensors at the four end corners of the lower shell are used for detecting the weight of a person or an object on the pedal, and the weight of the weighed object is converted into an electric signal through the pressure sensors; and the measurement results are displayed by the photovoltaic module, power is supplied to each component through the output end of the display screen, the device is clean, energy-saving and environment-friendly, environmental pollution is reduced, the service life is long, maintenance is not needed, and redundant electric quantity is stored by the storage battery.

title: Solar cell, preparation method thereof and photovoltaic module
abstract: The invention provides a solar cell and a preparation method thereof, and a photovoltaic module, the solar cell comprises a substrate, and a hole transport layer, a perovskite absorption layer and a perovskite passivation layer which are sequentially arranged on the substrate, the perovskite passivation layer contains 2-methylthio-2-imidazoline hydriodate, and the hole transport layer contains a hole transport layer, a hole transport layer, a hole transport layer, a hole transport layer, a hole transport layer, a hole transport layer, a hole transport layer and a hole transport layer. According to the invention, the interface stability of the perovskite absorption layer can be improved, the surface defects of the perovskite absorption layer can be passivated, the energy level matching of the perovskite absorption layer can be optimized, the stability of the perovskite absorption layer can be enhanced, and the photoelectric conversion efficiency of the solar cell can be further improved.

title: Photovoltaic cylindrical tile and power generation roof structure
abstract: The utility model provides a photovoltaic cylindrical tile and a power generation roof structure, and particularly relates to the technical field of buildings. The photovoltaic cylindrical tile comprises a tile body, a water retaining piece and a power generation assembly. Wherein the tile body is a curved surface arranged in an arc shape. The water retaining piece is arranged on the outer surface of the curved surface in a protruding mode along the curved surface of the tile body, and the water retaining piece is attached to the tile body. The power generation assembly comprises a plurality of battery pieces which are electrically connected, the battery pieces are laid on the outer surface of the curved surface, and the battery pieces are attached to the curved surface. The width of the water retaining piece is smaller than or equal to 10 mm, and/or the height of the water retaining piece is smaller than or equal to 8 mm. And the water retaining piece is arranged on the outer surface of the curved surface in a protruding manner, so that the adjacent photovoltaic cylindrical tiles can be used for retaining water through the water retaining piece after being lapped, and a building is protected from being damaged by rainwater. According to the photovoltaic cylindrical tile, the power generation assembly and the tile body are combined, so that the plurality of battery pieces are laid on the tile body, the solar energy collection area of the photovoltaic cylindrical tile is increased, the appearance adaptability is improved, and the power generation efficiency of the photovoltaic cylindrical tile and the solar energy conversion efficiency are improved.

title: Solar energy storage fault detection device
abstract: The utility model relates to the related technical field of solar energy storage, in particular to a solar energy storage fault detection device, which comprises a detector, an energy storage box and a mounting mechanism, a detection mechanism is arranged on one side of the surface of the detector, and a mounting mechanism is arranged on one side of the surface of the detector. According to the solar energy storage fault detection device, a mounting mechanism is arranged, a pull ring is pulled to drive a limiting block to move, a reset spring is subjected to compression deformation, when the limiting block is completely embedded into a movable groove, a positioning block is completely embedded into a positioning groove, the limiting groove and the movable groove are aligned at each other, acting force applied to the pull ring is loosened, and the limiting block is completely embedded into the movable groove. When the detector needs to be overhauled, a pull ring is pulled to enable the limiting block to be completely embedded in a movable groove, and at the moment, a handle is pulled to take out the detector.

title: Anti-deposition solid-liquid mixed fluid conveying pipeline system
abstract: The utility model discloses an anti-deposition solid-liquid mixed fluid conveying pipeline system. According to the system, a washing pipe is arranged beside a solid-liquid mixed fluid conveying pipe in parallel, washing branch pipes are arranged between the washing pipe and the solid-liquid mixed fluid conveying pipe at intervals, and washing valves are arranged on the washing branch pipes. The flushing valve is provided with a special driving mechanism which comprises a motor, a gear, a coil spring, a worm, a swing rod, a limiting block and the like, instant action of the valve element can be achieved, and the limiting block can be adjusted through a spring and a screw knob. And a one-way stop valve is arranged between the solid-liquid mixed fluid conveying pipe and the flushing pipe. The motors are remotely and centrally controlled through the controller, the valves are periodically and discontinuously opened and closed in a staggered mode, and the solar cell panel is used for supplying power. The system can efficiently prevent deposition and backflow, the influence on the medium proportion is small, and automatic energy-saving and environment-friendly operation is achieved.

title: Compact solar pet tracking device based on dynamic energy management and control method
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of pet supplies, in particular to a compact solar pet tracking device based on dynamic energy management and a control method. The solar charger comprises an outer shell, a flexible solar power supply module is arranged on the upper surface of the outer shell, a storage battery used for storing energy is arranged in the outer shell, a main board is arranged above the storage battery, the flexible solar power supply module and the storage battery are both connected to the main board, and charging is controlled through the main board. A motion activation positioning module used for positioning is installed on the main board, the motion activation positioning module comprises an independent main control chip, and the main control chip is connected with an accelerometer and a GPS module; solar energy is adopted for power supply, the power utilization source can be controlled, solar energy is used for charging and power supply when solar rays are sufficient, a lithium battery is used for power supply when solar rays are insufficient, and compared with a charging design or a disposable battery of a traditional device, the cruising ability is high, the charging requirement is greatly reduced, and convenience is greatly improved.

title: Solar panel base for solar street lamp
