abstract: The utility model provides a solar panel base for a solar street lamp, which relates to the technical field of solar panel bases and comprises a lamp post body, a screw is fixedly connected to the center of the upper end of the lamp post body, positioning grooves distributed in an annular array are formed in the upper end of the lamp post body, and an illuminating lamp is fixedly mounted outside the lamp post body. A sealing and locking mechanism is arranged above the lamp pole body and comprises a connecting sleeve, the inner wall of the connecting sleeve is movably connected with the upper end of the lamp pole body in a sleeving mode, through the sealing and locking mechanism, convenient and fast installation of the slope base is achieved, rainwater is guided through a conical water guiding table to avoid accumulation and infiltration, and therefore the rainwater is prevented from entering the lamp pole body. And the internal screw rod is further protected through the sealing cover and the annular sealing gasket, so that the mounting efficiency is improved, the bolt is prevented from rusting and oxidizing, and the orientation angle of the photovoltaic panel body can be conveniently adjusted through the switching insertion matching of the positioning rod and the positioning groove, and the effect of improving the solar energy receiving efficiency is achieved.

title: Skid-mounted oil field crude oil heating equipment
abstract: The utility model provides skid-mounted oil field crude oil heating equipment. The skid-mounted oil field crude oil heating equipment comprises a skid-mounted container, a heat storage electric boiler, a heat storage tank, a solar heat collector, an air source heat pump, a shell and tube heat exchanger, an energy storage pump, an energy release pump and an electric control valve. The air source heat pump system has the advantages that the heat storage electric boiler is started to store heat in the night valley electricity price period, the heat is released for heating in the daytime peak-flat electricity price period, the air source heat pump supplements heat in the daytime high environment temperature period, the heat conversion efficiency is high, and according to the peak-valley-flat electricity price difference, the energy is saved. The operation cost can be saved by more than 60% compared with that of a traditional heating mode, the temperature of crude oil can be stably controlled by adopting one electric control valve, the temperature can be flexibly set, the inaccuracy of temperature control of traditional heating equipment is avoided, water is adopted as a heat transfer medium for heating, and the risk that crude oil is combustible is avoided.

title: Multifunctional conjugated interface modification material as well as preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention relates to the field of perovskite solar cells, and discloses a multifunctional conjugated interface modification material with one of the following structural formulas as well as a preparation method and application thereof. A trans-perovskite solar cell obtained by taking the conjugated interface modification material as a buried interface modification layer has a high-quality perovskite thin film with a low defect state; the solar cell prepared by the method has the advantages of low energy loss of a buried interface, obviously enhanced carrier extraction and transmission, improved photoelectric conversion efficiency to 25.48%-26.61%, and excellent long-term stability.

title: Artificial environment bin system
abstract: The invention relates to an artificial environment bin system which can adjust temperature, humidity and oxygen content and comprises an environment bin body and a heat pump cycle, the heat pump cycle comprises a compressor, a four-way valve, a condenser, an expansion valve and an evaporator, the artificial environment bin system further comprises an energy storage box and a surface air cooler, and a secondary refrigerant is contained in the energy storage box; the energy storage box is connected with the heat pump cycle in a heat exchange mode, and when the temperature of the environment bin body reaches a preset value and solar power supply electric energy and/or valley price electric energy exist, the heat pump cycle stores energy into the energy storage box; the surface air cooler can utilize energy in the energy storage box to conduct heat pre-exchange on fresh air when solar power supply electric energy and/or peak price electric energy do not exist, and then the fresh air passes through the evaporator. Compared with the prior art, by optimizing the energy use, improving the flexibility and adaptability of the system and reducing the operation cost, the invention aims to solve the challenges faced by the existing environment control system and provide a more sustainable and economic solution for users.

title: Additive for perovskite solar cell, perovskite solar cell and preparation method of perovskite solar cell
abstract: The invention provides an additive for a perovskite solar cell, the perovskite solar cell and a preparation method thereof, the structural formula of the additive is LY, L comprises any one of Na < + >, K < + >, Rb < + > or Cs < + >, and the structural formula of Y is as follows: R1 comprises at least one of-SO2CF3,-PO (CF3) 2,-PO (OH) 2,-PO (OH) (CF3),-P (OH) 2,-P (CF3) 2 or-P (OH) (CF3), and R2 comprises any one of-SO2-,-PO (OH)-or-PO (CF3)-. The Y in the additive can form coordination with lithium ions migrated in a hole transport layer, so that the lithium ions are inhibited from being migrated into a perovskite light absorption layer. Therefore, the additive can avoid reduction of the perovskite solar energy performance caused by lithium ion migration, and the efficiency and the operation stability of the perovskite solar cell are improved.

title: Perovskite solar cell, preparation method thereof and photovoltaic module
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of solar cells, in particular to a perovskite solar cell, a preparation method thereof and a photovoltaic module. The perovskite solar cell comprises a crystalline film layer, a perovskite light absorption layer and a perovskite sacrificial layer arranged between the crystalline film layer and the perovskite light absorption layer. The perovskite sacrificial layer comprises a first perovskite material and has a plurality of energy levels in gradient distribution, the region, close to the crystalline film layer, of the perovskite sacrificial layer has a first energy level, the region, close to the perovskite light absorption layer, of the perovskite sacrificial layer has a second energy level, the difference value between the first energy level and the energy level of the crystalline film layer is E1, and the difference value between the first energy level and the energy level of the crystalline film layer is E2. The difference between the second energy level and the energy level of the perovskite light absorption layer is E2, and the difference between the energy level of the perovskite light absorption layer and the energy level of the crystalline film layer is E3, E1lt; e1, E2, E3, E2lt; and E3. According to the perovskite solar cell, the energy level matching performance and the contact performance between the perovskite light absorption layer and the crystalline film layer are optimized, and the perovskite solar cell has better stability and photoelectric performance.

title: Emergency kitchen
abstract: The utility model discloses an emergency kitchen, which relates to the technical field of emergency kitchens and comprises a power supply chamber and a working chamber which are used for providing electric energy, the power supply chamber comprises a hydrogen energy power supply module and a solar energy power supply module, and the power output end of the hydrogen energy power supply module is communicated with the power input end of the kitchen. The power output end of the solar power supply module is communicated with the power input end of the kitchen, the power output end of the kitchen supplies power to the working chamber, and the working chamber comprises a cooker area and a storage area. Hydrogen energy and solar energy are completely clean energy, consumed products do not pollute the environment, the hydrogen energy reaction process is stable and controllable, high-power electric appliances can be driven to work continuously, solar energy is extremely easy, long endurance of an emergency kitchen can be achieved, when solar energy and hydrogen energy are used, hydrogen energy power supply serves as a main means, solar energy power supply serves as a supplement, and energy is saved. And the cruising ability of the emergency kitchen is prolonged.

title: Airflow uniform distribution and energy saving device of limestone powder production dust collector
abstract: The utility model relates to an airflow uniform-distribution and energy-saving device of a limestone pulverizing dust collector, which is arranged at the rear end of a flue and the front end of the dust collector, and a first-stage airflow uniform-distribution device, a second-stage airflow uniform-distribution device and a third-stage airflow uniform-distribution device are sequentially arranged in an inlet horn according to the flue gas direction; each stage of uniform distributor consists of a blade and a frame; the top of the inlet horn is provided with solar photovoltaic power supply equipment for supplying power to each stage of blade and providing rotation kinetic energy; the blades of the first-stage uniform airflow distributor are in the form of large blades, and the blades of the second-stage uniform airflow distributor and the blades of the third-stage uniform airflow distributor are in the form of small blades. According to the utility model, the multistage airflow uniform distributors are uniformly distributed in the inlet horn of the dust collector, so that the flue gas is gradually and uniformly diffused, the flue gas is dynamically adjusted to flow into the dust collector, the uniform distribution is better, the dust removal efficiency of the dust collector is greatly improved, and the running resistance and abrasion of equipment are reduced.

title: Benzotriazole derivative electron acceptor as well as preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a benzotriazole derivative electron acceptor as well as a preparation method and application thereof. The benzotriazole derivative electron acceptor is represented by a general formula (I). The receptor has good solubility in a green solvent, and can be matched with a polymer donor to obtain an organic solar cell and a transparent organic solar cell with high energy conversion efficiency. .

title: Virtual power plant optimization scheduling method considering combination of interface solar steam power generation and hydrogen storage system
abstract: A virtual power plant optimization scheduling method considering interface solar steam power generation and hydrogen storage system combination comprises the following steps: taking electrical load, hydrogen demand and water demand of a load end as a core, considering electrochemical energy storage and hydrogen storage in a combined manner, and establishing a virtual power plant optimization model containing interface solar steam power generation and hydrogen storage system combination; establishing constraint conditions of the virtual power plant optimization model; the uncertainty of new energy output in the region is processed; and solving the virtual power plant optimization model by adopting a particle swarm optimization algorithm with variable weight coefficients, and performing simulation calculation in different scenes. According to the virtual power plant optimal scheduling method considering the combination of the interface solar steam power generation and the hydrogen storage system, the dual dilemma of energy shortage and fresh water shortage in an island area can be solved, the dependence on traditional energy can be reduced, the energy transportation cost and the environmental risk are reduced, and the energy utilization efficiency and the environmental friendliness are improved.

title: Thermal management system for light-heat-electricity energy recovery in space environment
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of space electronic equipment energy and heat management, and relates to a heat management system for light-heat-electricity energy recovery in a space environment. Comprising a direction-variable dredging structure, a one-way conductive PN junction, a thermoelectric metal power generation structure, a cooling emission nozzle, graphene foam phase-change nanoparticles, a gradient arc-shaped porous capillary core, a liquid collection supporting rod, a sun tracking rotating shaft, a battery, a control system and a photovoltaic panel, the one-way conductive PN junction is electrically connected to the battery, and the thermoelectric metal power generation structure is electrically connected to the battery. The battery is electrically connected with the sun tracking rotating shaft and the control system which is electrically connected with the sun tracking rotating shaft. Through the technical means such as a direction-variable dredging structure, a multi-stage photo-thermoelectric conversion system, intelligent heat management and working medium recycling, efficient collection of solar energy, recycling of waste heat and light weight of the system are achieved.

title: High open-circuit voltage perovskite solar cell and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of perovskite solar cells, and particularly discloses a high-open-circuit-voltage perovskite solar cell and a preparation method thereof. The high open-circuit voltage perovskite solar cell comprises a hole transport layer, a perovskite light absorption layer and an interface modification layer, wherein the interface modification layer is located between the hole transport layer and the perovskite light absorption layer; and the interface modification layer is made of cellulose diacetate. According to the invention, a layer of cellulose diacetate is introduced between the hole transport layer and the perovskite light absorption layer as the interface modification layer, so that a uniformly-covered ultrathin layer can be formed on the surface of the hole transport layer, the interface can be effectively regulated and controlled, and the film forming quality and uniformity of the perovskite thin film are improved; the problems that NiOx and perovskite interface energy levels are not matched, the surface defects are rich and the wettability is poor are solved, so that the open-circuit voltage and the overall photoelectric property of the device are improved; meanwhile, the stability and repeatability of the device are enhanced, and the device has good application prospects and industrialization value.

title: Solar steam electricity system
abstract: An electricity generation system including an electricity generating plant with a turbine, a dynamo and a solar power plant having an absorber tube for a parabolic trough solar power plant that includes a glass pipe which extends from a first end to a second end of a parabolic trough, a helical pipe enclosed within the glass pipe. A sand filled pipe is surrounded by the helical pipe. An inner pipe extends from the first end to the second end of the parabolic trough along the central axis of the glass pipe. A solenoid valve is configured to block the water from entering the inner pipe when the solenoid valve is closed and release the water to the inner pipe when the solenoid valve is opened. The turbine is fluidly connected to the solar power plant to receive the steam and produce mechanical energy which rotates the dynamo.

title: Method for preparing SnO2 electron transport layer for CZTSSe solar cell based on sol-gel method
abstract: The invention provides a method for preparing a SnO2 electron transport layer for a CZTSSe solar cell based on a sol-gel method, and the method comprises the steps: carrying out the spin coating, annealing, cooling and other operations of a CZTSSe/CdS film, and obtaining the SnO2 electron transport layer. The preparation method comprises the following steps: carrying out ultraviolet-ozone treatment on a CZTSe/CdS film; the treated film is spin-coated with SnO2 nano dispersion liquid with the first concentration; and carrying out annealing treatment on the spin-coated thin film so as to obtain the SnO2 electron transport layer for the CZTSSe thin-film solar cell. According to the invention, the SnO2 thin film is prepared by using a sol-gel method for the first time to serve as the electron transport layer of the CZTSSe thin-film solar cell, the sol-gel method is simple to operate and low in equipment requirement, and the SnO2 layer and the absorption layer CZTSSe/CdS layer have good energy level matching, can reduce interlayer defects and avoid poor contact layers, and have the characteristics of cooperation and complementation; the structure has a low carrier recombination rate and low energy loss, so that the photoelectric conversion performance of a photovoltaic device is improved.

title: Trans-inverted perovskite solar cell based on phosphonic acid SAMs and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a phosphonic acid SAMs-based inverted perovskite solar cell and a preparation method thereof, the phosphonic acid SAMs-based inverted perovskite solar cell comprises a substrate layer, a conductive substrate, a hole transport layer, a perovskite light absorption layer, an electron transport layer and a top electrode layer, and SAMs of the hole transport layer are carbazolyl phosphonic acid compounds. The phosphonic acid group in the carbazolyl phosphonic acid compound has very strong binding energy, the stability and performance of SAMs can be remarkably improved, the carbazole derivative is used for improving surface coverage, changing surface properties and generating dipole moment, and the working function of a substrate can be adjusted; the obtained hole transport layer material passivates corresponding defects through interaction with a perovskite layer, the quality of a perovskite thin film is improved, the open-circuit voltage and the filling factor of a thin film cell device are remarkably improved, and finally the photoelectric conversion efficiency of a solar cell is greatly improved.

title: Solar-energy electricity generation system with integrated load management
abstract: An integrated load management controller for directing electrical current generated by a plurality of solar photovoltaic modules exposed to ambient light selectively through a diverter to a battery bank for storage and to a current conditioner for supply of electrical current into an electrical grid, based on a supply demand communicated by an electrical grid demand controller, for managing the generation, storage, and supply of electrical current from the solar photovoltaic modules. A method of supplying supplemental electrical current to an electrical grid servicing load center using a solar-energy electricity generation system is disclosed.

title: Drying system
abstract: The utility model relates to a drying system, which adopts a solar air heater, heat storage of a heat-conducting oil system, absorption refrigeration and heat pump heat supply dehumidification technology, realizes efficient utilization of solar heat in an article drying and cold using unit, solves the problem of utilization of the existing solar energy in the drying system, is convenient to install, maintain and maintain, is safe and efficient, and has the advantages of energy conservation and environmental protection. And social, economic and ecological benefits are expected to be remarkable.

title: Solar table with atmosphere lamp and wireless charging function
abstract: The utility model belongs to the technical field of outdoor tables, and discloses a wireless charging solar table with an atmosphere lamp strip, which comprises a table top, a square slotting part is arranged on the table top, a solar charging lamp strip module is mounted in the square slotting part, and the solar charging lamp strip module comprises a base, a lamp strip, a photovoltaic panel and a wireless charging module I, the base is fixedly installed in the square slotting part, the lamp strip is installed on the periphery of the base in a surrounding mode, the photovoltaic panel is fixedly installed on the upper surface of the base, the first wireless charging module is fixedly installed at the bottom of the base, the lamp strip is electrically connected with the first wireless charging module, the wireless charging module is electrically connected with the photovoltaic panel, and the photovoltaic panel supplies power to the wireless charging module. And the lamp strip is charged. According to the outdoor table, linkage use of atmosphere light, wireless charging and solar energy receiving of the outdoor table can be achieved. The product competitiveness is improved, and some indoor smart home is applied to outdoor products.

title: Preparation method of solar cell, solar cell and photovoltaic module
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of a solar cell, the solar cell and a photovoltaic module. The preparation method of the solar cell comprises the following steps: forming a seed layer on the surface of a cell body; forming a patterned mask layer on the surface of the seed layer, wherein the patterned area of the mask layer corresponds to the area where the metal layer is to be formed; removing the seed layer which is not covered by the mask layer to form a patterned seed layer; removing the mask layer; electroplating the surface of the patterned seed layer to form a metal layer to obtain an electrode grid line; wherein in the step of removing the seed layer which is not covered by the mask layer and the step of removing the mask layer, at least one step adopts a chemical reagent to perform removal operation. According to the preparation method of the solar cell, the conductivity of the electrode grid line can be improved, so that the energy conversion efficiency of the solar cell is improved.

title: Intelligent early warning system and method for 5T detection station overhaul coming vehicle
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent early warning system and method for a 5T detection station overhaul coming vehicle, and solves the problems of human negligence, communication interruption and insufficient response of'human staring 'protection. The system comprises a detection terminal (2 kilometers, double magnetic steel/radar, wide-temperature lithium titanate battery + solar energy and IP67 protection), an alarm terminal (machine room sound-light alarm and differential mode) and a cloud platform (monitoring, log and remote configuration). The core functions are as follows: reverse coming vehicle locking (direction judgment to prevent false alarm), multi-level early warning (preparation in 2 kilometers and immediate lane descending in 1 kilometer) and self-inspection diagnosis; 4G/5G/LoRa transmission is adopted, the reliability is ensured by dual-computer hot standby, the civil defense is replaced by technical defense, the intrinsic safety is improved, and the probability of maintenance accidents is reduced.

title: Solar lighting and monitoring integrated device
abstract: The utility model provides a solar lighting and monitoring integrated device, which relates to the technical field of solar energy application and monitoring lighting and comprises a lighting and monitoring integrated assembly, a cleaning assembly is arranged on the lighting and monitoring integrated assembly, an adjusting assembly is arranged at the top of the lighting and monitoring integrated assembly, and the cleaning assembly is connected with the adjusting assembly. The illumination and monitoring integrated assembly comprises a mounting rack and a monitoring camera. According to the device, the translation motor is controlled to work, so that the translation motor electrically drives the threaded rod to rotate, then the moving block is driven to move on the outer side of the threaded rod, the device is cleaned by the cleaning frame, and a solar photovoltaic panel, an illuminating lamp and a monitoring camera can be conveniently cleaned by using a cleaning brush; dust and impurities attached to the surface of the monitoring camera are effectively removed, it is guaranteed that the illuminating lamp keeps stable illumination, the definition of the monitoring camera is improved, meanwhile, the solar photovoltaic panel is made to be in an efficient power generation state, and the power generation amount of the solar photovoltaic panel is increased.

title: Parabolic groove type condenser design method based on tolerance angle and condensation ratio analysis
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of solar energy utilization. The invention provides a parabolic trough condenser design method based on tolerance angle and condensation ratio analysis, a parabolic trough condenser comprises a reflecting surface and a receiver, and the method comprises the following steps: S1, introducing a tolerance angle as a main control parameter, and establishing an initial one-dimensional model of the parabolic trough condenser; s2, on the basis of the initial one-dimensional model, determining receiver diameters and reflecting surface opening widths corresponding to different tolerance angles, and calculating a condensation ratio; s3, performing function fitting processing on the corresponding data of the tolerance angle and the condensation ratio; s4, according to the function relationship, using the condensation ratio to inversely calculate a tolerance angle, and using the tolerance angle, the receiver diameter and the opening width to construct a target one-dimensional model; and S5, converting the target one-dimensional model into a three-dimensional model to obtain the required parabolic trough condenser structure. According to the method, the rapid design of the parabolic trough condenser can be realized without depending on complex manual operation and empirical value selection, and the method has relatively high engineering application value and popularization significance.

title: Fixed solar spotlighting power supply device
abstract: A fixed solar spotlighting power supply device capable of being used day and night can perform high-power condensation on direct light and scattered light, generate electric energy and heat energy at the same time, continuously provide alternating current in the daytime and provide lighting at night, and comprises a large-condensation fixed condenser composed of a dome divergent Fresnel lens and a non-imaging solar condenser; the top of the transparent shell is provided with a dome divergent Fresnel lens, and the bottom of the transparent shell is provided with a transparent cover; at least one LED lamp or bulb; a solar thermal energy and photovoltaic hybrid receiver; at least one thermoelectric module; a thermal energy storage device; the battery pack is provided with a charger and a charging controller; and a micro inverter. Wherein the large-condensation fixed condenser is installed inside the transparent shell, and the LED lamp or the bulb is located between the large-condensation fixed condenser and the transparent shell. Daytime power generation and night illumination are realized.

title: Method for preparing boron-gallium co-doped modified silicon wafer by improving boron diffusion and application of boron-gallium co-doped modified silicon wafer
abstract: The invention discloses a method for preparing a boron-gallium co-doped modified silicon wafer by improving boron diffusion and application of the method, and belongs to the technical field of crystalline silicon solar cell manufacturing, and the method comprises the following steps: putting a phosphorus-doped silicon wafer into a tubular furnace, introducing BCl3 and GaCl3, then introducing oxygen, carrying out a replacement reaction, replacing boron and gallium elementary substance atoms, and diffusing and depositing the boron and gallium elementary substance atoms on the silicon wafer to obtain the boron-gallium co-doped modified silicon wafer. The boron-gallium co-doped modified silicon wafer is obtained; and placing the modified silicon wafer in a nitrogen atmosphere, performing high-temperature annealing, and activating boron and gallium impurities deposited on the surface of the silicon wafer. According to the invention, the diffusion activation energy of boron on the surface of a silicon wafer can be reduced through a boron and gallium co-doping mode, the boron is promoted to be more deeply diffused into the silicon, a uniform p + emitter is formed, and the time required by the same junction depth is shortened; during high-temperature annealing, gallium can migrate through an interstitial mechanism (Ga) and form a B-Ga complex with substitutive boron (B), so that boron diffusion activation energy is reduced, boron can be promoted to be deeper diffused into silicon, and a higher diffusion rate is obtained.

title: Energy storage system and method to improve battery performance by battery connection method
abstract: Two or more batteries may be in a switching para-series circuit arrangement where a set of batteries are connected, in both parallel and series arrangement in two independent phases, using fast switching devices, where the output to the load is the average voltage based on the duty cycles. Renewable energy power source such as solar panels may be coupled with batteries in parallel connection in a first phase and the same batteries connected in series to the load in a second phase, using transistor switches that, first, enables simultaneous charging and discharging of the batteries, and second, enables voltage shifting from the solar panel, as the additional batteries in series provide the required voltage to the load and where the duty cycles of charging and discharging is adjustable to convert the voltage waveform.

title: Photovoltaic tracking system based on solar time continuous driving and control method
abstract: The invention discloses a photovoltaic tracking system based on solar time continuous driving and a control method. The system comprises a sun time calculation unit, an angle feedback unit, a control unit, a brushless motor driving unit and an execution mechanism. The sun time calculation unit is used for calculating the sun position, the angle feedback unit collects the posture of the photovoltaic support, and the control unit generates a control instruction according to deviation. The brushless motor driving unit adopts FOC and SVPWM algorithms under closed-loop control, so that the motor realizes ultra-low-speed continuous operation in a range of 0.1-10 rpm, and still keeps operation when the deviation is smaller than a threshold value, thereby avoiding angle dead zone and cosine loss caused by intermittent start and stop. The actuating mechanism is driven to adjust the posture of the photovoltaic support, so that the photovoltaic support continuously follows the sun around the clock. According to the scheme, the tracking precision and the energy utilization rate are improved, and the method is suitable for single-axis and double-axis photovoltaic tracking scenes.

title: Control system of distributed sewage treatment device
abstract: The utility model discloses a control system of a distributed sewage treatment device, and belongs to the field of sewage treatment.The control system comprises a control cabinet body, a photovoltaic panel is arranged at the upper end of the control cabinet body, a PLC connected with the photovoltaic panel is arranged in the control cabinet body, a bidirectional inverter connected with the PLC is arranged in the control cabinet body, and the bidirectional inverter is connected with the PLC. A load end connected with the bidirectional inverter is arranged in the control cabinet body; and a battery pack connected with the bidirectional inverter is also arranged in the control cabinet body. Solar energy is converted into electric energy through the photovoltaic panel, a traditional power supply mode is replaced, energy consumption of the system is remarkably reduced, and the system conforms to the green and low-carbon environmental protection concept. Redundant electric energy is stored by using the battery pack, so that the waste of the electric energy is avoided, and the operation cost of the system is reduced. Due to the bidirectional flow function of the bidirectional inverter, the system can stably operate when the electric energy supply is insufficient or excessive, and the reliability of the system is improved.

title: Hot water heat storage tank of photo-thermal hot water absorption heat pump
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of solar heat utilization, in particular to a hot water heat storage tank of a photo-thermal hot water absorption heat pump. The system comprises a solar water heater and a first-stage hot water heat storage tank installed on the solar water heater, the first-stage hot water heat storage tank is connected with an absorption heat pump through a hot water pipeline of the first-stage hot water heat storage tank, and the system further comprises at least one independently-arranged second-stage hot water heat storage tank. And the second-stage hot water heat storage tank is connected with the absorption heat pump through a hot water pipeline of the second-stage hot water heat storage tank and a hot water pipeline of the first-stage hot water heat storage tank. According to the hot water heat storage tank system of the photo-thermal hot water absorption heat pump, at least two hot water supply pipelines are adopted, the operation mode of the system is freely switched under the condition that the absorption heat pump works or is idle, the annual utilization rate of a solar water heater can be remarkably improved, the application range of the solar water heater is expanded, and the energy consumption is reduced. Heating in winter and refrigerating in non-heating seasons.

title: Self-resetting solar warning pile capable of customizing rotation angle
abstract: The invention discloses a self-resetting solar warning pile with a customizable rotation angle, which comprises a warning pile base, a side plate is in butt joint with the top surface of the warning pile base, and a perforated steel plate is horizontally arranged on the top surface of the side plate, so that the probability that the warning pile is damaged after being impacted is reduced, the subsequent maintenance cost and frequency are reduced, and the service life of the warning pile is prolonged. And the service life and the economic benefit of the warning pile are improved. An outer solar panel and a top solar panel are arranged at the top of the warning pile and can convert solar energy into electric energy and store the electric energy in a storage battery. Under the control of the timing switch controller, the warning lamp can be automatically turned on under the condition that no street lamp exists at night or the street lamp is damaged. Four lamps are fixed on each cross section, and the lamps are uniformly distributed on the side surface of the warning pile at intervals of 90 degrees, so that the visibility of the warning pile at night is greatly improved, vehicles and pedestrians are effectively reminded to pay attention, and traffic accidents caused by poor sight are reduced.

title: Solar cell suction cup
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of fixing supports, in particular to a solar cell sucker. The suction cup comprises a suction cup body, a fixing device is arranged outside the suction cup body, the fixing device comprises an inner groove frame, the top end of the inner groove frame is fixedly connected with the suction cup body, two rubber rings are fixedly connected to the inner side of the inner groove frame, and inner threaded rings are fixedly connected to the two sides of the inner groove frame. And bolts are in threaded connection with the interiors of the internal threaded rings, supporting blocks are in threaded connection with the arc surfaces of the bolts, fixing frames are fixedly connected to the ends, close to each other, of the two supporting blocks, and sealing rings are fixedly connected to one sides of the fixing frames. The solar cell suction cup solves the problems that according to a traditional solar cell suction cup, a sealing ring is inconvenient to replace, the maintenance difficulty is increased when the sealing ring is aged, damaged or needs to be replaced regularly, and maintenance personnel need to spend more time and energy to complete replacement work.

title: Energy management optimization method and system based on ship microgrid
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of ship power system energy management, and particularly discloses an energy management optimization method and system based on a ship microgrid, and the system comprises a photovoltaic power generation unit, an energy storage unit, and a diesel generator unit. The photovoltaic power generation unit is provided with a maximum power point tracking controller to achieve the maximum utilization rate of solar energy, the energy storage unit comprises a storage battery and a bidirectional power converter, the charge state is monitored in real time, a safety threshold value is set, and the diesel generator unit serves as a standby power supply. Based on an improved logic threshold control mechanism, a photovoltaic power generation unit is used as a main energy source and works at a maximum power point; the energy storage battery is a secondary buffer unit, a charge state safety threshold value is set, dynamic charging and discharging are carried out, and when photovoltaic output is surplus and the storage battery does not reach the upper limit, surplus electric energy is stored in the storage battery.

title: Perovskite layer and preparation method thereof, solar cell and photovoltaic module
abstract: The invention discloses a perovskite layer and a preparation method thereof, a solar cell and a photovoltaic module, the perovskite layer is formed by reaction of a lead halide framework layer and a cation solution, the lead halide framework layer comprises lead halide and 5-aminoorotic acid, and the mass ratio of the 5-aminoorotic acid to the lead halide is 1: (10-20). By adding the 5-aminoorotic acid, the residual lead iodide at the bottom of the lead halide framework layer can be effectively reduced, and the crystallization effect of the perovskite layer is improved, so that the energy conversion efficiency of the solar cell is improved.

title: PV/T combined cooling heating and power system
abstract: The utility model discloses a PV/T combined cooling heating and power system, which relates to the technical field of solar energy utilization, and aims to solve the problem that the existing PVT combined cooling heating and power system cannot be well used when being used. A refrigerant outlet of a PV/T assembly is sequentially connected with a compressor, a water tank I and a throttle valve through a pipeline via a valve V; the valve I is connected with a refrigerant inlet of the PV/T assembly; a refrigerant outlet of the throttle valve is connected with a refrigerant inlet of the outdoor fan; a refrigerant outlet pipeline of the outdoor fan is connected with an inlet of the compressor through a valve VI; a water outlet in one side above the first water tank is connected with a water inlet in the lower side of the first water tank through a first water pump, a second water tank and a fourth valve in sequence; a water outlet in the other side above the first water tank is connected with a water outlet in the lower side of the first water tank through a second water pump, a third water tank and a third valve in sequence; a water outlet in the lower side of the water tank is connected with a water inlet in the lower side of the water tank through a second valve, a third water pump and an absorption refrigerating unit.

title: Micro-channel PVT heat collection evaporator comprehensively utilizing solar energy and air energy and heat pump system
abstract: The invention discloses a micro-channel type PVT heat collection evaporator comprehensively utilizing solar energy and air energy and a heat pump system, and relates to the technical field of PVT heat pumps. The PVT heat collection evaporator comprises a photovoltaic panel, heat conduction silica gel, a ribbed micro-channel heat exchanger, a rear cover plate and a fan which are sequentially arranged from top to bottom. Wherein the photovoltaic panel and the ribbed micro-channel heat exchanger are bonded through heat-conducting silica gel; the rear cover plate is bonded with the photovoltaic panel through EVA glue. The fan is mounted on the rear cover plate through bolts; a low-temperature refrigerant is arranged in the ribbed micro-channel heat exchanger, an oil return pipe is arranged on the side, close to an outlet, of the bottom of the heat exchanger, and the oil return pipe is used for collecting and conveying lubricating oil deposited due to the gravity effect. The technical problems that an existing PVT heat pump is low in energy utilization rate, low in building roof space utilization rate, low in evaporation temperature and difficult in oil return can be solved, the resource utilization variety is rich and comprehensive, the building roof space is reasonably planned, and the heat exchange performance is comprehensively improved.

title: Solar photovoltaic support and solar photovoltaic system
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of solar photovoltaic, and particularly relates to a solar photovoltaic support and a solar photovoltaic system.The solar photovoltaic support comprises a support assembly used for installing and adjusting a photovoltaic panel, a guide rail is arranged on the support assembly, a cleaning part is slidably connected in the guide rail, and an installation plate, a liquid storage tank and an auxiliary cleaning mechanism are arranged on the support assembly; the support assembly comprises a base column, a fixing column is fixedly connected to the top of the base column, and a supporting frame is rotationally connected to the fixing column. According to the solar photovoltaic support and the solar photovoltaic system, through the use of the support assembly, the telescopic end of the electric telescopic rod stretches out and draws back so that the orientation of the photovoltaic panel can be adjusted, the light energy conversion efficiency of the photovoltaic panel can be improved, in the orientation adjusting process of the photovoltaic panel, the cleaning piece can slide on the guide rail to clean the photovoltaic panel, and the cleaning efficiency is improved. Inconvenience and danger of manual cleaning are avoided, the surface of the photovoltaic panel is continuously kept clean, efficient absorption of sunlight is ensured, and the power generation efficiency is stably improved.

title: Electron transport material, preparation method thereof, solar cell and photovoltaic module
abstract: The invention discloses an electron transport material and a preparation method thereof, a solar cell and a photovoltaic module, the electron transport material for the perovskite solar cell comprises TiO2 and a doping material, and the doping material comprises noble metal nanoparticles and carbon quantum dots loaded on the surface of TiO2, and nickel and cobalt co-doped in crystal lattices of TiO2. Through the combined action of the precious metal nanoparticles, the carbon quantum dots and the nickel-cobalt co-doped TiO2, photon-generated carrier separation is promoted, the electron mobility is improved, meanwhile, light utilization and absorption of perovskite are promoted, and the effect of further improving the energy conversion efficiency of the solar cell is remarkable.

title: Suspension type aquatic organism suction and conveying device in water
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of water source water taking and cleaning, and discloses an underwater suspension type aquatic organism suction conveying device which comprises a suction conveying device body, a support is fixedly installed on the upper surface of the suction conveying device body, and a solar photovoltaic panel is fixedly installed at the top end of the support. The suction conveying device comprises a suction conveying device body, a storage battery is fixedly installed in the suction conveying device body, and a buoy is fixedly installed on the surface of the suction conveying device body. According to the water suspension type aquatic organism suction conveying device, through cooperative arrangement of a solar photovoltaic panel and the storage battery, when the water suspension type aquatic organism suction conveying device is used, the solar photovoltaic panel is used for absorbing solar energy and converting the solar energy into electric energy; the embedded waterproof LED lamp tube is arranged in a matched mode, the embedded waterproof LED lamp tube is connected with a power source in the using process, then the lamp is turned on, and therefore the illumination effect is achieved.

title: Cable well lid
abstract: The utility model discloses a cable well lid which comprises a cover plate, an energy storage battery is arranged in the cover plate, a solar cell panel is arranged on the top of the cover plate, the solar cell panel and the energy storage battery are connected through a DC-DC converter, the cable well lid is fixed to a cable well through a locking piece, and the cable well lid is fixed to the cable well through the locking piece. The locking piece penetrates into the cover plate from one side of the cover plate and penetrates out of the cover plate from the other side of the cover plate. According to the utility model, electric energy is obtained through combination of solar energy electricity taking and power transmission line induction electricity taking, when the induction electricity taking is not stable, the energy storage battery can still supply power, and the sheath circulating current on-line monitoring device is prevented from being off-line; the cable well lid is fixed to the cable well through the locking piece, the anti-theft function of the cable well lid is achieved, and meanwhile the connection reliability of the cable well lid and the cable well is improved.

title: Novel purline structure and photovoltaic support
abstract: The utility model provides a novel purline structure and a photovoltaic support, which are used for connecting a photovoltaic assembly and a support cross beam, and comprise a purline body, the purline body is formed by a metal plate with a U-shaped cross section, and the purline body is provided with a first mounting surface, a first side wall, a fixed surface, a second side wall and a second mounting surface which are connected in sequence; a height difference exists between the first mounting surface and the second mounting surface and is used for obliquely mounting the photovoltaic module; and the fixed surface is fixedly mounted with the supporting cross beam. According to the scheme, each purline body is provided with the first installation face and the second installation face, the height difference exists between the first installation faces and the second installation faces, the multiple groups of purline bodies are erected on the supporting cross beams in parallel, the photovoltaic assemblies are erected between every two adjacent purline bodies, and one sides of the photovoltaic assemblies are fixedly connected with the first installation faces of one group of purline bodies. And the other side of the photovoltaic module is fixedly connected with the second mounting surface of the other group of purline main bodies, so that the inclined mounting of the photovoltaic module is realized, and the utilization efficiency of solar energy is improved.

title: Operation method of solar circulating pulse sprinkling irrigation device coupled with compressed air energy storage
abstract: The invention discloses an operation method of a solar circulating pulse sprinkling irrigation device coupled with compressed air energy storage. The operation method comprises the following specific steps: step 1, constructing a water pump flow equation under the combined action of actual output power and outlet back pressure of a solar cell panel; 2, calculating the actual output power of the solar cell panel under any irradiance and environment temperature; 3, determining the change rule of the outlet back pressure value of the water pump; step 4, establishing a nozzle working pressure change rule and calculating the water spraying amount of primary pulse spraying; 5, the pulse spraying period duration in different time periods is calculated; 6, the daily water extraction amount is obtained through calculation; and 7, determining the irrigation starting time and irrigation duration of the solar circulating pulse sprinkling irrigation device coupled with compressed air energy storage. The method solves the problem of non-uniform irrigation caused by incomplete consideration factors of an existing operation method.

title: Breeding equipment and method for small fig bee larvae
abstract: The invention discloses a breeding device and method for small fig bee larvae, and relates to the technical field of small fig bee larva breeding. The breeding equipment comprises a main supporting column, a supporting frame fixed to the top of the main supporting column and artificial ficus microcarpa, a solar panel for providing energy is fixed to the top of the supporting frame, the supporting frame is covered with tarpaulin, a door curtain is installed on the front face of the tarpaulin, and the door curtain is connected with the main supporting column. The door curtain is provided with a protection assembly for changing the invasion rate of the parasitoid wasps, a driving assembly for removing the parasitoid wasps invading into the tarpaulin is arranged in the tarpaulin, abnormal behaviors or physiological pressure caused by an artificial environment is reduced, and the device can be used for conservation of endangered banyan trees or pollination bees in urban greening or help to recover a damaged pollination network. The negative influence caused by climate change is relieved, a quantitative technical standard is provided for cultivation of the microcarps for the first time, the history of'cultivation by experience 'is ended, and industrialization and standardization of cultivation of the microcarps are promoted.

title: Pool base station
abstract: A pool base station comprises a solar power supply module and a water quality detection module, the solar power supply module is arranged on the upper portion of the pool base station and used for supplying power to the water quality detection module, and the water quality detection module is arranged below the solar power supply module and used for supplying power to the water quality detection module. The pool base station can float on the water surface or suspend in water when working, and the water quality detection module is located below the waterline. The pool base station disclosed by the utility model can float on the water surface or suspend in water when working, the solar power supply module on the pool base station can receive and convert solar energy to supply power to the pool base station, green energy is adopted, and the working time of the pool base station is prolonged. In the working state, the water quality detection module is located below the waterline so that the water quality detection module can make full contact with pool water, and the accuracy of the detection result is improved.

title: Automatic cooling device used in automobile and system thereof
abstract: The invention provides an automatic cooling device and system used in an automobile, and relates to the field of automobile cooling, the automatic cooling device comprises an energy transmitting unit arranged outside the automobile, an energy receiving unit arranged in the automobile and a cooling unit arranged in the automobile, and the cooling unit comprises a cooling execution device connected with the output end of a rectifying and voltage stabilizing circuit; a clamping base is fixedly installed at the bottom of the solar cell panel, a detachable adsorption fixing mechanism is connected to the bottom of the clamping base, and the adsorption fixing mechanism is used for fixedly installing the solar cell panel on a car roof. The solar panel is arranged outside the vehicle, and the area and the installation position (such as a vehicle roof) can be selected according to needs so as to obtain the maximum illumination intensity and the maximum power generation efficiency which are far better than those of a miniature solar panel arranged in the vehicle; the wireless power supply technology is adopted, energy can penetrate through an automobile shell (such as automobile window glass or an automobile roof iron sheet) to be transmitted, drilling and wiring on an automobile body are not needed, the problems of sealing, water leakage, attractiveness and the like are thoroughly solved, and mounting and dismounting are extremely convenient and fast.

title: Multi-energy power generation system optimal configuration method based on genetic algorithm
abstract: The invention discloses a multi-energy power generation system optimization configuration method based on a genetic algorithm, and the method comprises the following steps: constructing a wind power, photovoltaic, thermal power and energy storage complementary power generation system model, calculating the initial investment cost apportionment, the operation maintenance cost, the thermal power fuel total cost and the equipment replacement cost apportionment of the power generation system model, and determining the annual value AC of project cost; calculating a wind curtailment and light curtailment rate and a green electricity proportion, setting constraint conditions, and optimizing the power generation system model through a genetic algorithm; according to the method, the limitation of fixed-proportion configuration of each energy in a traditional mode is broken through, and dynamic optimal configuration of energy storage and thermal power capacity is realized for a wind-solar-thermal storage integrated project; through a multi-energy cooperative power supply mode, an energy storage system plays a regulating role to stabilize power supply, wind and light clean energy is preferentially utilized, and meanwhile, stable and reliable operation of a power grid is guaranteed by combining wind and light abandoning rate and green power proportion constraint control.

title: Solar-driven CO2 capture cracking catalyst, preparation method and application
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of preparation of catalysts, in particular to a solar-driven CO2 trapping and cracking catalyst, a preparation method and application, and the solar-driven CO2 trapping and cracking catalyst comprises the following components in parts by mass: 50-70 parts of a solid metal-based carrier precursor, 10-15 parts of a metal salt solution, 5-8 parts of a modified impregnation liquid, 20-30 parts of a reaction medium and 8-12 parts of a modified doping liquid. Through the one-step hydrothermal synthesis and co-impregnation process, the preparation process is simplified, the traditional complex process of separation after CO2 capture is omitted, the comprehensive cost is reduced by more than 30%, and the traditional high-energy-consumption carbon dioxide pressure swing adsorption and temperature swing adsorption technology is completely eliminated.

title: Methanol filling ship hybrid propulsion system
abstract: The utility model discloses a hybrid propulsion system of a methanol filling ship, which comprises three first dual-fuel generators, a second dual-fuel generator, four sets of lithium battery packs, a solar photovoltaic panel, a controller and an electric equipment group, the three first dual-fuel generators and the second dual-fuel generator are arranged in parallel and are electrically connected with the controller respectively; the four sets of lithium battery packs, the solar photovoltaic panel and the plurality of electric equipment are electrically connected with the controller; the electric equipment group comprises a side thrust motor, at least one main propulsion motor, at least one cargo oil pump and at least one marine daily power supply which are electrically connected with the controller respectively; the three first dual-fuel generators and the second dual-fuel generator can adopt methanol as fuel, the power of the first dual-fuel generators is larger than that of the second dual-fuel generator, the mode that diesel oil is adopted as driving fuel in the past is replaced, and the problems that energy consumption is high and environmental protection performance is insufficient in the past are solved.

title: Multi-stage solar interface water purifying device
abstract: The utility model belongs to the technical field of water treatment, in particular relates to a multi-stage solar interface water purifying device, and aims to solve the problems that water drops are formed by cooling steam, heat is dissipated on a collector when the steam is converted into the water drops, latent heat of condensation is not fully utilized, and the efficiency is relatively low, the multi-stage solar interface water purifying device comprises a box body, a top cover is connected to the top of the box body in an inserted mode, the top of the top cover is in an arc shape and used for water drop flowing, collecting boxes used for collecting water drops are arranged on the inner walls of the two sides of the box body, two supporting plates are fixedly arranged on the bottom wall of the box body, and a floating space is formed between the supporting plates and the box body. A photo-thermal composite generator for heating seawater is arranged in the seawater storage tank; according to the utility model, through the multi-stage evaporation and heat recovery technology, the water purification efficiency is remarkably improved, the energy consumption and the cost are reduced, and meanwhile, the used clean energy and the efficient water purification process also meet the environmental protection requirements of the modern society, so that the water purification device has remarkable economic benefits and social benefits.

title: Solar monitoring vehicle with adjustable function
abstract: The utility model provides a solar monitoring vehicle with an adjustable function, which relates to the technical field of solar monitoring vehicles, and comprises a transmission mechanism, the transmission mechanism comprises a motor fixedly connected to one side of the inner wall of a box body, the upper end of the motor is movably connected with a rotating shaft, the outer wall of one side of the rotating shaft is fixedly connected with a connecting rod, and the connecting rod is movably connected with the inner wall of the box body. A movable block is fixedly connected to one side of the outer wall of the rotating shaft, a fixed plate is movably connected to one side of the outer wall of the rotating shaft, a rotating rod is movably connected to the upper end of the fixed plate, a rotating block is fixedly connected to the outer wall of the rotating rod, a first connecting groove is formed in the outer wall of the rotating block, and a second connecting groove is formed in the outer wall of the rotating block. According to the utility model, the problems of low light energy absorption efficiency and influence on the continuous power supply capability of equipment caused by the fact that most solar panels of the conventional solar monitoring vehicle are fixedly mounted and are difficult to flexibly adjust according to the change of solar rays are solved.

title: Power supply device and charging method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a power supply device and a charging method thereof. The power supply device comprises a base; the driving assembly is arranged on the base, and the driving assembly comprises a first driving part and a second driving part; the solar cell panels are located on the two sides, in the width direction, of the base and are in power connection with the driving assembly, each solar cell panel comprises a first panel body and a second panel body, the first panel body is in power connection with the first driving piece, and the end of the first panel body is in linkage with the end of the second panel body through a connecting piece; the connecting piece is in power connection with the second driving piece; the driving assembly is suitable for driving the first plate body and the second plate body to act through the first driving piece and the second driving piece so that the solar cell panel can be switched between unfolding and folding. The power supply device supplies power to the energy supplementing facility through the solar cell panel, and the solar cell panel can be switched between expansion and contraction to cope with different environments, so that the stability and reliability of power supply are ensured.

title: Hydrogen storage system and hydrogen storage method
abstract: The invention provides a hydrogen storage system and a hydrogen storage method, and belongs to the technical field of green hydrogen storage. The hydrogen storage system comprises an energy conversion unit suitable for converting solar energy and/or wind energy into electric energy; the water electrolysis hydrogen production unit is suitable for preparing hydrogen in a water electrolysis mode by utilizing the electric energy output by the energy conversion unit; and the methane synthesis unit is communicated with the water electrolysis hydrogen production unit and is suitable for enabling the hydrogen from the water electrolysis hydrogen production unit to react with the introduced coke and obtaining a mixed gas containing methane, so that the chemical energy of the hydrogen is transferred into the methane to be stored. According to the invention, coke is used as a medium for hydrogen storage and transportation, and the coke is consumed through green hydrogen, so that methane with high added value is produced, and the problems of high cost, poor safety and the like in hydrogen storage and transportation are solved.

title: Photo-thermal heat storage composite phase change material and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to a photo-thermal heat storage composite phase change material which comprises the following components in percentage by mass: 86.4-97% of inorganic hydrated salt, 2-8.8% of an additive and 1-4.8% of a carbon-based material, the carbon-based material comprises at least one of carbon black, graphite carbon, graphene, carbon nanotubes or carbonized cellulose. Due to the carbon-based material structure, the heat conduction performance of the photo-thermal heat storage composite phase change material is improved, the heat storage efficiency is improved, the broadband light absorption characteristic is brought by introduction of the carbon-based material, absorption of the photo-thermal heat storage composite phase change material to solar spectrums can be enhanced, the photo-thermal conversion efficiency can be improved, and the photo-thermal conversion efficiency is improved. Light energy is effectively converted into heat energy under illumination, and then the phase change process is driven for heat storage.

title: Method for solving Brayton cycle transient process of tower type solar supercritical carbon dioxide
abstract: The invention discloses a method for solving a Brayton cycle transient process of tower type solar supercritical carbon dioxide, belongs to the technical field of transient analysis and calculation of a solar photo-thermal power generation system, and solves the problems that transient response of an integrated system is difficult to capture due to solar intermittency, transient maintenance is difficult due to physical property distortion of a supercritical CO2 critical point, and the transient response is difficult to capture. And existing steady-state/quasi-steady-state analysis neglects transient characteristics and lacks a multi-configuration Brayton cycle transient solving method. The method comprises the following steps: firstly, initializing an integrated system parameter and a Brayton cycle configuration, and then carrying out side-by-side iteration: dispersing a conservation equation of a molten salt side cold tank, a heat collector and the like, calculating the state of the conservation equation, and judging temperature convergence; and then the parameters of the intermediate heat exchanger are taken as boundaries, the CO2 side Brayton cycle equation is discretized to calculate the parameters, internal energy convergence is judged, and iteration is carried out until the final calculation time is reached. According to the method, the Brayton cycle transient process of the tower type solar supercritical CO2 is accurately captured, calculation is simplified, precision is guaranteed, and a multi-cycle configuration is supported.

title: All-inorganic multilayer film with broadband radiation refrigeration performance
abstract: The invention discloses a design and preparation method of an all-inorganic multilayer film for broadband radiative refrigeration, the multilayer film has a similar one-dimensional photonic crystal film layer structure, and belongs to the technical field of optical function materials and energy conservation. The thin film adopts a four-layer alternate SiO2/Al2O3 film layer structure, the uppermost layer is a Si3N4 coupling layer, the bottom layer is an Ag reflecting layer protected by AlN, the emissivity of an atmospheric window is enhanced through impedance mismatch of a high-refractive-index layer and a low-refractive-index layer, and the mid-infrared radiance is improved through the Si3N4 phonon coupling effect and the refractive index gradient design. The low-refractive-index layer is thinned, and the mid-infrared emission spectrum is widened through coherent interference of the high-refractive-index layer. The solar spectral reflectivity of the film layer structure is 97.42%, the atmospheric window emissivity is 90.65%, the broadband infrared emissivity is 90.59%, and the thermal stability reaches up to 1450 DEG C. According to the multilayer film, cooling at the highest temperature of 10.9 DEG C in the horizontal direction and at the highest temperature of 3.2 DEG C in the vertical direction is achieved in the actual environment, and the net cooling power is 288W/m < 2 >. The material is suitable for building energy saving, electronic device heat dissipation and spacecraft heat management, overcomes the defect that a traditional inorganic material is poor in spectral selectivity, and provides an innovative radiation refrigeration cooling scheme.

title: Solar power supply device for oil field well site pressure driving equipment
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of power supply devices, and discloses a solar power supply device for oil field well site pressure driving equipment, which comprises a bottom plate, the top of the bottom plate is fixedly connected with a supporting plate, the inner wall of the supporting plate is rotatably connected with a rotating shaft, and the circumferential surface of the rotating shaft is fixedly connected with a fixing frame. The device comprises a fixed frame, the top of the fixed frame is fixedly connected with a photovoltaic panel, the front part of the photovoltaic panel is fixedly connected with a long plate, the inner wall of the long plate is rotatably connected with a threaded rod, the circumferential surface of the threaded rod is in threaded connection with a protective frame, and the inner wall of the protective frame is rotatably connected with a rotating rod. The brush roller rotates to treat impurities such as oil dirt and dust accumulated on the surface of the photovoltaic panel, so that the photovoltaic panel can effectively absorb sunlight, the impurities are prevented from blocking the surface of the photovoltaic panel, it is ensured that the power generation efficiency is at the optimal level, and sufficient energy is provided for pressure driving equipment.

title: Campus composite heat pump hot water system
abstract: The utility model discloses a campus composite heat pump hot water system which comprises a photovoltaic device, a hot water device and a night water storage tank and is characterized by further comprising a daily water storage tank with the water storage capacity smaller than that of the night water storage tank, and the hot water device is an air source heat pump. The power output end of the photovoltaic device is connected to a power interface of the air source heat pump through a photovoltaic drive circuit, and the power interface of the air source heat pump is further connected with a mains supply drive circuit connected with the photovoltaic drive circuit in parallel. The solar water heater has the advantages of better meeting the hot water use requirement of the campus, saving more energy and reducing more consumption.

title: Door and window and hollow glass with solar energy
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of door and window devices, in particular to a door and window and hollow glass with solar energy, which comprises a door and window frame and a door and window frame, a pair of hinge devices is fixedly connected between the door and window frame and the door and window frame, the door and window frame is rotatably connected with the door and window frame, and the hollow glass is fixedly connected to the end face of the door and window frame. The hollow glass comprises an outer glass plate and an inner glass plate, a rectangular sealing strip is fixedly connected between the outer glass plate and the inner glass plate, a solar device is arranged on the inner glass plate, and the solar device is arranged on the side, away from the hinge device, outside the rectangular sealing strip. The solar glass window aims at solving the problems that in an existing solar glass window, the integration degree of a solar device and hollow glass is insufficient, and the integration degree is not high, and has the beneficial effects of being high in integration degree and integration degree.

title: Solar fan cap
abstract: The solar fan cap comprises a cap body and a fan, a connecting base is arranged on the fan, an opening is formed in the connecting base, a rotating piece and a solar power supply module are arranged on the cap body, the rotating piece comprises a ball head, an arc face matched with the ball head is arranged on the inner wall of the opening of the connecting base, and the diameter of the opening is smaller than that of the ball head. The fan is arranged on the cap body, so that the ball head can be clamped and kept in the cambered surface to form spherical hinge connection, multi-angle adjustment and fixation of the fan relative to the cap body are achieved, meanwhile, the solar power supply module is electrically connected with the fan and supplies power to the fan, and a user can easily conduct up-and-down, left-and-right and inclined all-dimensional adjustment and accurate directional air supply on the fan. Meanwhile, the solar power supply module is integrated, light energy can be continuously converted into electric energy to charge the fan and the standby battery pack, infinite endurance can be achieved theoretically when sunlight is sufficient, dependence on external charging is greatly reduced, the trouble of frequently replacing a battery is avoided, and more energy conservation and environmental protection are achieved.

title: Carbazole polymer hole transport material applied to trans-perovskite solar cell
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of organic photoelectric polymer materials, and discloses a carbazole polymer hole transport material applied to trans-perovskite solar cells, and the polymer adopts a molecular chain as a skeleton structure, and the molecular chain is formed by connecting carbazole and 3, 3 '-benzo [e] cyclopenta [b] indole substituted p-terphenyl. According to the invention, the chemical structure of the hole transport material is improved; the carbazole polymer is formed by replacing p-terphenyl with 3, 3 ''-benzo [e] cyclopenta [b] indole as a skeleton structure, and the carbazole polymer is applied to a trans-structure perovskite solar cell as a non-doped hole transport material, so that the carbazole polymer not only has high light transmission, but also can promote the growth of perovskite to obtain high energy conversion efficiency, and can be used as a hole transport material for the trans-structure perovskite solar cell. Therefore, the technical problem that an existing trans-perovskite solar cell is low in efficiency is solved.

title: Energy-saving photovoltaic glass curtain wall for building
abstract: The invention relates to an energy-saving photovoltaic glass curtain wall for a building, and relates to the technical field of building curtain walls, the energy-saving photovoltaic glass curtain wall for the building comprises a frame, the frame is fixedly arranged in a building wall, a plurality of first rotating mechanisms are rotatably arranged in the frame, second rotating mechanisms for placing glass assemblies are rotatably arranged in the first rotating mechanisms, and a first cavity opening is formed in the frame; two first locking mechanisms used for controlling the first rotating mechanism to rotate are symmetrically arranged in first cavity openings in the two ends of the frame correspondingly, the first locking mechanisms abut against the first rotating mechanism, and two second locking mechanisms used for controlling the second rotating mechanism to rotate are symmetrically arranged in the first rotating mechanism correspondingly. The first rotating mechanism is abutted to control rotation or locking of the first rotating mechanism; the second locking mechanisms are symmetrically arranged in the first rotating mechanism, and the second locking mechanisms abut against the second rotating mechanisms to control the second rotating mechanisms to rotate or lock the second rotating mechanisms, so that the local glass curtain wall can be conveniently opened or closed, and the solar panel can be conveniently adjusted to a proper illumination angle.

title: Special charging mechanism for photovoltaic cleaning robot
abstract: The invention provides a special charging mechanism for a photovoltaic cleaning robot, and relates to the technical field of solar energy industry, the special charging mechanism comprises a pile body, when a sweeping robot approaches and pushes a contact plate, a push block moves forward to jack up a lifting plate through the transmission effect of a toothed bar and a gear, so that an electrode plate extends out of a communication groove and is in contact with the robot for charging; after charging is completed, by means of a spring reset mechanism, the electrode plate automatically retracts into the bottom groove and is shielded again, automatic stretching and protection of the electrode plate are achieved through mechanical linkage, safety and durability in a non-charging state are remarkably improved, the hidden danger of electric leakage is reduced, and the service life of the battery is prolonged. The problems that an exposed electrode of a charging device is directly exposed to an external environment in a non-charging state, the exposed electrode is easily damaged due to collision and corrosion and has an electric leakage risk, dust and other impurities in an outdoor environment are easily attached to the surface of the electrode, the conductivity is affected, an effective protection structure is lacked, and the service life of the charging device is prolonged are solved. And the safety and the durability of the electrode plate in a non-charging state are poor.

title: Household photovoltaic energy storage power supply device
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of solar energy, in particular to a household photovoltaic energy storage power supply device. The household photovoltaic energy storage power supply device comprises a building balcony, the building balcony comprises a first guardrail, a second guardrail and a third guardrail, and the second guardrail and the third guardrail are arranged on the two sides of the first guardrail respectively; the photovoltaic module is used for solar power generation, and the photovoltaic module moves above the first guardrail; and the overturning structure is arranged between the photovoltaic module and the building balcony and is used for driving the photovoltaic module to overturn around the first guardrail. The beneficial effects of the utility model are that through the design of the overturning structure, the photovoltaic assembly can be protected from being damaged by rainwater and dirt, the cleaning state of the photovoltaic assembly is maintained, and the cleaning difficulty and the maintenance cost are reduced, so that the long-term stability and high-efficiency operation of a photovoltaic power generation structure are ensured, and the overall power generation efficiency is improved.

title: Preparation method of polylactic acid-based nano-filtration fiber membrane with efficient natural photothermal conversion efficiency
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of a polylactic acid-based nano-filtration fiber membrane with efficient natural photothermal conversion efficiency, and belongs to the field of membranes. The specific preparation process comprises the following steps: firstly, preparing molybdenum disulfide nano particles, and then coating the surfaces of the molybdenum disulfide nano particles with a polydopamine (PDA) layer to obtain nano particles with a core-shell structure so as to improve the dispersity of the nano particles in an electrostatic spinning solution and improve the compatibility and interfacial force with a polymer matrix; then modifying copper sulfide nanoparticles on the outer surface of the polydopamine to construct composite photo-thermal conversion particles with a core-shell-satellite structure; finally, polylactic acid is used as a base material, and the nano-filtration fiber membrane is obtained through an electrostatic spinning technology.
