By utilizing different absorption characteristics of CuS, PDA, MoS2 and polylactic acid to light with different energy, through the design of the multi-layer structure of the photo-thermal conversion particles, the multi-component efficient synergistic effect is fully exerted, the full absorption and utilization of wide-spectrum sunlight are realized, and the solar energy-thermal energy conversion efficiency is remarkably improved.

title: Modularized solar heat collection roof of green building
abstract: The invention provides a green building modular solar heat collection roof, and relates to the technical field of building construction, the green building modular solar heat collection roof comprises a base plate, a first motor is arranged on the base plate, a driving shaft is arranged at the upper end of the first motor, a rotating plate is arranged at the upper end of the driving shaft, and a mounting plate, a fixing block and a second motor are arranged on the upper surface of the rotating plate; a mounting hole is formed in the mounting plate, a solar heat collecting plate is arranged in the mounting hole, a screw is arranged at the output end of the second motor, one end of the screw is rotatably connected with a fixed block, a moving block is slidably arranged on the upper surface of the rotating plate and is in threaded transmission connection with the outer wall of the screw through a threaded hole, and a connecting rod is arranged between the moving block and the mounting plate. According to the solar heat collection device, the azimuth angle of the solar heat collection plate can be adjusted by driving the rotating plate to rotate through the first motor, and the inclination angle of the solar heat collection plate can be adjusted through movement of the moving block, so that the solar heat collection plate is aligned to the sun at a better angle, and the absorption and conversion efficiency of solar energy is greatly improved.

title: Off-grid hydrogen energy poly-generation system based on renewable energy sources
abstract: The utility model relates to an off-grid hydrogen energy poly-generation system based on renewable energy sources. The off-grid hydrogen energy poly-generation system comprises a power supply module, an electrochemical energy storage device, a hydrogen storage tank, a hydrogen production module, a hydrogen fuel cell and a heat exchange module, the output end of the power supply module is respectively connected with the input end of the hydrogen production module and the electrochemical energy storage module through a power bus; the input end of the hydrogen production module is connected with seawater, and the output end of the hydrogen production module is connected with the input ends of the hydrogen storage tank and the hydrogen fuel cell and the input end of the heat exchange module; the hydrogen fuel cell is connected with the heat exchange module; the heat exchange module is used for heating fresh water output by the hydrogen production module. According to the system, various renewable energy sources such as wind energy and solar energy are integrated, the problems of intermittency and instability of a single energy source are effectively solved through unified allocation of the power bus, and the reliability of energy supply is improved. By means of the seawater desalination device, the system can directly obtain fresh water from seawater, the problems that island fresh water supply is unstable and cost is high are solved, and meanwhile drinking water and hot water are provided for residents.

title: Heliostat field layout optimization method, equipment, medium and product
abstract: The invention discloses a heliostat field layout optimization method and device, a medium and a product, and relates to the field of photo-thermal power generation. The method comprises the following steps of: discretizing a solar cone into a plurality of light rays, simulating a propagation path of the light rays in a heliostat field by adopting a Monte Carlo ray tracing method, and further calculating shadow shielding efficiency and heat collector cutoff efficiency; calculating the comprehensive optical efficiency of the single-sided heliostats in the heliostat field according to the shadow shielding efficiency and the heat collector cut-off efficiency, and further calculating the annual average optical efficiency and the annual average output heat power of the heliostat field; the annual average optical efficiency and the annual average output thermal power are used as objective functions of a non-dominated sorting genetic algorithm, heliostat field layout is optimized, and a Pareto optimal solution set is obtained; and a weighted maximum satisfaction method is adopted to make a decision, and an optimal layout scheme of the heliostat field is selected from the Pareto optimal solution set. By improving the accuracy of optical efficiency calculation in the heliostat field layout optimization process, the energy efficiency of the heliostat field is maximized.

title: Solar cell grid line mask tool
abstract: The utility model discloses a solar cell grid line mask tool, which is characterized by comprising a film coating bottom plate, a film coating pressing frame, a pressing strip and a mask strip, the film coating bottom plate is provided with a cell placing table corresponding to the size of a cell, the side edge of the cell placing table is provided with a cell positioning clamping strip, and the cell positioning clamping strip is provided with a plurality of mask strips. The middle of the film-coating pressing frame is hollowed out and is matched with the battery piece placing table, the film-coating pressing frame is fixedly locked on the film-coating bottom plate through a fastening screw sleeved with a spring, a positioning groove is formed in the position, corresponding to a grid line of a battery piece, of the upper surface of the film-coating pressing frame, and the mask strip is embedded into the positioning groove of the film-coating pressing frame and is pressed and fixed through a pressing strip. According to the utility model, the mask body made of the polytetrafluoroethylene material is used for replacing the traditional high-temperature adhesive tape, so that the grid line of the battery piece is effectively protected from being influenced, good conductivity is kept, the mask has the advantages of accurate positioning, high efficiency, short pasting time, difficulty in deformation, quickness in use and reusability, the economic benefit is greatly improved, and energy conservation and cost reduction are realized.

title: Hydrogel-based continuous forward osmosis-salt pollution-free solar interface evaporation coupling system
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of membrane separation and solar interface evaporation in water treatment, in particular to a hydrogel-based continuous forward osmosis-salt pollution-free solar interface evaporation coupling system which comprises a liquid storage tank, a floating structure and a stock solution are arranged in the liquid storage tank, an FO membrane is arranged in the floating structure, and the stock solution is arranged in the FO membrane. A gel evaporator and a draw solution are arranged on the top surface of the FO film; the floating structure extends into the stock solution, and the bottom surface of the FO membrane is in contact with the stock solution; and the gel evaporator extends into the draw solution, and the bottom surface of the gel evaporator is in contact with the top surface of the FO film. Salt ions and other organic pollutants in a stock solution are efficiently intercepted through the forward osmosis effect of an FO membrane, only water molecules flow to the high-osmotic-pressure draw solution side, the gel evaporator converts light energy into heat energy under the driving of solar energy to evaporate the water molecules, meanwhile, the material of the gel evaporator is hydrogel, and the water molecules in the stock solution can be evaporated through the heat energy. The evaporation efficiency is effectively improved, the concentration of the draw solution is maintained, and the continuous operation of the forward osmosis process is ensured.

title: Frost rain sliding plate photovoltaic heat energy storage heat pump
abstract: The invention discloses a freezing rain sliding plate photovoltaic heat energy storage heat pump and aims to solve the problems that freezing rain frequently occurs in a wet and cold climate zone with the temperature of-5 DEG C or above in the whole world in winter, a traditional air source heat pump is frosted and loses the heat supply function, the residential building is low in occupancy rate, centralized heat supply cannot be achieved, and the problem is a world problem under the dual-carbon target. The system is technically characterized in that a quadruple-source shutter evaporator occupies the position of a protective fence of an existing building air conditioner outdoor unit for replacement, and a mixed source integrating freezing rain water vapor resources, a low-humidity air source, solar photovoltaic photo-thermal and energy storage which are specific in a low-temperature and high-humidity climate zone can be fully utilized in system operation; the device serves as a low-temperature heat source of a simple energy lifting device and ultra-silence cooling of air conditioner waste heat. The central heating is simplified into unit long-acting direct heating and cooling, intermediate link loss is avoided, 30-50% of operation cost can still be reduced for users under the condition of no subsidy heating, and meanwhile, heating, cooling and photovoltaic charging inversion of independent users of new buildings can be effectively achieved, and daily lighting electricity is saved.

title: Green electricity driven carbon-based energy microwave discharge plasma gasification reaction system and method
abstract: The invention discloses a green electricity driven carbon-based energy microwave discharge plasma gasification reaction system and method, and relates to the technical field of plasma gasification and efficient utilization of renewable energy sources. The system mainly comprises a green power supply unit, a microwave discharge plasma gasification unit, a gasification agent supply unit and a product separation and purification unit, the green power supply unit is used for adjusting unstable power such as wind energy and solar energy into stable electric energy suitable for microwave excitation, and the plasma gasification process is driven; the microwave gasification unit realizes low-temperature efficient reaction of carbon-based fuel and a gasifying agent; the gasifying agent supply unit provides a plurality of optional gasifying agents including CO2 and water vapor; and the product separation and purification unit is used for gas purification and gasification agent recycling. The system realizes cooperative complementation of renewable energy and carbon-based energy, has the advantages of fast response, high energy efficiency, low carbon emission and the like, and is suitable for scenes of clean fuel preparation and carbon resource utilization.

title: Solar-driven water quality monitoring platform
abstract: The utility model discloses a water quality monitoring platform driven by solar energy, which comprises a solar cell panel, the solar cell panel is installed on a rotary support frame, the rotary support frame comprises an L-shaped frame, the L-shaped frame comprises two right-angle sides which are perpendicular to each other, a bevel edge is arranged between the two right-angle sides, the solar cell panel is connected with the bevel edge, and the solar cell panel is installed on the rotary support frame. A rotating shaft is arranged at the joint of the two right-angle sides and connected with a stepping motor, a rotary platform is arranged below the rotary supporting frame and connected with a rotary bearing, the rotary bearing is connected with an external driving device, the solar cell panel is connected with an energy storage battery, and the energy storage battery is connected with a control module. The control module comprises a microprocessor and a data cache region, and the control module is connected with the water quality sensor module.

title: Distributed photovoltaic consumption reduction and efficiency improvement system based on water lifting project
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of photovoltaic technology and water lifting engineering, and discloses a distributed photovoltaic consumption reduction and efficiency improvement system based on water lifting engineering, the top of a reservoir and the top of a pump room are respectively provided with a pool photovoltaic panel and a pump room photovoltaic panel, and a photovoltaic support assembly is arranged below the photovoltaic panels. The supporting assembly comprises a base, a vertical rod and rib plates, and a plurality of sets of rib plates are arranged between the vertical rod and the base. A plurality of groups of studs are embedded in the base, and the tops of the studs are connected with nuts. The distributed photovoltaic panels are installed above the reservoir and the pump room, solar energy is directly converted into electric energy, power is provided for the pump machine, the utilization rate of photovoltaic electric energy is remarkably increased, dependence on traditional electric power is reduced, and effective utilization of green energy is achieved. According to the utility model, the energy consumption of a water lifting project can be effectively reduced, the power utilization cost is reduced, the surplus power can be connected to the internet, the economic benefit is increased, the utilization efficiency is improved, the optimized operation of the system can be realized through an intelligent control technology, and the social value is remarkable.

title: Distributed power supply method and device for large-wingspan aircraft
abstract: The embodiment of the invention discloses a distributed power supply method and device for a large-wingspan aircraft, and the method comprises the steps: employing a solar cell and an energy storage battery to cooperate to supply power to the large-wingspan aircraft, enabling the upper surface of the large-wingspan aircraft to be provided with a solar cell panel, enabling the solar cell panel to serve as an upper skin, and enabling the left and right sides of the whole aircraft to be respectively provided with a group of energy storage batteries; in the daytime, the solar battery pack collects illumination to generate electric energy, the energy is distributed by the energy controller, and the energy storage battery can be charged after the load requirement of the large-wingspan aircraft is met; at night, the large-wingspan aircraft load is powered by the energy storage battery. By means of the distributed energy power supply system, the endurance of the large-wingspan aircraft can be greatly improved.

title: Radar power supply device
abstract: The utility model discloses a radar power supply device which comprises a solar power supply module, a mains supply module and a power supply control module. Wherein the solar power supply module is connected with the power supply control module and the target radar, and the commercial power supply module is connected with the power supply control module and the target radar; the solar power supply module comprises a solar cell panel and an energy storage battery, the solar cell panel is connected with the first end of the energy storage battery, the second end of the energy storage battery is connected with the power supply control module, and the third end of the energy storage battery is connected with the target radar. According to the radar power supply device provided by the invention, the situation that a worker needs to supplement fuel to the generator irregularly when a single generator is used for supplying power to the radar is avoided, the working difficulty of the worker is reduced, the convenience of supplying power to the radar is improved, and the energy consumption in the process of supplying power to the radar is reduced; and the environmental protection performance of the power supply device is improved.

title: Solar-powered rsu device
abstract: The utility model discloses a solar power supply rsu device, which belongs to the V2X field and comprises a supporting mechanism, a fixing mechanism is mounted in the middle of the supporting mechanism, a solar power supply rsu device body is mounted in the middle of the fixing mechanism, other equipment is mounted above the outer end of the supporting mechanism, the fixing mechanism comprises a supporting seat, and the supporting seat is mounted on the fixing mechanism. A supporting block is fixedly arranged at the outer end of the supporting seat, a mounting groove is formed in the middle of the supporting block, a clamping groove is formed in the inner side of the outer end of the supporting block, a clamping spring is fixedly installed on the inner side of the clamping groove, and a clamping plate is movably installed in the clamping groove through the clamping spring. The distance between the top plate and the supporting block can be adjusted, so that after the rsu device shell powered by solar energy is installed, upper and lower protection parts are more matched, and the adjusting rod and the connecting rod can be fixed after the height is adjusted through the arrangement of the pressing block.

title: Methoxyl-substituted pyridylamine polymer as well as preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a methoxy-substituted pyridylamine polymer as well as a preparation method and application thereof. The structural formula of the methoxy-substituted pyridylamine polymer is shown as a formula (I), the perovskite solar cell prepared from the methoxy-substituted pyridylamine polymer has high open-circuit voltage, and the energy conversion efficiency of the perovskite solar cell is effectively improved.

title: Portable camping lamp
abstract: The portable camping lamp comprises a lamp body and a battery pack, a floodlight panel and a lens are arranged on the lamp body, a protective cover is arranged on the side of the lamp body, a PET heating element matched with a mosquito-repellent incense piece in the protective cover is arranged in the lamp body, an elastic push rod, a sliding plate and a rotating piece are rotationally connected to one side of the protective cover, and a plurality of connecting plates are movably connected to the sliding plate. Every two adjacent connecting plates are rotationally connected, the solar panels are arranged on the connecting plates, the solar panels are stacked and stored through the rotating pieces, and the elastic push rod is arranged on the other side of the protective cover, so that after the mosquito-repellent incense piece is arranged in the protective cover in the arrow direction, the push rod device at the other end can be turned to the other side, and the mosquito-repellent incense piece can be stored. The mosquito-repellent incense piece inside can be pushed out of the protective cover only by pulling the elastic push rod, the problem that the electric mosquito-repellent incense piece cannot be taken out without a tool is avoided, the large-capacity battery pack is arranged, the device is a natural energy storage station, the device can serve as a mobile power bank to charge a mobile phone, and normal use of the mobile phone is guaranteed.

title: Circulation type photoelectric concerted catalytic filtration system for removing new pollutant wastewater by efficiently activating molecular oxygen and application of circulation type photoelectric concerted catalytic filtration system
abstract: The invention discloses a circulation-type photoelectric synergistic catalytic filtration system for removing new pollutant wastewater by efficiently activating molecular oxygen, which has multiple advantages of efficiently activating molecular oxygen, realizing photoelectric synergistic interaction and enhancing mass transfer by a flow system, and is beneficial to realizing efficient removal of new pollutants. The circulation type photoelectric synergistic catalysis filtering system comprises a shell, a negative electrode, a positive electrode and an interlayer, wherein an anode, a non-woven fabric interlayer, a cathode and a sealing ring are sequentially arranged in the shell; wherein the anode is a bismuth oxybromide/carbon nitride/samarium-bismuth vanadate photoelectrode, and the cathode is a ferrocobalt diatom confinement carbon nanotube electrode; the broadband spectral response material and the novel catalyst design significantly improve the anti-interference performance, and adapt to complex water quality and low-concentration pollution scenes. New pollutant wastewater can be efficiently removed after being illuminated and electrified in the circulation type photoelectric concerted catalytic filtration system in a circulation flow mode, and the removal rate of ibuprofen within 2 hours can reach 96%. The method is simple in design, easy to operate, low in cost and small in energy consumption, solves the problems of low removal efficiency, high energy consumption and the like of a common treatment system, further reduces the operation cost in cooperation with solar full spectrum utilization and low catalyst dosage design, and shows the comprehensive advantages of high efficiency, stability, economy and environmental protection.

title: Amine organic compound and organic photovoltaic cell
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of organic photovoltaics, in particular to an amine organic compound and an organic photovoltaic cell. The arylamine side chain can effectively regulate and control the absorption and chemical energy level of the acceptor material, and can form good optical absorption complementation with a donor and a host acceptor, so that solar photons are fully utilized, and the battery performance can be comprehensively improved when the arylamine side chain is applied to an organic photovoltaic battery as a third component acceptor material.

title: Portable water collector
abstract: The invention relates to the field of water collectors, in particular to a portable water collector which is characterized in that telescopic blades are matched with a cooling module, so that air flows into blade bodies of the cooling module from guide grooves of the telescopic blades, and the temperature difference between low temperature generated on the surfaces of the blade bodies and the temperature of water vapor in the air reaches liquefiable temperature difference; and therefore, the air is condensed and stored. According to the water collector, renewable resources such as wind energy and solar energy are fully utilized, the telescopic blades are arranged to guide more air and liquefy, collect and store water vapor in the air in the environment with low air humidity (such as regions in the northwest and the like), and therefore water resources are fully utilized.

title: Photovoltaic charging pile
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of photovoltaic new energy equipment, in particular to a photovoltaic charging pile. The pile mainly comprises a pile body, the charging pile further comprises a carrying frame connecting base, a power supplementing photovoltaic panel and a main charging panel device installed in the pile body. The pile body is mounted on the carrying frame connecting seat; the main charging panel device comprises a main energy storage battery and a robot charging port; a direct-current adjustable voltage reduction device is connected between the power compensation photovoltaic panel and the main energy storage battery; and a first direct-current adjustable constant-voltage device is connected between the main energy storage battery and the robot charging port. According to the photovoltaic charging pile, rich solar energy resources of an original photovoltaic power plant are borrowed, and the photovoltaic panel cleaning robot is charged in real time in a following mode; no extra mains supply network needs to be introduced, the charging process is simple and efficient, and the charging method is more suitable for charging work of the photovoltaic panel cleaning robot of a large photovoltaic power plant.

title: Control method for preventing photovoltaic push rod from being locked and unable to retreat in braking process
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of photovoltaic push rods, and discloses a control method for preventing a photovoltaic push rod from being locked and unable to retreat in the braking process, which comprises the following steps: S1, starting a central control unit of a photovoltaic bracket, and performing normal tracking on the electric push rod by calculating the sun time to ensure the maximum utilization rate of solar energy; s2, the central control unit accurately obtains the real-time operation angle of the photovoltaic support through a dual data fusion mechanism, an inclination angle sensor and a pulse width modulation module are further arranged in the central control unit, and a Hall sensor is arranged in a motor for driving an electric push rod to stretch out and retract; s3, setting the running angle of the photovoltaic support in the central control unit to enter a buffer early warning area of hard limit; the whole structure is simple, hard limiting brake impact can be actively avoided from the control method level, the push rod is guided to smoothly return, and the using effect is improved by optimizing the brake time sequence.

title: Hybrid power supply system and control method thereof
abstract: The invention provides a hybrid power supply system and a control method thereof, and relates to the technical field of power supply equipment. The hybrid power supply system comprises a power supply system, a power supply system, a monitoring system and a photovoltaic off-grid and grid-connected system, wherein the power supply system is used for supplying power to the power supply system, the monitoring system and the photovoltaic off-grid and grid-connected system; the power supply system is used for generating electric energy based on the power supply system and transmitting the electric energy to the monitoring system and the photovoltaic off-grid and grid-connected system; the monitoring system is used for monitoring the power supply system and the photovoltaic off-grid and grid-connected system, the monitoring system comprises a fire fighting system and an SMS system, and the fire fighting system comprises smoke detection equipment, temperature detection equipment, a fire extinguishing system, a smoke exhaust system and harmful gas detection equipment; the SMS system comprises a load monitoring module, an optical power monitoring module and a temperature field monitoring module; and the photovoltaic off-grid and grid-connected system is used for converting the solar energy collected by the solar cell panel into electric energy and storing the electric energy through an energy storage battery.

title: Multi-mode composite power generation device based on wind-solar coupling
abstract: The invention discloses a multi-mode composite power generation device based on wind-solar coupling. The multi-mode composite power generation device comprises a wind-solar coupling power generation unit, a wind-induced rotation power generation unit and a wind-induced vibration power generation unit. Wherein the wind-light coupling power generation unit comprises a wind-light power generation component, a reverse tracking component and a bag type friction nanometer power generation component, the wind-light power generation component can capture wind energy and light energy and convert the wind energy and the light energy into electric energy, and the angle of the wind-light power generation component is driven and adjusted by the reverse tracking component; the reverse tracking component can collect wind speed and light intensity data in real time and dynamically adjust the angle of the wind-solar power generation component; the bag type friction nanometer power generation component can capture wind energy, has a working state and a storage state, and can be switched along with angle adjustment of the wind and light power generation component. The device can efficiently utilize natural wind, train wind and solar energy along the railway, solves the energy supply problem of the sensor network, improves the railway operation and maintenance stability, reduces the cost, and assists in constructing a green, efficient and accurate modern intelligent railway operation and maintenance system.

title: Monitoring stand column device for monitoring installation
abstract: The utility model belongs to the technical field of monitoring equipment installation, and particularly relates to a monitoring upright post device for monitoring installation, which comprises an adjusting rod, and an angle adjusting component is arranged at the top of the adjusting rod; the angle adjusting assembly comprises a supporting plate, the supporting plate is fixedly connected to the top of the adjusting rod, an air cylinder is fixedly connected to the top of the adjusting rod, a sliding rail is fixedly connected to the top of the adjusting rod, a sliding block is fixedly connected to the output end of the air cylinder, and the sliding block is in sliding connection with the sliding rail. Connecting tables are fixedly connected to the two sides of the top of the supporting plate, and sliding grooves are formed in the connecting tables. According to the utility model, the slide block is driven by the cylinder to slide on the slide rail, and the top of the slide block drives the rotating rod to rotate and slide in the chutes arranged at the two sides of the connecting table, so that the angle adjustment of the solar panel is realized, solar energy is utilized to generate electricity to the greatest extent, the electric power pressure is reduced, and the utilization rate of the solar panel is improved.

title: Multifunctional integrated photovoltaic heating and power supply equipment
abstract: The utility model discloses multifunctional integrated photovoltaic heating and power supply equipment, which belongs to the technical field of heating and power supply equipment and comprises an installation cabinet, a heat storage box is arranged in one side of the installation cabinet, a photovoltaic assembly is arranged at the top end of the installation cabinet, a cleaning assembly is arranged on the surface of the photovoltaic assembly, and a supporting rod is fixedly connected to the top end of the installation cabinet. According to the solar water heater, the heat insulation plate is arranged in the solar water heater, by means of the design, the heat insulation plate can cover the surface of the heat collector at night, meanwhile, the heat collector is embedded in the mounting plate, so that the heat collector is sealed to a certain degree, the possibility that water in the heat collector is frozen at night is reduced, and the service life of the solar water heater is prolonged. And the heat collector and the photovoltaic panel are combined together, and energy generated by the heat collector and the photovoltaic panel is collected through the heat storage box and the electricity storage box, so that electric energy and heat energy can be conveniently utilized, and the utilization rate of light energy can be increased.

title: Coal slurry electrolytic hydrogen production system and method based on solar power supply and heat supply
abstract: The invention discloses a coal slurry electrolysis hydrogen production system and method based on solar power supply and heat supply, and the system comprises a photovoltaic power supply and heat supply unit which is used for converting solar energy into electric energy and heat energy, and the electric energy is provided for the electrolysis process of coal slurry after being subjected to power supply adjustment and pulse modulation through a power supply controller and a pulse controller; the heat energy is used for heating coal slurry in the electrolysis process through the heat exchanger and is supplied to the electrolytic reaction unit through the circulating pump; the coal slurry preparation unit is used for crushing and screening low-rank coal and mixing the low-rank coal with a dispersing agent, dilute acid or dilute alkali to prepare coal slurry; the electrolytic reaction unit is used for electrolyzing the coal slurry, so that the coal slurry is subjected to an oxidation-reduction reaction under the action of an electric field to obtain hydrogen; the intelligent control unit is used for adjusting operation parameters of the coal slurry electrolytic hydrogen production system; according to the coal slurry electrolytic hydrogen production system, the electrolyte can be preheated through cooperation of photovoltaic waste heat, the overall efficiency and stability of the system are improved, the resource utilization rate is increased, and clean and efficient conversion of low-rank coal resources is achieved.

title: Cable joint on-line monitoring device based on CT electricity taking and optical fiber sensing
abstract: The invention discloses a cable joint on-line monitoring device based on CT electricity taking and optical fiber sensing, and relates to the field of cable monitoring, the cable joint on-line monitoring device comprises a CT electricity taking device and an optical fiber sensor, the optical fiber sensor is installed below the CT electricity taking device, an upper positioning seat is fixedly arranged on the upper side of the CT electricity taking device, and a lower positioning seat is installed at the bottom of the optical fiber sensor; an optical fiber probe is installed at the end of the CT electricity taking device, an optical fiber probe is installed at the end of the optical fiber sensor, meanwhile, an induction coil is installed at the end of the CT electricity taking device, and the optical fiber sensor supplies energy through the CT electricity taking device. According to the cable joint online monitoring device based on CT power taking and optical fiber sensing, continuous energy supply is achieved through the current of the cable, long-term stable operation of the optical fiber sensor is ensured, the later maintenance cost and workload are reduced, external mains supply and solar energy are not needed, and installation is convenient and fast; the larger the current is, the more sufficient the induction electric energy is, regular manual replacement or charging is not needed, and the maintenance cost and risk are reduced.

title: Design method and system for building integrated photovoltaic system
abstract: The invention discloses a building integrated photovoltaic system design method and system, and relates to the field of building design. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring photoelectric characteristics, response characteristics and optical characteristics of solar cells made of different photovoltaic materials; according to the photoelectric characteristics and optical characteristics of the solar cells of the photovoltaic materials corresponding to the photovoltaic material combinations, standard building models of the different thermotechnical partitions under the different photovoltaic material combinations are established, simulation is carried out, and the energy consumption result of each standard building model is obtained; determining an optimal photovoltaic material combination according to the energy consumption result, the response characteristics and the solar radiation characteristics of different parts; and simulating the reference building model according to the optimal photovoltaic material combination, and determining the optimal building shape parameter combination of each thermotechnical partition by adopting an iterative local search algorithm by taking the maximum generating capacity and the minimum net energy consumption as optimization targets, so as to obtain the optimal building model of each thermotechnical partition. The overall energy utilization efficiency and energy efficiency of the building can be remarkably improved.

title: Solar coupling power generation system of land wind power plant
abstract: The invention discloses a land wind power plant solar coupling power generation system, and relates to the technical field of renewable energy power generation, and the system comprises a wind and light energy collection module which collects parameters, converts wind and light energy into electric energy, and transmits the electric energy; the energy conversion and storage module processes the electric energy, monitors the state of a storage battery, and distributes the electric energy for grid connection and storage; the intelligent monitoring and scheduling module is used for processing parameters, calculating by adopting a formula and sending an instruction; the grid-connected transmission module processes electric energy, merges the electric energy into a power grid and feeds back power grid acceptance power; the pre-maintenance execution module is used for receiving an instruction maintenance device, feeding back a state and calculating the life extension amount; through cooperation of wind and light energy collection and the intelligent monitoring module, efficient complementation of wind energy and solar energy and stable operation of the system are achieved, and the utilization rate of renewable energy is increased; meanwhile, an intelligent maintenance system covering the whole life cycle is constructed, hidden dangers are actively eliminated, the operation and maintenance cost is reduced, the service life of equipment is prolonged, and the economical efficiency and reliability of the system are improved.

title: Solar power generation equipment management method and system based on Internet of Things
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of solar power generation equipment management, in particular to a solar power generation equipment management method and system based on the Internet of Things, and the method comprises the steps: adaptively adjusting the collection frequency and range of a sensor installed on solar power generation equipment; acquiring operation parameters, environment parameters and equipment state information of the solar power generation equipment; transmitting the acquired parameters and information to a data management platform by adopting a dynamic routing selection and data compression technology; performing multi-dimensional analysis on the received parameters and information by using a fusion algorithm, evaluating the operation state of the equipment and analyzing the energy output; and generating a targeted equipment maintenance instruction and an energy scheduling strategy according to an analysis result, and issuing the instruction and the strategy to an execution end for implementation. According to the invention, a complete and efficient management process is formed from front-end information acquisition optimization to rear-end intelligent decision execution in combination with the Internet of Things, and the operation efficiency and the management level of the solar power generation equipment are improved.

title: Photocatalytic nitrogen fertilizer preparation and application integrated device and use method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a photocatalytic nitrogen fertilizer preparation and application integrated device in the technical field, the photocatalytic nitrogen fertilizer preparation and application integrated device comprises a floating support, the floating support is arranged in a paddy field, the upper part of the floating support is fixedly provided with a nitrogen fertilizer preparation mechanism, and the nitrogen fertilizer preparation mechanism comprises a reaction tank; the device uses solar energy as the only energy to drive the air pump, and does not depend on fossil energy; in combination with reaction period control, the concentration of ammonium nitrogen in the field water can be stably maintained at a proper concentration; ammonium nitrogen is dissolved in water and directly enters crop rhizosphere to be absorbed; the lifting ring is pushed and extruded through the reset spring, the aeration nozzle is used for aeration, the gradient photocatalytic material can dissolve ammonium nitrogen generated by nitrogen in air in water under photoreaction, under the action of the reset spring, the lifting ring can achieve lifting adjustment, the position can be conveniently adjusted through air pressure, and the gradient photocatalytic material can be recycled. And the turbine blades can rotate by virtue of the aerated air flow, so that a solution in the reaction tank is stirred, and the sufficiency of ammonium nitrogen dissolved in water is conveniently improved.

title: Environment-friendly liquid dung heating device
abstract: The invention discloses an environment-friendly liquid dung heating device, and relates to the technical field of heating equipment.The environment-friendly liquid dung heating device comprises a liquid dung storage area and a heating assembly, the heating assembly comprises a focusing unit, the focusing unit comprises a plurality of first lenses, the first lenses can focus sunlight, and a heat conduction unit comprises a first pipeline storing a heat transfer medium; the heat transfer medium exchanges heat with liquid dung in the liquid dung storage area through the heat exchange area, and at least part of the area of the first pipeline is located in the focusing emergent area of the first lens; after the environment-friendly liquid dung heating device is manufactured, fuel does not need to be purchased, liquid dung can be heated through solar energy, and the liquid dung heating cost is low; the sum of the light absorption areas of the first pipelines is larger than the sum of the projection areas of the emergent light spots of all the first lenses on the first pipelines, so that the problems that the angles of the first lenses are frequently adjusted and more manpower and material resources are consumed due to the fact that sunlight heats the heat transfer medium slowly and azimuth angles such as the solar altitude are changed are solved.

title: Laminated solar spectrum gradient utilization and thermoelectric cooperation system and use method
abstract: The invention provides a laminated solar spectrum gradient utilization and thermoelectric collaboration system and a use method thereof. The laminated solar spectrum gradient utilization and thermoelectric collaboration system comprises a Fresnel condensation layer, high-transmittance packaging glass, a semitransparent photovoltaic cell, a heat collection layer and a narrow-band-gap photovoltaic cell which are sequentially arranged from top to bottom. The Fresnel condensation layer, the high-transmittance packaging glass, the semitransparent photovoltaic cell, the heat collection layer and the narrow-band-gap photovoltaic cell are independently constructed or integrally manufactured by adopting a layer-by-layer deposition or integrated packaging process. The Fresnel condensation layer, the high-transmittance packaging glass, the semitransparent photovoltaic cell, the heat collection layer and the narrow-band-gap photovoltaic cell are vertically integrated, so that gradient utilization of the solar spectrum is achieved, and the comprehensive efficiency is improved. The heat collection layer recovers upper and lower layer photovoltaic waste heat, reduces the battery temperature, enhances the stability and prolongs the service life. The system gives consideration to power generation and heat supply, output heat energy can meet multiple scenes, the structure is compact and adapts to multiple deployment forms, manufacturing is compatible with an existing process, cost is controllable, and the problems of resource waste and the like of a traditional system are effectively solved.

title: Self-adaptive day-by-day solar irrigation equipment for energy-saving agriculture
abstract: The utility model discloses self-adaptive day-by-day solar irrigation equipment for energy-saving agriculture. The self-adaptive day-by-day solar irrigation equipment comprises a solar panel, a tracking bracket, an irrigation system and an intelligent control system, the solar panel is installed on the tracking support, the tracking support achieves day-by-day tracking through the rotating mechanism, the irrigation system comprises a water pump, a water conveying pipe and a spray head, and the intelligent control system comprises a central processing unit, a sensor and an actuator. The central processing unit controls operation of the driving motor and the water pump controller according to feedback signals of the illumination sensor, the temperature sensor and the humidity sensor, and sun-by-sun tracking of the solar panel and accurate control of the irrigation system are achieved. And the wireless communication module realizes communication with a remote monitoring system, so that the intelligent level and the management efficiency of the equipment are improved. According to the invention, the utilization efficiency of solar energy can be maximized, water resource waste is reduced, and the irrigation effect is improved.

title: Self-adaptive movable house capable of rising, falling and rotating under temperature control
abstract: The invention discloses a temperature control lifting and rotating self-adaptive movable house, belongs to the technical field of constructional engineering, and aims at solving the problems that an existing temporary building is insufficient in thermal environment regulation and control, weak in self-adaptive capacity, high in energy consumption and the like. The box house comprises a house body, a paraffin-based thermal expansion driving system, an outer wall thermal bimetal shutter curtain wall system, an intelligent control system and a solar photovoltaic and ventilation integrated system. Wherein the paraffin-based thermal expansion driver can adjust the distance between a house and the ground, the thermal bimetal shutter curtain wall can dynamically shade and ventilate, the intelligent control system monitors parameters such as temperature gradient and heat exchange temperature difference, all the systems are linked to achieve automatic switching between a winter heat preservation mode and a summer ventilation mode, and the solar photovoltaic and ventilation system improves the energy utilization efficiency. Through cooperation of multiple systems, the box room can adapt to environment temperature changes, maintain the indoor comfortable temperature, reduce energy consumption and enhance the environment adaptability and structural stability of a temporary building, and is suitable for construction sites, disaster rescue and other scenes.

title: Renewable energy facility specification optimization method and system under dual power supply scene
abstract: The invention provides a renewable energy facility specification optimization method and system in a dual power supply scene, and belongs to the technical field of solar grid-connected dual power supply. Comprising the steps that in a dual-power-supply scene, small base stations in a region are divided into N clusters, each cluster is provided with an energy storage center and K small base stations, and each small base station is provided with a solar cell panel and an energy storage battery; defining an energy sharing model of the energy storage center and a total cost model of renewable energy facilities of each small base station; providing constraint conditions according to parameters of the sharing model and the total cost model, performing minimization calculation on the total cost by using a Markov decision process, and solving an optimal configuration combination of the solar cell panel specification and the energy storage battery specification; according to the method, objective environment data such as local solar irradiance, regional rent and labor cost are utilized, and the scale of renewable energy facilities most suitable for local regional characteristics is explored from the perspective of minimizing the total cost of the facilities on the basis of considering electricity charge loss.

title: Intelligent control device for distribution network power system
abstract: The utility model discloses an intelligent control device for a distribution network electric power system, which comprises an intelligent control device main body connected with the distribution network electric power system, and the distribution network electric power system comprises a solar photovoltaic group, an inverter, a battery pack, an electric energy metering device, a data communication device I, a power sensor and a battery electric quantity metering device. According to the utility model, the power generation condition and the output power can be monitored in real time in the operation process of the distribution network power system, and the angle of the solar photovoltaic group can be intelligently adjusted according to the combination of the electric energy and the solar trace when the electric energy is relatively low, so that the solar photovoltaic group can generate power stably, the power generation efficiency is improved, and the energy consumption is reduced. And the output power of the inverter can be adjusted during the peak period of the power grid, so that stable voltage supply can be realized, the operation stability of the distribution network power system is improved, in addition, the charging and discharging conditions of the battery pack can be managed and controlled, and the battery pack is effectively protected.

title: Support device for photovoltaic power station
abstract: The utility model relates to a support device for a photovoltaic power station. Comprising an installation base, an installation supporting column and multiple sets of fulcrum shaft structures are fixedly connected to the installation base, multiple sets of swing positioning pieces are fixedly connected to each fulcrum shaft structure, two sets of arc-shaped through grooves are formed in each swing positioning piece, and a swing frame assembly is installed on each fulcrum shaft structure; all the swing frame assemblies are locked and connected through bolts arranged in the arc-shaped through grooves in a penetrating manner; the pitching adjusting assembly is installed on the swing frame assembly; the swing frame assembly comprises a swing mounting frame, and a hinged lifting seat is mounted on the swing mounting frame; the pitching adjusting assembly comprises a photovoltaic base plate connected with the hinged lifting base in a pivoted mode, an upper adjusting base is fixedly connected to the bottom face of the photovoltaic base plate, an upper hinged sliding block is installed on the upper adjusting base, the pitching adjusting assembly further comprises a lead screw support, a lower hinged sliding block is installed on the lead screw support, and an installation swing rod is connected between the lower hinged sliding block and the upper hinged sliding block in a pivoted mode. The device further comprises a lifting driving mechanism. According to the utility model, a plurality of groups of photovoltaic panels can be mounted, solar energy can be absorbed as much as possible under the condition that the occupied area is not enlarged, and the inclination angles of the photovoltaic panels can be adjusted, so that the solar energy is utilized to the maximum extent.

title: Solar power supply system for plateau region and installation method
abstract: The invention, which relates to the technical field of extreme environment energy supply, discloses a solar power supply system for a plateau region, comprising a photovoltaic power generation assembly, a current aggregation unit, an energy management center, an energy storage unit, an electric energy conversion unit, a power distribution unit and a monitoring unit. Through systematic designs such as material selection, electrical protection, thermal management and communication redundancy, the severe challenge of the plateau environment is solved, triple optimization of power generation efficiency, safety and operation and maintenance cost is achieved, and a high-reliability clean energy solution can be provided for plateau key facilities.

title: Natural gas valve structure
abstract: The utility model belongs to the technical field of natural gas conveying equipment, and discloses a natural gas valve structure which comprises a valve body, a valve element, a driving mechanism, a storage battery and a solar panel. One end of the channel is an air inlet, and the other end of the channel is an air outlet; a connecting shaft is arranged in the channel, and the valve element is fixedly arranged on the connecting shaft in a penetrating mode. The output end of the driving mechanism is connected to the connecting shaft, and the driving mechanism can drive the valve element to be blocked between the air inlet and the air outlet. The output end of the storage battery is connected to the driving mechanism; the solar panel is connected to the input end of the storage battery, and the solar panel is configured to convert light energy into electric energy. The storage battery and the solar panel are matched with each other, so that the requirement of the natural gas valve structure for energy supply is reduced, and the reliability is higher under the condition of extreme weather or power shortage; the valve body, the valve element and the driving mechanism are matched with one another, so that communication or interruption of natural gas in a channel is controlled, the structure is simple, and faults are not prone to occurring.

title: Passive energy-saving curtain wall unit and assembly method
abstract: The invention discloses a passive energy-saving curtain wall unit and an assembly method. The passive energy-saving curtain wall unit comprises a plurality of embedded parts, hollow vertical beams are welded to the tops of the embedded parts, a plurality of hollow cross beams are installed between the hollow vertical beams, and an installation frame is installed between every two adjacent hollow cross beams through screws; edge covering pieces are fixedly arranged on the four edges of the curtain wall structure in an edge covering mode, female groove sealing strips are arranged on the inner sides of the four edge covering pieces, matched female grooves are formed in the female groove sealing strips, limiting pieces are fixedly installed on the inner side of the installation frame, male head sealing strips are fixedly installed on the limiting pieces, and the male head sealing strips are matched with the matched female grooves. According to the energy-saving curtain wall, the solar energy utilization rate is increased through photo-thermal-photoelectric-temperature difference three-mode synergism, the requirement of building energy-saving development is met, gel double-response dynamic heat insulation is adopted, the indoor heat insulation effect is improved, and winter and summer double-mode precise temperature control is achieved through a curved flow channel.

title: Installation warning frame for port engineering
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of warning frames, in particular to an installation warning frame for port engineering. The signboard comprises a signboard body, a plug pin is fixedly connected to one side of the signboard body, a notch is formed in one side of the signboard body, a display board is slidably connected into the notch, energy storage batteries are fixedly connected to the two sides of the bottom end of a fixing support, and a shakable handle is connected to one side of a mounting column on one side in a penetrating mode. A sliding groove is formed in the mounting column, a threaded rod is rotatably connected to the interior of the mounting column, a rainwater groove is welded to the top end of the signboard body, and a solar panel is fixedly connected to the interior of the rainwater groove; according to the solar signboard, electric energy is stored and output to the illuminating lamp through the rainwater groove, the solar panel, the illuminating lamp and the energy storage battery connected with the solar panel, so that the warning effect of the signboard can be obviously improved at night and in rainy and foggy weather, and the defect of low visibility at night is overcome.

title: Small multifunctional road surface cleaning vehicle
abstract: The invention discloses a small multifunctional road surface cleaning vehicle, and relates to the technical field of road surface cleaning equipment.The small multifunctional road surface cleaning vehicle comprises a vehicle body and a control panel, the control panel is fixedly installed on the outer side of the vehicle body, a containing groove is formed in the upper end face of the vehicle body, and a first sliding groove is formed in the bottom face of the containing groove; the middle of the containing groove is rotationally connected with an outer frame. According to the small multifunctional road surface cleaning vehicle, the motor drives the lead screw to rotate to enable the sliding block to move along the first sliding groove, then the supporting rod drives the outer frame to rotate, the angle of the solar panel on the outer frame can be flexibly adjusted, the solar panel receives light to the maximum extent according to the sun positions in different time periods, and the solar energy conversion efficiency is improved; more electric power is provided for the cleaning vehicle, and the endurance is prolonged; and meanwhile, the embedded groove of the outer frame is detachably connected with the frame through a bolt, so that the solar panel is convenient to mount, replace and maintain, the practicability and the environmental protection property of the cleaning vehicle are enhanced, and the use cost and the maintenance difficulty are reduced.

title: Solar-assisted composite heat source heat pump system and heating method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to a solar-assisted composite heat source heat pump system and a heating method thereof, the bottom of a heat exchange box is provided with a photoelectric conversion assembly connected with a solar cell panel, the heat exchange box is filled with a low-temperature-resistant heat-conducting medium, and the low-temperature-resistant heat-conducting medium is internally provided with a snakelike heat absorption pipe and a heat-conducting medium electric heating pipe; the two ends of the snake-shaped heat absorption pipe communicate with the first pipeline and the second pipeline correspondingly, the heat-conducting medium electric heating pipe is connected with the photoelectric conversion assembly through the electric heating controller, and the energy consumption controller is connected with the electric heating controller, the compressor and the electric expansion valve through wires. Meanwhile, energy conservation and environmental protection are achieved, and the heating effect is obvious.

title: New energy integrated power construction intelligent power supply system
abstract: The invention discloses a new energy integrated intelligent power supply system for power construction. A solar photovoltaic panel and a wind driven generator are integrated to realize wind-solar complementary power generation, and a lithium battery pack and a hydrogen fuel cell are configured to form a dual-redundancy energy storage system. The system realizes real-time monitoring and intelligent scheduling of energy production and consumption through a multi-core heterogeneous processor carried by the central controller. The photovoltaic panel adopts a sun position tracking bracket, the fan is provided with variable pitch blades, and the power generation efficiency is improved by matching with the maximum power point tracking technology; the energy storage module uses a modularized lithium battery pack and active equalization management to guarantee power supply stability; the power output interface is integrated with multiple electrical protection and electric energy optimization circuits. The system realizes remote monitoring and fault diagnosis through the Internet of Things, and combines an edge computing AI prediction unit with a federal learning framework. The system significantly improves the construction power supply reliability, reduces the traditional energy dependence, and achieves the green construction target.

title: Fluorescent double-glass photovoltaic module and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a fluorescent double-glass photovoltaic module and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method comprises the following steps: mixing and stirring photoluminescent fluorescent powder, a glass solvent and ink into fluorescent glaze; providing a battery piece layer; providing a light receiving plate, a front film layer, a backlight plate and a back film layer, wherein a wiring hole is formed in the backlight plate; fluorescent glaze is printed on the backlight plate in a grid structure through a screen printing machine to form a fluorescent band layer, and the top of the fluorescent band layer at the corresponding part of the gap between adjacent battery pieces protrudes towards the gap and is in an arc shape; sequentially carrying out drying and toughening treatment on the printed backlight plate; the light receiving plate, the front film layer, the battery piece layer, the back film layer and the tempered backlight plate are sequentially stacked and then laminated in a photovoltaic laminating machine; and providing a junction box, and electrically connecting the junction box with the battery piece layer through the wiring hole to form the double-glass photovoltaic module. The double-glass photovoltaic module prepared by the preparation method is high in solar energy utilization rate and high in conversion efficiency.

title: New energy electric driving type mower capable of being provided with solar energy
abstract: The invention discloses a new energy electric driving type mower capable of being provided with solar energy, which comprises an electric driving vehicle, and a side fixing bracket is arranged on one side of the electric driving vehicle. The new energy electric driving type mower has the beneficial effects that a driving chain wheel, a driven chain wheel, a rotating support rod and a mowing knife are arranged, so that when the output end of a third motor drives the driving chain wheel to rotate, the mowing knife is driven to rotate; the driving chain wheel drives the chain on the outer side, the driving chain wheel drives the multiple driven chain wheels to rotate through the chain, the driven chain wheels drive the rotating supporting rods on the inner side to rotate when rotating, the rotating supporting rods drive the mowing knives to rotate, and mowing work is conducted through the multiple mowing knives; when the output end of a first motor drives a supporting frame and a connecting support to rotate, the connecting support, an inner rotating supporting block and a second solar panel are driven to rotate and adjust, and the orientation angle of the second solar panel is adjusted.

title: Energy storage hot air device
abstract: The utility model discloses an energy storage hot air device, which relates to the technical field of sludge treatment and comprises an energy storage hot air structure, the energy storage hot air structure comprises an energy storage outer pipe and an energy storage inner pipe, the energy storage inner pipe is positioned on the inner side of the energy storage outer pipe, and a heat storage medium is filled between the energy storage inner pipe and the energy storage outer pipe. The outer side of the energy storage outer pipe is used for winding an electromagnetic coil, and the electromagnetic coil is used for being connected with an external power source. The energy storage hot air device can act on complementation of solar energy for heating air to generate hot air, and is not affected by weather.

title: Energy-saving type stayed cable warning lighting device based on solar panel
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of cable-stayed warning equipment, in particular to an energy-saving cable-stayed warning lighting device based on a solar panel, which comprises two mounting arc plates and two butt joint arc plates, a connecting plate is fixed between the mounting arc plate and the butt joint arc plate on the same side, two base plates are fixed in one mounting arc plate, and a solar panel is fixed in the other mounting arc plate. According to the device, a traditional stayed cable warning mode is optimized, a solar panel is adopted to automatically supply power, a warning strip is matched to emit light, the warning effect is achieved, an external power source is not needed, and the device is simple in structure, convenient to use and high in practicability. Meanwhile, the butt joint arc plate and the installation arc plate are matched with each other, stable and rapid installation on the inclined pull line is achieved, the adjusting piece and the positioning part are matched with each other, installation and adjustment are easier and more convenient, and personnel can conveniently move the solar warning assembly on the inclined pull line for overhauling.
